topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 日常生活中的人工智能
topics.description: 发现日常生活中的人工智能：手机的人脸解锁、视频推荐、拼写自动纠错、能感应到人的自动门；这些技术看起来好像能“知道”一些事情。
evidence: Identify at least five examples of AI in their daily life
Explain that these technologies use patterns and data, not magic or real thinking
Describe one way AI makes their life easier and one time it might not work perfectly
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} point out several things they use every day — like auto-correct or face unlock — and explain that these are examples of AI?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 日常生活中的计算机
topics.description: 认识日常生活中的计算机——不只是笔记本电脑，还有手机、平板电脑、智能音箱、交通信号灯、洗衣机；了解是什么让一件物品成为计算机。
evidence: Point out at least five everyday objects that contain computers
Explain what all computers have in common (they follow instructions and process information)
Sort a set of objects into 'contains a computer' and 'does not contain a computer'
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} look around your home and point out at least five things that have a computer inside them, including ones that don't look like traditional computers?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 现实世界中的机器人
topics.description: 了解机器人到底是什么——不是科幻故事里的样子；认识工厂里的机器人、扫地机器人、手术机械臂；知道机器人会按照人们给出的指令行动。
evidence: Describe what a robot is (a machine that follows instructions to do a task)
Name at least three real robots and what they do
Explain that robots are not alive and do not have feelings — they follow instructions people wrote
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} saw a robot vacuum cleaner, could they explain how it's different from a person cleaning — that it follows instructions rather than thinking for itself?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 智能设备与非智能设备
topics.description: 把物品分成“智能”（能感知并做出反应）和“非智能”（只会固定地工作）两类，比如烤面包机和智能音箱；初步了解有些机器能够感知周围世界并做出反应。
evidence: Sort a set of objects into 'smart' (responds to input) and 'not smart' (does the same thing every time)
Explain what makes a smart speaker different from a regular radio
Give an example of a machine that senses something and responds (automatic door, motion-sensor light)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain the difference between a normal light switch and one that turns on automatically when you walk into a room?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 一步步的指令
topics.description: 为日常任务编写一步步的指令，比如做三明治、刷牙；了解如果指令错了或少了一步，事情就会出问题；知道计算机会严格按照指令执行。
evidence: Write or describe step-by-step instructions for a simple everyday task
Predict what goes wrong if a step is missing or in the wrong order
Explain that a computer follows instructions exactly — it cannot guess what you meant
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} had to write instructions for making a jam sandwich so precise that even a robot could follow them, could they include every single step?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 语音助手及其工作原理
topics.description: 当你和Alexa、Siri或谷歌助手说话时会发生什么：它们会听、试着理解、查找答案；有时也会出错；它们是工具，不是有生命的。
evidence: Describe the steps that happen when you ask a voice assistant a question (it listens, processes words, finds an answer, speaks back)
Give an example of a time a voice assistant might get something wrong
Explain that a voice assistant is a computer program, not a person — it doesn't understand or feel
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} asked Alexa or Siri a question and got a wrong answer, could they explain why the voice assistant sometimes makes mistakes?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 电脑游戏中的人工智能
topics.description: 电脑游戏角色如何“决定”做什么；简单的基于规则的AI和会学习的AI；非玩家角色（NPC）、难度调节；国际象棋或棋类游戏中作为对手的AI。
evidence: Explain how a computer opponent in a game decides its moves
Describe the difference between a game character that follows fixed rules and one that learns from the player
Give an example of AI making a game more fun (adjusting difficulty, generating levels)
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} plays a video game against the computer, could they explain how the game's characters 'decide' what to do?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 人工智能的错误与局限
topics.description: 机器也会出错；它们只知道被展示过的内容；不好的训练数据会导致不好的结果；AI不是魔法——只是对数据进行数学运算；展示边缘情况和失败案例。
evidence: Give an example of AI making a mistake (voice assistant mishearing, auto-correct error, wrong recommendation)
Explain that AI mistakes happen because of gaps or errors in training data
Describe why AI is not magic — it follows mathematical rules applied to data
topics.assessmentPrompt: If an AI incorrectly identified a picture of a muffin as a chihuahua, could {{name}} explain why that kind of mistake happens?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 计算机的数据与信息
topics.description: 什么是数据：计算机使用的信息——数字、文字、图片、声音；计算机知道的一切都来自人们提供的数据。
evidence: Define data as information stored in a computer (numbers, text, images, sounds)
Give at least three examples of data they create every day (photos, messages, search queries)
Explain that a computer only knows what it has been given — it has no knowledge of its own
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain what 'data' means and give examples of data they create every time they use a phone or computer?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 人类与机器
topics.description: 比较人类和机器的能力：创造力、共情力、常识与速度、记忆、重复劳动；简单介绍图灵测试；人类有什么独特之处。
evidence: Name at least three things humans are better at than computers (creativity, empathy, common sense)
Name at least three things computers are better at than humans (speed, memory, repetitive tasks)
Describe the Turing Test in simple terms (can a computer fool a person into thinking it's human?)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain what humans are still better at than computers and what computers can do that humans can't?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 机器学习基础
topics.description: 从概念层面了解机器学习的运作原理：给计算机展示很多示例，它会从中找到规律，之后就能对新事物做出预测；可以借助可教机器（Teachable Machine）或同类工具获得动手实操的体验
evidence: Describe the three steps of machine learning in simple terms (give examples, find patterns, make predictions)
Train a simple model using a tool like Teachable Machine and describe what happened
Explain why showing more and better examples makes the model more accurate
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} describe how you teach a computer to recognise something — by showing it lots of examples until it spots the pattern?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 模式与分类
topics.description: 人类非常擅长发现模式，计算机也可以学习识别模式，但它们需要大量的示例才能做到；归类和分类活动是机器学习的基础。
evidence: Sort a set of items into categories and explain the rules they used
Explain that computers learn patterns by looking at many examples
Describe why a computer needs more examples than a human to learn the same pattern
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you showed {{name}} pictures of cats and dogs, could they explain how a computer could learn to tell them apart — and why it would need many more pictures than a person would?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 推荐系统与信息茧房
topics.description: 学习推荐系统的工作原理：YouTube、网飞、购物网站等平台会追踪你点击过的内容，从中总结规律；认识什么是信息茧房；学会区分有用的推荐和恶意操纵的区别
evidence: Explain how YouTube or Netflix decides what to suggest next
Describe what a 'filter bubble' is (only seeing things similar to what you already like)
Give one benefit and one risk of recommendation systems
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} understand why YouTube keeps suggesting similar videos to ones they've watched, and could they explain how the recommendation system works?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 人工智能与决策公平
topics.description: 探讨人工智能是否可以做出与人们切身利益相关的重要决策，例如招聘、贷款审批、司法判定等；了解人工智能做出不公平决策时的责任归属；初步认识算法公平的概念。
evidence: Give an example of an important decision that AI might help make (hiring, medical diagnosis, loan approval)
Explain why letting AI make decisions about people can be risky if the system is biased
Suggest who should be responsible if an AI system makes an unfair decision
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} learned that a computer program was deciding who gets a job interview, could they explain why that might be unfair and who should be responsible?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 人工智能与环境
topics.description: 训练人工智能模型需要消耗大量能源与水资源，数据中心也会产生相应的环境成本；同时人工智能也能助力环境保护，例如预测天气、监测森林砍伐、优化能源利用等；需要客观看待其中的利弊权衡。
evidence: Explain that training AI models uses a lot of electricity and water
Give at least two examples of AI being used to help the environment
Describe the trade-off between AI's environmental cost and its environmental benefits
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain that AI needs a lot of energy to work but can also be used to help protect the environment, and discuss whether the trade-off is worth it?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 人工智能与未来工作
topics.description: 人工智能如何改变职场：一些工作会消失，新的工作会出现，许多工作会发生变化；人工智能（暂时）还不能做的工作；在人工智能时代哪些技能很重要。
evidence: Name at least two jobs that AI is changing or replacing and two new jobs AI has created
Explain why creativity, empathy, and problem-solving are skills that matter more in an AI world
Describe how AI might change a specific job they know about (teacher, doctor, farmer) without replacing it
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain how AI might change the way people work in the future and which human skills will still be important?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 人工智能数据收集与隐私
topics.description: 人工智能系统会收集哪些关于你的数据；谁拥有这些数据，以及为什么这很重要；Cookie、网络跟踪、智能音箱一直在收音；你的数据很有价值。
evidence: Name at least three types of personal data that AI systems collect
Explain why personal data is valuable to companies
Describe one step they can take to protect their privacy online
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} understand that apps and websites collect information about what they do online, and could they explain why that matters?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 人工智能系统中的偏见
topics.description: 如果训练数据存在偏见，人工智能也会产生偏见；例子包括人脸识别对某些肤色识别效果更好、翻译会默认某种性别；偏见从何而来，以及我们能否解决它。
evidence: Explain what bias in AI means using a real-world example
Describe how biased training data leads to biased AI results
Suggest one way to reduce bias in an AI system (use more diverse data, test with different groups)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain why an AI trained mostly on photos of light-skinned faces might not work as well for people with darker skin?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 深度伪造与人工智能生成内容
topics.description: 深度伪造、人工智能生成的图片和文本；如何辨别它们以及它们为什么重要；核查信息来源的重要性；网络上的内容并不都是真实的。
evidence: Explain what a deepfake is and give an example of AI-generated content
Describe at least two clues that might reveal an image or text was AI-generated
Explain why it matters that AI can create realistic fake content
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} saw an amazing photo online, would they think to question whether it might have been created by AI rather than captured by a camera?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 设计公平的人工智能规则
topics.description: 将设计思维应用于人工智能伦理：如果你要设计一个人工智能系统，你会给它制定什么规则？它应该帮助谁？哪些事情是不允许它做的？
evidence: Propose at least three rules for a hypothetical AI system they are designing
Explain why AI designers need to think about who might be harmed, not just who benefits
Describe one real example of AI being used responsibly and one where it was not
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} was designing an AI assistant for their school, could they think of rules to make sure it was fair and helpful for everyone?

topics.subject: Computing
topics.name: 人工智能的未来
topics.description: 了解十年后人工智能可能的发展方向与应用场景；探讨人们对人工智能的期待与担忧；认识到儿童是未来人工智能的设计者与决策参与者，建立充满信心、主动参与的正向认知。
evidence: Describe at least two ways AI might be used in the future that don't exist yet
Explain one thing they would want AI to do and one thing they would want it not to do
Describe why it matters that young people understand AI — because they will shape how it is used
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} have a thoughtful conversation about what they'd want AI to do in the future and what they'd be worried about?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 阅读重在理解
topics.description: 要明白阅读的核心是读懂内容含义，可不只是把单词读准就可以哦。如果只会拼读文本内容却完全不懂其中的意思，那不叫真正的阅读哦。
evidence: Simple View of Reading (Gough & Tunmer)
reading comprehension research on comprehension-decoding separation
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} reads something aloud correctly but then can't tell you what it was about, do they recognise that reading means understanding — not just saying the words?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 阅读理解监控
topics.description: 你要留意认读单词和真正读懂内容的区别哦——如果发现自己读完了所有单词，却没弄懂内容讲的是什么，就要主动想办法搞明白~
evidence: comprehension monitoring research
Metacognitive Monitoring in Reading Comprehension (MDPI 2024)
topics.assessmentPrompt: After {{name}} reads a paragraph or listens to an explanation, do they notice when they haven't really understood it — rather than just carrying on as if they had?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 作者的用词选择
topics.description: 认识作者在遣词、文本结构、语气、叙事视角上的刻意安排，会对身为读者的你产生哪些特定影响
evidence: authorial awareness research
Understanding Author's Purpose (Firkins)
collaborative multilayered text interpretation in 5-8 year olds
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a book or article, do they ever notice and comment on why the author chose to write it a certain way — and what effect that has on them as a reader?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 推断含义与字面含义
topics.description: 学会区分文本明确表述的内容，和你自己推断、假设或是脑补出的内容，分清二者的区别是做到对文本真实理解的基础。
evidence: inference vs literal comprehension development research
online inference making and comprehension monitoring (PMC 2021)
topics.assessmentPrompt: After {{name}} reads a story or article, can they tell you which parts they actually read in the text and which parts they worked out or assumed for themselves?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 认识你尚未掌握的知识
topics.description: 主动排查自己的词汇缺口——留意那些你一知半解的单词，分清哪些是你已经熟练掌握的知识、哪些是你没有把握的内容，同时学习解决这类知识不确定性的实用方法
evidence: Noticing Unfamiliar Words Assessment research (grade 2+)
word consciousness and vocabulary metacognition research
Building Word Knowledge e-Book (PMC 2019)
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} comes across a word they half-know — where they can guess the meaning but aren't sure — do they notice that gap and do something about it, like looking it up or asking?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 作文自我评估
topics.description: 评估你自己写的英语作文是否能给读者传递你想要的效果，不要只检查拼写、语法是否正确，还要判断内容是不是真的达到了你预想的表达作用
evidence: writing self-evaluation research grades 3-5
metacognitive awareness of writing (Frontiers 2025)
topics.assessmentPrompt: After {{name}} writes something — a story, a letter, a persuasive piece — do they think about whether it would have the effect they wanted on a reader, not just whether the spelling is right?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 反思你的语言运用
topics.description: 站在语言使用者的角度进行自我反思：你的阅读、写作、口语表达是如何根据沟通对象、表达目的和场景灵活调整的，以及你想要进一步提升的方向
evidence: metalinguistic awareness development
register and audience awareness research
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} notice how they communicate differently in different situations — writing for school versus texting a friend, or speaking in a debate versus chatting at home — and can they explain why those differences matter?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 造句基础
topics.description: 明白单词组合在一起就能构成句子，句子可以表达完整的想法；会在说话和书写时使用完整句子，还能扩充句子让内容更丰富。
evidence: Distinguish between complete sentences and fragments
Compose a complete sentence with a subject and verb
Expand a simple sentence by adding detail
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} says something like "The dog", can they tell you that's not a complete sentence — and add words to make it say something like "The dog ran fast"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 单词间的空格
topics.description: 书写时要用空格隔开不同的单词，明白印刷内容里的空格是用来区分不同单词的标记
evidence: Leave clear finger-spaces between words when writing
Count the number of words in a written sentence by identifying spaces
Correct writing that has missing spaces between words
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is writing a short message, can they leave a space between each word — so the reader can tell where one word ends and the next begins?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 基础名词与动词
topics.description: 能够在口语表达和书写中恰当使用常用名词（指代人、地点、事物的词汇）和动词（表示动作的词汇）
evidence: Use common nouns accurately in sentences (e.g. 'dog', 'school', 'book')
Use action verbs appropriately (e.g. 'run', 'eat', 'play')
Identify nouns and verbs in simple sentences when prompted
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} talks or writes about everyday things — like "the dog runs" or "Mum cooks dinner" — do they use the right kind of words for things (nouns) and actions (verbs) without mixing them up?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 人名、星期与人称代词I的大写规则
topics.description: 专有名词（如人名、地名）、星期类词汇以及人称代词"I"的首字母都需要大写
evidence: Capitalise names of people and places consistently in writing
Write the pronoun 'I' as a capital letter
Capitalise days of the week (e.g. 'Monday')
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is writing their friend's name or the name of a town, do they automatically start it with a capital letter — and do they write the word 'I' with a capital when talking about themselves?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 语法词汇：字母、单词、句子
topics.description: 讨论读写内容时会使用基础语法术语，包括：字母、大写字母、单词、单数、复数、句子、标点、句号、问号、感叹号
evidence: Name punctuation marks correctly when pointed out in text
Use terms like 'capital letter' and 'full stop' when editing writing
Explain what a 'sentence' is using the correct term
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you point to a full stop or a question mark in a book, can {{name}} tell you what it's called and what it's for — and do they know the difference between a word and a sentence?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 用'and'连接词句
topics.description: 使用连词'and（和）'连接单词和从句，造出更长的句子
evidence: Combine two simple sentences using 'and' (e.g. 'I like cats and dogs')
Join two related clauses with 'and' (e.g. 'We went to the park and we played')
Use 'and' in lists of items within a sentence
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is telling you about their day, can they write two ideas joined together with the word 'and' — like "I had lunch and then we played outside"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 介词
topics.description: 理解并使用最常见的地点类、方向类介词，例如：到、从、在……里、在……外、在……上、离开、为了、靠近、和……一起
evidence: Use prepositions correctly in sentences (e.g. 'on the table', 'under the bed')
Follow instructions involving prepositions (e.g. 'Put the book on the shelf')
Describe positions using prepositional phrases
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you ask {{name}} to describe where something is — like where the cup is on the table — can they use little words like "on", "under", "next to", or "by" correctly?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 疑问词
topics.description: 理解并会用疑问词（who：谁、what：什么、where：哪里、when：什么时候、why：为什么、how：如何）来组成问句、回答问题
evidence: Ask questions using appropriate question words
Answer who, what, where, when questions about familiar topics
Recognise that question words signal a question is being asked
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} wants to find out something — like where you put their shoes or why the sky is blue — can they start their question with the right word, like "where" or "why"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 规则复数名词
topics.description: 学习通过在名词后加-s或-es的方式，口头表述、正确书写规则复数名词；理解「复数」的含义是数量大于一
evidence: Say and write correct plural forms (e.g. 'one cat, two cats'; 'one wish, two wishes')
Choose -s or -es correctly based on the ending sound
Explain that plural nouns name more than one
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you point to a picture of one cat and then several cats, can {{name}} tell you the correct word for more than one — and write it with the right ending, like "cats" or "boxes"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 句子的开头与结尾规则
topics.description: 句子开头要大写首字母，结尾使用恰当的标点（句号、问号或感叹号）；能够识别并说出句末标点的名称
evidence: Write sentences beginning with a capital letter
Choose and use the correct end punctuation for statements, questions, and exclamations
Identify and name full stops, question marks, and exclamation marks when reading
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a sentence like "the cat sat on the mat", do they remember to use a capital letter at the start and a full stop at the end — without needing a reminder?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 撇号的用法：缩写与所有格
topics.description: 学习在写作中使用撇号实现两种功能：一是构成缩写（标注被省略的字母），二是表示单数名词的所有格，并且能够区分这两种用法
evidence: Use apostrophes correctly in both 'don't' and 'Sam's bag' within the same piece of writing
Explain the difference between apostrophe for contraction and apostrophe for possession
Correct misplaced or missing apostrophes in a set of sentences
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a word like "don't" or "it's", do they put the apostrophe in the right place — and can they also write something like "the dog's bowl" to show the bowl belongs to the dog?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 列表中的逗号
topics.description: 使用逗号分隔句子里列表中的各项内容（例如：I bought apples, bananas, and oranges，意思是“我买了苹果、香蕉和橙子”）
evidence: Write a sentence containing a list of 3+ items separated by commas: 'I bought apples, bananas, and oranges'
Identify where commas should go in an unpunctuated list sentence
Explain that commas separate items in a list so the reader knows each item
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} writes a sentence listing three or more things — like the items they'd pack for a picnic — do they put commas between each item in the list?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 限定词与冠词
topics.description: 学习在名词前正确使用限定词，包括冠词a/an/the以及指示代词this/that/these/those
evidence: Use 'a' before consonant sounds and 'an' before vowel sounds correctly: 'a ball', 'an apple'
Distinguish 'this/these' (near) from 'that/those' (far) when pointing to objects
Select the correct article (a/an/the) to complete a sentence
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes about something nearby versus something far away, do they use the right word — saying "this book" for one in their hand and "that book" for one across the room?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 扩展名词短语
topics.description: 我们可以用扩展名词短语描述和明确指代的事物，只要在名词前面加上形容词或者其他修饰成分就可以哦，比如示例中的「the blue butterfly（蓝色的蝴蝶）」、「the old, creaky door（老旧的、嘎吱响的门）」
evidence: Expand 'the cat' into 'the fluffy black cat' by adding adjectives
Use noun phrases with two or more modifiers in independent writing
Choose precise adjectives to make a noun phrase more vivid: e.g., 'a tiny, shivering kitten'
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} describes something in writing — like a pet or a toy — do they add extra describing words, such as "the small, fluffy rabbit" rather than just "the rabbit"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 句子的四种类型
topics.description: 理解并运用四种句子类型——陈述句、疑问句、感叹句、祈使句，能够识别语法规律是如何体现句子的作用的
evidence: Write or identify a statement, question, exclamation, and command from a set of sentences
Match each sentence type to its correct end punctuation mark
Transform a statement into a question or command on request
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} spot the difference between a question ("Are you hungry?") and a command ("Eat your dinner!") — and write each type of sentence using the right punctuation at the end?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 语法术语：名词、动词与时态
topics.description: 能够在讨论中理解并使用二年级阶段的语法术语，包含：名词、名词短语、陈述句、疑问句、感叹句、祈使句、复合词、后缀、形容词、副词、动词、时态（过去/现在）、撇号、逗号
evidence: Use the term 'noun phrase' when discussing expanded noun phrases in own writing
Identify adjectives, adverbs, and verbs in sentences using correct terminology
Explain what 'tense' means and give an example of past and present tense
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you ask {{name}} to point out a noun, a verb, or an adjective in a sentence from their reading book, can they find one and explain what it does in the sentence?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 过去时、现在时与进行时
topics.description: 学习正确、连贯地使用动词表达过去时态和现在时态，包括进行时形式（例如：she is drumming 她正在打鼓，he was shouting 他当时正在大喊），理解时态是如何体现时间的
evidence: Write a passage consistently in past tense without switching to present
Use progressive forms correctly: 'was running', 'is jumping' to show ongoing actions
Identify verbs in a sentence and change them from past to present tense or vice versa
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is writing about something that happened yesterday versus something happening right now, do they change the verb — for example, writing "she jumped" for the past and "she is jumping" for right now?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 代词
topics.description: 能正确使用人称代词、物主代词和不定代词（例如：I/me/my 我/我/我的、they/them/their 他们/她们/它们/他们的、anyone/everything 任何人/所有事物），学会用代词替换名词，避免表达重复
evidence: Replace a repeated noun with a pronoun: 'The dog was happy. He wagged his tail.'
Use I/me correctly in subject and object position in a sentence
Choose the correct possessive pronoun (my/his/her/their) to match the noun it replaces
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} retells a story or describes what a friend did, do they use words like "he", "she", "they", or "his" correctly — instead of repeating the person's name every single time?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 主谓一致
topics.description: 造句时要给单数、复数名词搭配对应的动词，保持主谓一致哦（比如：“He hops”（他单脚跳）和“We hop”（我们单脚跳）就是正确的搭配）
evidence: Write 'The dog runs' (singular) and 'The dogs run' (plural) with correct verb agreement
Correct subject-verb agreement errors in sentences: fix 'The children plays' to 'The children play'
Choose the correct verb form to match a singular or plural subject in a gap-fill exercise
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} writes "she hop" or "we hops", do they catch the mistake — and can they fix it to "she hops" and "we hop" so the subject and verb match?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 从属从句
topics.description: 学习使用从属连词（when、if、that、because）和并列连词（or、and、but）连接分句，组成并列句和复合句
evidence: Write 'I stayed inside because it was raining' using a subordinating conjunction
Use 'but' and 'or' to join ideas: 'I wanted to play but it was raining'
Use 'when' and 'if' clauses in writing: 'If it stops raining, we can go outside'
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a story or a message, can they join two ideas with words like "because", "but", "when", or "if" — rather than writing every thought as a short separate sentence?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 形容词与副词辨析
topics.description: 学会正确使用形容词和副词，根据修饰的对象是名词还是动词/形容词来选择对应的词类，例如：「She ran quickly（她跑得很快）」和「She is quick（她动作很快）」
evidence: Choose the correct form: 'The dog is (slow/slowly)' vs 'The dog walks (slow/slowly)'
Identify whether a word is modifying a noun (adjective) or a verb (adverb) in a given sentence
Expand sentences by adding both an adjective and an adverb: 'The tall boy ran quickly'
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} writes "she ran quick" instead of "she ran quickly", can they spot that they need an adverb to describe the running — and fix it themselves?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: a和an的选用
topics.description: 学习正确使用不定冠词：发音以辅音音素开头的单词前用「a」，发音以元音音素开头的单词前用「an」，示例：a rock（一块石头）、an open box（一个开着的盒子）、an hour（一小时）、a unicorn（一只独角兽）
evidence: Choose 'a' or 'an' correctly before nouns beginning with consonant or vowel sounds (e.g., 'a ball', 'an egg', 'an umbrella')
Apply the rule to tricky words where spelling and sound differ (e.g., 'an hour' because /h/ is silent, 'a uniform' because /juː/ starts with a consonant sound)
Correct errors in a/an usage in given sentences (e.g., change 'a orange' to 'an orange')
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes, do they automatically choose "a" before a word that starts with a consonant sound and "an" before a vowel sound — like "a cat" but "an apple" or "an hour"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 时间、地点与原因的表达
topics.description: 学习使用连词（when、before、after、while、so、because）、副词（then、next、soon、therefore）和介词（before、after、during、in、because of），在单句内或句与句之间表达时间、地点和原因
evidence: Use time conjunctions to connect clauses (e.g., 'We went inside because it was raining', 'After the bell rang, we lined up')
Use adverbs of time and cause within sentences (e.g., 'First, she opened the door. Then, she stepped outside. Therefore, she got wet.')
Use prepositions of time and cause in phrases (e.g., 'during the lesson', 'before lunch', 'because of the rain')
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a story, do they use time words like "after", "while", or "soon" to show the order things happened — rather than starting every sentence with "then"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 语法术语：分句与连词
topics.description: 在讨论读写内容时，能准确理解和运用三年级要求掌握的语法术语，包括：介词、连词、词族、前缀、分句、从句、直接引语、辅音字母、元音字母、引号
evidence: Use the terms 'clause' and 'subordinate clause' to identify parts of a multi-clause sentence (e.g., point to the subordinate clause in 'I stayed inside because it rained')
Use the terms 'conjunction', 'preposition', and 'prefix' correctly when explaining word/sentence choices in own writing
Distinguish between consonant letters and vowel letters and use the terms 'direct speech' and 'inverted commas' when discussing punctuation
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you ask {{name}} to find a "subordinate clause" or a "preposition" in a sentence from their book, can they point one out and explain what it means?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 不规则动词过去式
topics.description: 能正确变形并使用常用不规则动词的过去式（例如sat、hid、told、went、came、ran），明白这类动词不遵循常规加-ed的变化规则
evidence: Supply the correct past tense of common irregular verbs: go→went, see→saw, run→ran, tell→told
Correct over-regularised forms in writing (e.g. change 'goed' to 'went', 'hided' to 'hid')
Write a short recount using at least five irregular past-tense verbs accurately
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes about something that happened in the past with an irregular verb — like "run" or "sit" — do they write "ran" and "sat" rather than "runned" and "sitted"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 不规则复数名词
topics.description: 除了规则变化的复数名词外，你还要学会构造和使用不规则复数名词（比如children（孩子们）、teeth（牙齿）、mice（老鼠）、geese（鹅）），要知道有些名词的复数形式是不规则的，不能直接在词尾加-s或者-es哦
evidence: Form and use irregular plural nouns correctly (e.g. child→children, tooth→teeth, mouse→mice, goose→geese)
Identify collective nouns that name a group (e.g. 'a flock of birds', 'a group of children', 'a pack of wolves')
Correct over-regularised plurals in writing (e.g. change 'mouses' to 'mice', 'foots' to 'feet')
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you point to a picture of several mice or a group of children, can {{name}} write the correct plural — knowing it's "mice" not "mouses" and "children" not "childs"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 巧用代词清晰表达
topics.description: 学习选用合适的代词让表达清晰连贯，避免表意模糊和用词重复，同时能正确使用反身代词（例如：我自己、我们自己、他自己）
evidence: Replace repeated nouns with pronouns to improve cohesion: rewrite 'Sam picked up Sam's bag' as 'Sam picked up his bag'
Use reflexive pronouns correctly in sentences (e.g. 'I made it myself', 'They helped themselves')
Identify and fix ambiguous pronoun references (e.g. 'Tom told Jack he was late' — who was late?)
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a paragraph about two people — like two characters in a story — do they use "he", "she", and "they" clearly enough that you always know who is being talked about?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 直接引语的标点用法
topics.description: 学习使用引号（也叫说话标记）为直接引语添加标点，理解直接引语记录的是他人所说的原话，必须用标点将这些原话内容括起来。
evidence: Place inverted commas around the spoken words in a sentence (e.g., "Let's go!" shouted Tom.)
Write a sentence containing direct speech with correct punctuation including a reporting clause (e.g., Mum said, "Time for bed.")
Identify direct speech in a text and explain what the inverted commas show
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes down something a character said in a story, do they put speech marks around the exact words — like "Come here," she called — and use the correct punctuation inside?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 现在完成时
topics.description: 学习动词的现在完成时用法，对比它和一般过去时的差异，理解现在完成时用于描述发生时间不明确、或是和当下仍有关联的已完成动作，例如「He has gone out（他已经出门了）」和「He went out（他出门了）」的用法区别
evidence: Form the present perfect using 'has/have' + past participle (e.g., 'She has eaten', 'They have finished')
Choose between simple past and present perfect to match the intended meaning (e.g., 'I ate lunch' vs 'I have eaten lunch')
Identify the present perfect form in a text and explain why the author used it instead of simple past
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} explain the difference between "I ate breakfast" (simple past) and "I have eaten breakfast" (present perfect) — knowing one means a finished action and the other links the past to right now?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 抽象名词
topics.description: 理解并会运用抽象名词，这类名词指代的是无法通过感官（看、听、闻、尝、摸）感知的想法、品质、状态类概念
evidence: Sort words like 'freedom', 'table', 'courage', 'pencil', 'childhood' into abstract and concrete noun categories
Complete sentences using appropriate abstract nouns: 'Her _____ (brave → bravery) inspired the whole team'
Write three sentences each containing a different abstract noun (e.g. 'honesty', 'friendship', 'happiness')
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write a sentence using an abstract word like "kindness", "freedom", or "happiness" — knowing these are nouns even though you can't touch or see them?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 句子一致性
topics.description: 掌握单句内部及句与句之间的主谓一致、代词与先行词一致规则
evidence: Correct 'The group of children were laughing' to 'The group of children was laughing' and explain the singular subject
Choose the correct pronoun in 'Each student must bring ____ (his or her / their) book' and explain the antecedent link
Identify and fix three agreement errors in a short paragraph, explaining each correction
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} writes "Each of the players have their own locker", can they spot the error and fix it to "has their own locker" — making sure the verb matches the subject?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 比较级与最高级
topics.description: 学习构成并使用形容词、副词的比较级和最高级，能够正确区分并选用合适的形式
evidence: Form comparatives and superlatives for 'big' (bigger/biggest), 'beautiful' (more/most beautiful), and 'good' (better/best)
Choose the correct form in 'She runs _____ (faster/more fast) than her brother' and explain the rule
Write sentences using both a comparative adverb ('more carefully') and a superlative adjective ('tallest') correctly
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is comparing three things — like three books they've read — can they correctly say one is "good", another is "better", and the best one is "the best"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 扩展名词短语（8岁及以上适用）
topics.description: 借助修饰性形容词、名词和介词短语对名词短语进行扩展，为表述补充更多细节
evidence: Expand 'the teacher' to 'the strict maths teacher with curly hair' using adjective, noun, and preposition phrase
Write a sentence containing a noun phrase with at least three modifiers, e.g. 'the old stone bridge over the river'
Identify the head noun and its modifiers in 'the tiny grey kitten under the table'
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} describes something in a piece of writing, do they build up a rich description — like "the tall man with the grey coat" rather than just "the man"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 前置状语与逗号
topics.description: 学习使用前置状语丰富句子开头形式，掌握前置状语后的逗号使用规则
evidence: Write a sentence beginning with a time adverbial, e.g. 'Later that day, the children ran home'
Rewrite 'The fox crept through the garden at midnight' with the adverbial fronted and a comma placed correctly
Identify and correct a missing comma after a fronted adverbial in 'Before breakfast she packed her bag'
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a story or a report, do they sometimes start a sentence with a phrase like "After lunch," or "Quietly, the fox moved closer," — and put a comma after that opening phrase?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 语法术语：代词与限定词
topics.description: 掌握并运用四年级要求的语法术语，包括限定词、代词、物主代词和状语
evidence: Label the determiner, pronoun, and adverbial in 'She quickly opened her present on the table'
Explain the difference between a possessive pronoun ('mine', 'theirs') and other pronouns ('I', 'they')
Use the terms 'determiner' and 'adverbial' accurately when discussing a classmate's writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you ask {{name}} to find a "determiner" or a "possessive pronoun" in a sentence, can they point one out and explain what job it does?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 名词的复数与所有格辨析
topics.description: 学会区分名词的复数后缀-s和所有格后缀-'s的不同用法
evidence: Sort words like 'dogs', 'dog's', and 'dogs'' into plural, singular possessive, and plural possessive categories
Explain why 'the cats bowl' is incorrect and supply the correct form ('the cat's bowl' or 'the cats' bowl') for a given meaning
Write two sentences using the same noun — one as a plural and one as a possessive
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} tell the difference between "the girls' coats" (belonging to many girls) and "the girls are coming" (just a plural) — and write each one correctly without mixing up the apostrophe?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 一般过去时、一般现在时和一般将来时
topics.description: 写作时能够正确构造并连贯使用一般过去时、一般现在时和一般将来时三种动词时态，保持全文时态统一
evidence: Rewrite 'I walk to school' in past tense ('I walked') and future tense ('I will walk')
Identify and correct inconsistent tense in 'Yesterday she walks to the shop and bought milk'
Write a three-sentence paragraph maintaining consistent future tense throughout
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes about something that happened yesterday, something happening now, and something that will happen tomorrow, do they change the verb correctly for each time — like "I walked", "I walk", and "I will walk"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 标准英语动词
topics.description: 学习使用标准英语的动词变形，替换不规范的地域性动词表达
evidence: Correct 'we was playing' to 'we were playing' and explain why the standard form is needed in writing
Choose the standard form in pairs such as 'I did / I done', 'she has / she have', 'they were / they was'
Rewrite a short passage replacing three non-standard verb forms with their Standard English equivalents
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sometimes says "we was" or "they done it" in conversation, do they know to write "we were" and "they did it" in their schoolwork — using standard written English?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 句子中的形容词排序
topics.description: 学习按照英语通用规则排列句子中的形容词，常规排序逻辑为：观点→大小→年龄/新旧→形状→颜色→来源/产地→材质→用途，让描述读起来更自然通顺
evidence: Arrange multiple adjectives before a noun in conventional order, e.g. 'a lovely little old rectangular green French silver whittling knife' simplified to classroom examples like 'a small red bag' not 'a red small bag'
Identify when adjective order sounds unnatural and rearrange to match English conventions, e.g. correct 'the wooden big table' to 'the big wooden table'
Apply the size-before-colour-before-material pattern in descriptive writing, e.g. 'a tall grey stone castle' rather than 'a stone grey tall castle'
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} uses several describing words together — like "a tiny old wooden box" — does the order sound natural, or do they mix up the adjectives so it sounds odd?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 用于插入语的括号和破折号
topics.description: 学习使用括号、破折号和逗号标注插入语：插入语是加入句子中的补充信息，就算删掉这部分内容，也不会改变句子的核心含义
evidence: Insert a parenthetical phrase using paired brackets, e.g. 'The oldest building (built in 1642) stands in the town square'
Use paired dashes to add an aside or extra detail within a sentence, e.g. 'My brother — who is older than me — lives in London'
Choose between brackets, dashes, and commas for parenthesis based on how much emphasis the aside should receive, recognising that dashes give most prominence and brackets give least
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} adds a little extra detail inside a sentence — like "The teacher, who is very strict, gave us homework" — do they correctly use brackets, dashes, or commas around that added bit?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 段落内部衔接
topics.description: 学习在段落中使用各类衔接手段，包括代词、状语（如首先、然后、在那之后）以及同义词，串联不同句子，让整段的思路表达连贯流畅
evidence: Replace repeated nouns with pronouns or synonyms to maintain cohesion without ambiguity, e.g. 'The explorer found a cave. She examined it carefully'
Use adverbials of sequence (firstly, then, next, finally) and cause (therefore, as a result, consequently) to connect ideas within a paragraph
Identify where cohesion breaks down in a paragraph and insert appropriate linking devices to improve the flow
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a paragraph, do the sentences flow together smoothly — using words like "however", "after this", or "in contrast" to link ideas, rather than every sentence starting with "And then"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 并列连接词前的逗号用法
topics.description: 在并列复合句中，用并列连词（and、but、or、so、yet）连接两个独立分句时，需要在并列连词前面加上逗号
evidence: Place a comma before the coordinating conjunction in a compound sentence, e.g. 'I wanted to go outside, but it was raining'
Distinguish compound sentences (two independent clauses) from simple sentences with compound predicates, e.g. 'She sang and danced' needs no comma but 'She sang a song, and he played the piano' does
Edit writing to insert missing commas before coordinating conjunctions in compound sentences
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} joins two complete thoughts with a word like "but" or "so" — like "I wanted to go, but it was raining" — do they put a comma before that joining word?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 用逗号避免歧义
topics.description: 在缺少逗号可能造成误读的句子中，使用逗号明确句意，避免产生歧义
evidence: Insert a comma to prevent ambiguity, e.g. 'Let's eat, Grandma' vs 'Let's eat Grandma' or 'Most of the time, travellers worry about their bags'
Identify sentences where a missing comma changes the meaning and explain the two possible readings
Use commas after introductory elements (adverbial phrases, subordinate clauses) to prevent misreading of the main clause
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} explain why "Let's eat, Grandma" and "Let's eat Grandma" mean very different things — and use that kind of comma in their own writing to avoid confusion?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 名词、形容词转换为动词
topics.description: 学习通过添加-ate、-ise（也作-ize）、-ify三类后缀，将名词、形容词转换为动词，同时理解词类变化对句子结构的影响
evidence: Add -ate, -ise, or -ify to nouns or adjectives to form verbs, e.g. pollen → pollinate, advert → advertise, simple → simplify
Choose the correct verb-forming suffix for a given root and use the resulting verb in a sentence, e.g. 'They needed to classify the animals' from 'class'
Identify the word-class change when a suffix converts a noun or adjective into a verb and explain how this affects the sentence structure
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} take a word like "active" or "sharp" and turn it into a verb by adding a suffix — knowing that "activate" and "sharpen" are the verb forms?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 扩展名词短语（9岁+适用）
topics.description: 学习构造并使用介词短语（即「介词+名词短语」结构），为句子补充时间、地点、方向类的细节，同时能够识别介词短语在句中是充当形容词性短语还是副词性短语
evidence: Identify the preposition and noun phrase within a prepositional phrase, e.g. in 'under the old bridge', 'under' is the preposition and 'the old bridge' is the noun phrase
Add prepositional phrases to expand sentences with detail about where, when, or how, e.g. 'The cat slept' → 'The cat slept on the warm windowsill throughout the afternoon'
Distinguish prepositional phrases functioning as adjectives (modifying nouns: 'the house on the hill') from those functioning as adverbs (modifying verbs: 'she ran across the field')
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes directions or descriptions of a place — like "behind the old tree" or "near the top of the hill" — do they use prepositional phrases naturally to show where or when something is?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 修正残缺句与连写句
topics.description: 学会识别并修改两类错误句子：一类是残缺句，也就是缺少主语或谓语的不完整句子；另一类是连写句，也就是没有使用正确标点或连词，就把两个及以上可以独立成句的分句拼接在一起的错误句子
evidence: Identify a sentence fragment by checking whether it has both a subject and a predicate, e.g. recognise 'Running through the park' as a fragment and correct to 'The dog was running through the park'

Identify a run-on sentence where two independent clauses are fused without punctuation or a conjunction, e.g. 'I like cats I also like dogs' and correct using a full stop, comma + conjunction, or semicolon
Edit a paragraph to fix fragments and run-ons, choosing the most effective correction strategy for each error
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}}'s writing has a sentence like "Running down the street." or two ideas jammed together without any punctuation, can they spot that something's wrong and fix it?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 语法术语：情态动词与从句
topics.description: 在讨论读写相关内容时，能准确掌握并使用五年级要求的语法术语：情态动词、关系代词、关系从句、插入语、括号、破折号、衔接、歧义。
evidence: Label a relative clause in a sentence and identify the relative pronoun that introduces it, using correct terminology
Explain why a pair of brackets or dashes creates a parenthesis and describe its function using the term 'parenthesis'
Use the terms 'modal verb', 'cohesion', and 'ambiguity' when discussing how a writer has achieved particular effects in a text
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you ask {{name}} what a "modal verb" or a "relative clause" is, can they give you a clear explanation and point to an example in a sentence?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 用状语衔接段落
topics.description: 你可以使用时间状语（比如稍后、与此同时、过了一会儿）、地点状语（比如在附近、在远处、墙的另一边）、列举类状语（比如第二、最后、除此之外）衔接不同段落的观点，引导读者顺畅读懂多段落文本。
evidence: Begin a new paragraph with an adverbial of time to signal a shift in time or sequence, e.g. 'Meanwhile, back at the castle...' or 'Several hours later, the storm finally passed'
Use adverbials of place to move the reader to a new location between paragraphs, e.g. 'Beyond the forest, the land was flat and dry'
Use numbering or addition adverbials to structure non-fiction across paragraphs, e.g. 'The first reason... The second reason... In addition...'
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a multi-paragraph story or report, do they use linking phrases — like "Meanwhile, far away…" or "By the following morning…" — to guide the reader smoothly from one section to the next?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 情态动词与可能性
topics.description: 理解并运用情态动词（can、may、must、might、shall、will、could、should、would）和情态副词（perhaps、surely、certainly），来表达不同程度的可能性、必要性以及许可含义
evidence: Select a modal verb to express certainty, probability, or possibility in a sentence, e.g. 'It will rain' vs 'It might rain' vs 'It could rain'
Replace a modal verb with a modal adverb to achieve a similar effect, e.g. 'He might come' → 'Perhaps he will come'
Distinguish between modals expressing permission (may, can), obligation (must, should), and possibility (might, could) in context
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes, do they choose between words like "must", "might", "could", and "should" to show whether something is certain, possible, or just an idea — rather than treating every action as definite?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 进行时态
topics.description: 掌握动词进行时态的构成与用法，包含过去进行时（例：was walking 当时正在走路）、现在进行时（例：am walking 正在走路）、将来进行时（例：will be walking 届时正在走路），能够用这三类时态表述不同时间节点上正在持续进行的动作。
evidence: Write sentences using past progressive to describe an action that was ongoing at a particular time, e.g. 'She was reading when the phone rang'
Distinguish present progressive from simple present, e.g. 'I am eating lunch' (right now) vs 'I eat lunch at noon' (habitual)
Form the future progressive using 'will be' + present participle to describe an action that will be ongoing, e.g. 'Tomorrow at 3pm I will be travelling'
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} wants to describe an action that was happening over a period of time in the past — like "I was reading when the phone rang" — can they write the verb in the right ongoing-past form?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 定语从句
topics.description: 学习构造并使用由关系代词（who、whose、whom、which、that）和关系副词（where、when、why）引导的定语从句，用于补充细节、修饰名词，写出内容更丰富的复合句
evidence: Combine a main clause with a relative clause using 'who' or 'which' to add information about a noun, e.g. 'The dog, which had a red collar, barked loudly'
Choose the correct relative pronoun (who for people, which for things, where for places, when for times) and identify the noun it refers back to
Recognise that a relative clause beginning with 'that' can often replace 'who' or 'which' in defining clauses, e.g. 'The book that I read' vs 'The book which I read'
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes to add detail about a noun — like describing a friend "who loves football" or a place "where we always go on holiday" — do they build that into the same sentence using a relative clause?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 动词前缀及其含义
topics.description: 学会使用dis-、de-、mis-、over-、re-这几类动词前缀改变动词词义，理解每种前缀如何修饰词根动词所表达的动作
evidence: Add verb prefixes to change meaning, e.g. dis- (disagree, disappear), de- (decompose, defrost), mis- (misunderstand, misbehave), over- (overlook, overreact), re- (redo, reconsider)
Select the appropriate verb prefix to express a specific meaning shift such as negation (dis-/mis-), reversal (de-/un-), repetition (re-), or excess (over-)
Distinguish verb prefixes from noun/adjective prefixes and explain how adding a prefix to a verb changes the action described
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you give {{name}} a verb like "appear" and ask them to use a prefix to change its meaning, can they produce words like "disappear", "reappear", or "misrepresent" and explain what the prefix does?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 主动语态和被动语态
topics.description: 学习使用被动语态将表达重点从动作发出者转移到动作本身或动作承受者，理解被动结构在正式、客观的写作中会如何影响信息的呈现效果
evidence: Convert active sentences to passive voice and explain the change in emphasis
Identify passive constructions in news reports and scientific writing
Choose between active and passive voice based on purpose and audience
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} wants to write about something without saying who did it — like in a science report — can they switch the sentence round to say "The experiment was carried out" instead of "We carried out the experiment"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 项目符号标点用法
topics.description: 学会统一规范项目符号的标点用法，清晰罗列信息，掌握所有列表项的首字母大写、句尾标点以及平行结构的使用规则
evidence: Create bullet point lists with consistent capitalisation and punctuation throughout
Use full stops for bullet points that are complete sentences and no punctuation for fragments
Maintain parallel grammatical structure across all items in a bulleted list
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} uses bullet points to list information — like in a school project — are all the bullets punctuated the same way, with matching capitalisation and consistent end punctuation?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 选择合适时态精准表意
topics.description: 学会运用动词时态传递不同的时间、事件顺序、状态和条件，有意识地选用恰当的时态，准确表达动作、事件的具体发生时间和性质
evidence: Write a paragraph using multiple tenses to show the sequence of past, present, and future events
Choose between simple, progressive, and perfect tenses to express duration or completion
Explain why a specific tense is appropriate for expressing a condition or hypothetical situation
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a story that jumps between past events and present thoughts, do they shift verb tenses deliberately and accurately — so the reader always knows exactly when each event is happening?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 列表中的冒号与分号用法
topics.description: 使用冒号引出列表，使用分号分隔列表中的各个条目，尤其当列表条目内部包含逗号或是复杂短语时需遵循该规则
evidence: Introduce a list with a colon after an independent clause such as 'You will need the following items:'
Use semi-colons to separate list items that contain commas such as locations with city and country
Punctuate complex lists in formal writing maintaining clarity and consistency
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a list of things that are themselves quite long or contain commas — like a list of ingredients with measurements — do they use a colon to introduce it and semi-colons to separate the items?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 句首引导成分后的逗号规则
topics.description: 我们需要用逗号把句首的引导成分和句子其余部分分开，引导成分包括放在句首的单词、短语和从句
evidence: Place commas after introductory adverbs such as 'However' or 'Therefore' at the start of sentences
Use commas after introductory prepositional phrases like 'In the morning' or 'After the game'
Punctuate introductory dependent clauses correctly such as 'When the bell rang, we left'
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} begins a sentence with a phrase or clause — like "Despite the rain," or "If you look closely," — do they put a comma after that opening part before the main sentence begins?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: yes、no与人名相关的逗号用法
topics.description: 本知识点讲解逗号的三类使用规则：用来分隔句首的yes、no应答词，分隔反义疑问句的附加疑问部分，以及在直接称呼他人时隔开称呼语
evidence: Write sentences using commas with yes and no at the beginning such as 'Yes, I understand'
Punctuate tag questions correctly such as 'It's cold today, isn't it?'
Use commas to set off names in direct address such as 'Sarah, please pass the salt'
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes dialogue or a letter and addresses someone by name — like "Yes, Mum, I did tidy my room" — do they use commas correctly around the name and around words like "yes" or "no"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 连词、介词和感叹词
topics.description: 讲解连词、介词和感叹词的通用作用，以及它们在具体句子中的功能，让孩子理解每类词对句意表达起到的作用
evidence: Identify conjunctions, prepositions, and interjections in sentences and explain their function
Explain how removing a preposition or conjunction changes the meaning of a sentence
Use interjections appropriately to convey emotion in dialogue or informal writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you ask {{name}} what the word "although" or "ouch!" does in a sentence, can they explain one is a conjunction that joins ideas and the other is an interjection that expresses feeling?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 动词时态一致
topics.description: 能够识别并纠正单句内部、句与句之间以及段落中不恰当的动词时态切换，除非语义要求切换时态，否则需要保持时态统一
evidence: Identify and correct unnecessary tense shifts in a given paragraph
Edit own writing to ensure consistent tense use throughout a narrative
Explain when a tense shift is appropriate such as when describing a flashback
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you read back a paragraph {{name}} has written and it unexpectedly switches from past tense to present tense mid-way through, can they spot the shift and correct it so the tense stays consistent?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 关联连词
topics.description: 学习在句子中正确使用关联连词，掌握「要么/要么」「既不/也不」「既/又」「不仅/而且」「是/还是」这类成对搭配的关联连词用法
evidence: Write sentences using each pair of correlative conjunctions correctly
Ensure parallel structure when using correlative conjunctions in complex sentences
Identify and correct errors in correlative conjunction usage in given sentences
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} wants to say that two things are equally true — like "both cats and dogs make good pets" — do they know to use "both…and" together, rather than just "and" on its own?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 语法术语：语态与标点
topics.description: 准确掌握并运用小学六年级语法术语：主语、宾语、主动语态、被动语态、同义词、反义词、省略、连字符、冒号、分号、项目符号
evidence: Define and give examples of subject and object in sentences
Explain the difference between active and passive voice using correct terminology
Use terms such as ellipsis, colon, and semi-colon accurately when discussing punctuation choices
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you ask {{name}} to find the "subject" and "object" in a sentence, or to explain what a "semi-colon" or "ellipsis" does, can they give you a confident and accurate answer?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 带前缀单词的连字符用法
topics.description: 学习使用连字符消除复合修饰语、带前缀单词中的歧义，区分连字符放置位置不同带来的词义差异
evidence: Distinguish between 'man eating shark' and 'man-eating shark' by adding or removing hyphens
Use hyphens with prefixes to clarify meaning such as 'recover' versus 're-cover'
Apply hyphens correctly in compound adjectives before nouns such as 'well-known author'
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} explain why "a man-eating shark" and "a man eating shark" mean completely different things — and use a hyphen correctly in their own writing to avoid that kind of confusion?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 段落衔接
topics.description: 运用丰富多样的衔接手段串联不同段落的观点，包括词汇复现、状语类语法连接以及省略法，从而创作出逻辑连贯的长篇文本
evidence: Use adverbials such as 'on the other hand' and 'as a consequence' to connect paragraphs
Apply ellipsis to avoid repetition while maintaining clarity across sentences
Create cohesion by repeating key words or using synonyms to link ideas between paragraphs
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a long piece across several paragraphs, do the sections feel connected — with repeated key words, linking phrases, and occasional gaps (ellipsis) used deliberately to hold the whole text together?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 分句的标点用法
topics.description: 学习使用分号、冒号和破折号划分独立分句之间的界限，能够根据分句之间的逻辑关系选用合适的标点符号
evidence: Join two related independent clauses using a semi-colon in place of a conjunction
Use a colon to introduce an explanation or elaboration of the first clause
Replace commas with dashes to create stronger pauses between clauses for emphasis
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes two closely related sentences, can they join them with a semi-colon or colon — like "It was late; the streets were empty" — rather than always using a full stop or "and"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 作品标题的标点使用规则
topics.description: 学习使用下划线、引号或斜体来标注作品标题，掌握书籍、故事、诗歌、歌曲、文章等不同类型作品的标题标注惯例
evidence: Use italics or underlining for titles of books, films, and albums
Use quotation marks for titles of short works such as poems, songs, and articles
Apply title formatting conventions consistently in a piece of writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} refers to a book title or a film name in their writing, do they know to put it in inverted commas or italics — like writing *Charlotte's Web* or "Charlotte's Web" — rather than just leaving it as plain text?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 虚拟语气
topics.description: 在正式写作和正式口语场景中使用虚拟语气，可以表达愿望、要求、建议，或是描述假设的情况，常见用例有：'If I were you（如果我是你）'、'I suggest that he go（我建议他去）'、'Were they to arrive（假如他们要抵达）'
evidence: Write sentences using 'If I were' to express hypothetical conditions
Transform informal sentences into formal equivalents using subjunctive forms such as 'I recommend that she attend'
Identify subjunctive mood in formal texts such as legal documents or formal letters
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a formal letter or a persuasive essay, can they use phrases like "If I were in charge…" or "The school suggests that every pupil attend…" to sound more formal and precise?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 句式多样化
topics.description: 你可以通过嵌入从句、使用同位语、调整句子长度等技巧，对句子进行拓展、合并或精简，让句意更清晰、内容更吸引读者、表达风格更丰富哦
evidence: Combine two simple sentences into one complex sentence using subordination
Expand a simple sentence by adding descriptive phrases and clauses
Reduce wordy sentences by removing redundant words while preserving meaning
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} revises their writing, can they take a very long sentence and split it up, or take three short choppy sentences and combine them into one — choosing the version that reads best for the audience?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 高阶标点用法：提升表达清晰度
topics.description: 你将学会自信且准确地运用标点，增强表达效果、提升内容清晰度，具体包括：用分号连接关联分句，用冒号引出列表或解释说明，用破折号和括号插入补充信息，用省略号表示内容省略或营造悬念，用逗号分隔并列形容词和非限制性修饰成分。
evidence: Use a semicolon to link two closely related independent clauses without a conjunction
Set off a nonrestrictive clause with commas and explain why the commas are needed
Use a colon to introduce an explanation or elaboration, and a dash for a dramatic aside
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a complex piece — like an essay or a detailed story — do they use advanced punctuation like semi-colons, colons, dashes, and ellipses confidently and accurately to shape meaning and style?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 语法的表达效果
topics.description: 分析阅读文本中各类语法特征的作用与影响，理解作者如何有意选择不同的语法形式（如句子长度、被动语态、前置状语、列举法），为读者带来特定的阅读感受
evidence: Explain how an author's use of short, simple sentences creates tension or urgency in a passage
Analyse why an author uses a list of three (tricolon) in a persuasive text and evaluate its impact
Identify a grammatical choice in a text (e.g., present tense for immediacy) and explain the effect on the reader
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a piece of writing they admire, can they point to specific grammatical choices the author made — like very short sentences for tension, or a list of three for rhythm — and explain why those choices work?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 文学与语言术语
topics.description: 能够准确、熟练运用语言学及文学术语讨论阅读、写作和口语相关内容，涉及的术语包括词类、句子类型、从句类型、文学手法以及语篇层面特征的相关专业表述
evidence: Use terms like 'subordinate clause', 'relative pronoun', 'metaphor', 'alliteration' accurately in discussion
Explain the difference between a simile and a metaphor using correct terminology
Use metalanguage (e.g., 'the author employs enjambment to...') confidently when writing about texts
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} discusses a book or piece of writing with a teacher, do they use precise language — like "the author uses a compound-complex sentence here" or "that's a non-restrictive relative clause" — rather than just saying "this bit is good"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 短语与从句
topics.description: 理解并分析不同类型的短语（名词短语、动词短语、形容词短语、副词短语、介词短语）和从句（主句、从属从句、定语从句）在一般语境及具体句子中的功能，包括识别并修正错位修饰语和悬垂修饰语
evidence: Identify a prepositional phrase acting as an adverbial and explain its role in the sentence
Distinguish between a main clause and a subordinate clause and explain their relationship
Spot a dangling modifier in a sentence and rewrite it to remove the ambiguity
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} reads a sentence like "Walking home from school, the rain soaked her backpack" and something feels grammatically off, can they identify the dangling modifier and explain how to rewrite it correctly?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 标准英语
topics.description: 了解并理解口语和书面语的差异，包括正式程度、语域、语法、词汇层面的区别，同时掌握标准英语与其他英语变体的不同，能在写作和口语表达中自信运用标准英语
evidence: Explain three differences between how we speak informally and how we write formally (e.g., contractions, slang, sentence completeness)
Identify features of Standard English and explain why it is used in formal contexts
Rewrite an informal spoken passage (e.g., a text message) in formal written Standard English
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} understand that the way they speak with friends is different from how they should write in school — and can they adjust their language for formal situations, using standard grammar and vocabulary?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 句子的类型
topics.description: 能够合理选用并构造简单句、并列句、复合句、并列复合句，清晰体现观点之间的不同逻辑关系，有意识地变换句式，让表达更准确、更富趣味性、更具风格。
evidence: Combine short sentences into a complex sentence using a subordinating conjunction for effect
Rewrite a passage of monotonous simple sentences using a mix of sentence types for variety and flow
Identify the sentence type (simple, compound, complex, compound-complex) of given examples and explain the effect of each
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is writing for effect — like building tension in a story or structuring an argument — do they deliberately vary their sentence types, mixing short punchy sentences with longer, more complex ones?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 动词语态和语气
topics.description: 理解并有意识地使用主动语态和被动语态，识别不同的动词语气（陈述语气、祈使语气、虚拟语气、条件语气）及其作用，能够根据写作目的和受众选择合适的语态与语气。
evidence: Rewrite an active sentence in the passive voice and explain when the passive is more appropriate
Identify the subjunctive mood in a formal text (e.g., 'If I were...', 'It is essential that he be...')
Explain why a scientific report typically uses passive voice while a personal narrative uses active
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a formal report or analysis, can they choose between active and passive voice deliberately — for example, using passive voice in a science write-up to sound objective and impersonal?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 坐姿与握笔
topics.description: 端正坐在桌前，舒适且正确地握笔；按正确笔顺书写小写字母，起笔和收笔位置准确
evidence: Hold a pencil with a comfortable tripod or near-tripod grip
Write all 26 lowercase letters with correct starting points and direction
Maintain consistent letter size on lined paper
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} sits down to write, do they hold their pencil comfortably and form each letter the right way — starting from the right place and going in the right direction?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 大写字母规范书写
topics.description: 正确书写大写字母，可清晰写出大量大小写字母
evidence: Write all 26 capital letters with correct formation
Distinguish between uppercase and lowercase forms in own writing
Use appropriate sizing so capitals are taller than lowercase letters
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write all the capital letters clearly and legibly so that someone reading their work can easily tell which letter is which?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 字母书写家族
topics.description: 根据相似的书写笔顺规律，认识不同字母分别属于哪个书写家族，分组练习字母书写
evidence: Group letters by similar strokes (e.g. c, a, d, g, o family — all start with a curve)
Explain why certain letters are practised together
Form letters within the same family consistently using the shared movement pattern
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} understand that certain letters are formed in similar ways — for example, "c," "a," "d," and "g" all start with the same curved stroke — and practise those families together?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 书写数字0-9
topics.description: 正确、清晰地书写0到9的数字
evidence: Write all digits 0-9 clearly with correct starting points
Form digits the appropriate size relative to letter height
Write numbers legibly so they can be read by others
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes numbers like 3, 5, and 7, are they formed the right way and clearly readable — not reversed or written in an unusual direction?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 字母连写
topics.description: 学习使用斜向和横向笔画连写字母，了解哪些字母组合适合分开书写，掌握字母之间的正确相对大小
evidence: Join 'in', 'un', 'it' with a diagonal stroke connecting the letters
Leave letters like 'b' unjoined when followed by certain letters, explaining why
Write with consistent letter sizing on lined paper, ascenders and descenders in proportion
topics.assessmentPrompt: Is {{name}} starting to join up their letters when writing, so that their handwriting flows more smoothly rather than each letter standing completely separate?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 音素拼合识词
topics.description: 运用自然拼读知识，将包含已学音形对应规则的生词中的音素拼合起来认读；看到40余个音素对应的字母或字母组合能快速反应对应发音
evidence: Sound out and blend unfamiliar phonically regular words (e.g. /sh/-/o/-/p/ → 'shop')
Read words containing taught GPCs without excessive sounding out
Distinguish between similarly spelled words by identifying differing letter sounds (e.g. 'big' vs 'bag')
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} comes across a word they haven't seen before, can they sound it out bit by bit and blend the parts together to read it — even if it takes a moment?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 辅音字母组合
topics.description: 认读并拼写含有辅音字母组合及少见辅音拼写形式的单词，涉及的拼写形式包括：ch、sh、th、ck、tch、ng、ph、wh、发/k/音的字母k
evidence: Read words with consonant digraphs (e.g. 'shop', 'chip', 'that')
Identify the sound made by ph (/f/) and wh (/w/) in words
Spell words ending in -ck (e.g. 'duck') and -tch (e.g. 'match')
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} sees words like 'shop', 'chip', 'ring', or 'photo', can they spot that two letters together make one sound and read the whole word correctly?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 认识所有字母
topics.description: 能够识别并读出字母表中所有大小写字母的名称，按顺序背诵字母，还能运用字母名称区分不同的拼写选择
evidence: Name all 26 letters in both cases when shown in random order
Recite the alphabet from A to Z
Use letter names to explain spelling choices (e.g. 'Is it c or k in cat?')
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} point to any letter — capital or small — and tell you its name? And can they say the alphabet in order from A to Z?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 首音与韵组
topics.description: 能够拼接和拆分单音节单词的首音与韵组；辨认并读出辅音-元音-辅音（CVC）结构单词中的每个独立音素（首音、中音、尾音）；通过添加或替换音素组成新单词
evidence: Blend onset and rime to say a word (e.g. /c/ + /at/ → 'cat')
Identify the first, middle, or last sound in a CVC word
Change one sound to make a new word (e.g. change /c/ in 'cat' to /b/ → 'bat')
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you slowly say the sounds '/d/ /o/ /g/', can {{name}} blend them together and say 'dog'? And if you say 'cat', can they tell you the three separate sounds: /k/ /a/ /t/?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 押韵词
topics.description: 识别并说出押韵词；跟读故事、诗歌中重复出现的固定短语和韵句；学习欣赏并背诵诗歌
evidence: Identify which words rhyme from a set (e.g. cat, bat, dog)
Generate a word that rhymes with a given target
Join in with repeated refrains and rhyming patterns during shared reading
topics.assessmentPrompt: When you read a rhyming book to {{name}}, do they join in and predict the rhyming words — and can they come up with their own rhyme for a simple word like 'cat'?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 单字母发音
topics.description: 掌握每个辅音的主要发音，以及五大元音的长音、短音发音，能够快速对单字母字形对应的发音做出反应
evidence: Say the most common sound for each consonant when shown the letter
Distinguish short vowel sounds in CVC words (e.g. /a/ in 'cat' vs /e/ in 'bed')
Associate long and short vowel sounds with common single-letter spellings
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} look at a letter and quickly say its sound — like 's' makes /s/, 'a' can make a short /a/ as in 'apple' or a long /ā/ as in 'cake'?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 认识印刷品
topics.description: 能够理解印刷文字承载着实际含义，阅读遵循从左到右、从上到下的顺序，书本的内容是按页码逐页编排的
evidence: Track words with a finger moving left to right across the page
Turn pages in the correct sequence when handling a book
Point to where reading starts on a page
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} looks at a page in a picture book, do they know to start at the top-left and follow the words left to right, then move down to the next line?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 元音字母组合
topics.description: 认读并拼写包含常见元音字母组合（ai、ay、ee、ea、oa、oe、oo、oi、oy）的单词，了解部分元音字母组合可对应多种发音的规则
evidence: Read words with vowel digraphs (e.g. 'tree', 'boat', 'rain', 'coin')
Distinguish between different sounds for the same digraph (e.g. 'oo' in 'book' vs 'moon')
Spell words using common vowel digraph patterns
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a word like 'rain', 'boat', or 'moon', can they recognise the vowel pair that makes a special sound and read the whole word correctly?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 合成词
topics.description: 通过识别构成合成词的两个独立单词，认读并拼写合成词
evidence: Identify the two words in a compound (e.g. 'sunshine' = 'sun' + 'shine')
Spell compound words by combining known words
Create compound words from given word pairs
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} look at a word like 'sunshine' or 'football' and spot the two smaller words hiding inside it?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 双元音与复合元音
topics.description: 能够认读、拼写含有双元音、复合元音组合（ow、ou、ew、ue、ie、aw、au）以及末尾-y作元音发音的单词
evidence: Read words with variable vowel sounds (e.g. 'ow' in 'cow' vs 'snow')
Decode words with diphthongs (e.g. 'cloud', 'blue', 'pie')
Read words ending in -y pronounced as /ee/ or /igh/ (e.g. 'happy', 'my')
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} read words like 'town', 'cloud', 'flew', 'claw', or 'pie' — spotting the special vowel combinations and saying the right sound for each one?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: r控制元音发音
topics.description: 学习认读和拼写包含r控制元音（ar、er、ir、ur、or、ore）的单词，掌握这类元音+r组合中r会改变原有元音发音的规则
evidence: Read words with r-controlled vowels (e.g. 'car', 'bird', 'fork', 'her')
Recognise that 'r' changes the vowel sound (e.g. 'cat' vs 'cart')
Spell words with common r-controlled patterns
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads words like 'car', 'bird', 'nurse', or 'fork', can they recognise that the 'r' after the vowel changes its sound, and read the word correctly?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 认读缩合词
topics.description: 认读并理解带撇号的缩合词，明白撇号代表被省略的字母
evidence: Read common contractions in text (e.g. 'I'm', 'we'll', 'don't')
Match contractions to their expanded forms (e.g. 'I'm' = 'I am')
Explain that the apostrophe shows where letters are missing
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} understand that 'can't' means 'cannot' and 'it's' means 'it is' — knowing the apostrophe stands for the missing letter or letters?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 流畅朗读
topics.description: 准确大声朗读匹配自身自然拼读能力的读物，逐步提升朗读流畅度；反复诵读熟悉的文本，建立自信心、提高朗读速度、增强表达感染力
evidence: Read a phonically appropriate text with 90%+ accuracy
Reread familiar texts with improved pace and expression
Read emergent-reader texts with purpose and understanding
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a book aloud at their level, can they get through most words without stumbling — sounding less like they're decoding and more like they're telling a story?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 视觉认读高频词
topics.description: 无需拼读，看到就能自动读出常见的高频词和例外词，包含拼写规则不规则的单词
evidence: Read common exception words instantly without sounding out (e.g. 'the', 'said', 'was', 'you')
Note unusual correspondences between spelling and sound in exception words
Recognise at least 20-30 high-frequency words in connected text
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} instantly recognise everyday words like 'said', 'was', 'they', 'come', and 'because' without needing to sound them out every time?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 带屈折词尾的单词认读
topics.description: 认读符合已学字素音素对应规则、带有常见屈折词尾（-s、-es、-ing、-ed、-er、-est）以及带前缀un-的单词，同时能认读符合已学拼读规律的多音节单词
evidence: Read suffixed words fluently (e.g. 'jumping', 'wanted', 'faster')
Identify the root word when a suffix is added
Read words with prefix un- (e.g. 'unhappy', 'undo')
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} sees familiar words with different endings — like 'jumped', 'running', 'biggest', or 'unhappy' — can they spot the root word and read the whole thing correctly?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 拆分元音组合与魔法E
topics.description: 认读并拼写包含拆分元音组合（a-e、e-e、i-e、o-e、u-e）的单词，这类单词末尾的「e」不发音，会让它前面的元音发长音。
evidence: Read words with split digraphs (e.g. 'cake', 'bike', 'home', 'cube')
Compare minimal pairs showing the effect of the split digraph (e.g. 'cap' vs 'cape')
Spell words with split digraphs correctly
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} know that the 'e' at the end of words like 'cake', 'bike', or 'home' changes the vowel sound in the middle — making it say its name instead of its short sound?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 音节
topics.description: 学习对口语单词中的音节进行计数、拼合与拆分，掌握将书面单词拆分为音节的方法，辅助提升阅读和拼写能力
evidence: Clap out syllables in spoken words (e.g. 'butterfly' = 3 claps)
Blend syllables to form words (e.g. 'rain' + 'bow' → 'rainbow')
Segment a word into its syllable parts orally
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} clap out the syllables in words — two claps for 'pen-cil' or three for 'com-pu-ter' — and split a spoken word into its parts?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 三字母音组
topics.description: 认读并拼写含有三字母音组的单词。三字母音组指的是三个字母组合在一起仅对应单个发音的字母组，常见组合包括igh、air、ear、are
evidence: Read words with trigraphs (e.g. 'night', 'chair', 'near')
Distinguish between different sounds for 'ear' (e.g. 'hear' vs 'bear')
Identify the single phoneme represented by three letters in a word
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} recognise three-letter combinations like 'igh' in 'night', 'air' in 'chair', and 'ear' in 'hear' — knowing that all three letters together make just one sound?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 已学发音的多种拼写形式
topics.description: 认识已学发音对应的其他音形对应规则（例如/dʒ/音可写作ge、dge、g，/s/音可写作c，/n/音可写作kn、gn，/r/音可写作wr，/ʒ/音可写作s），能够认读由熟悉发音的少见拼写构成的单词
evidence: Read words with less common spellings for familiar sounds: 'badge', 'giraffe', 'city', 'knock', 'gnaw', 'write', 'treasure'
Identify that the same phoneme can be represented by different graphemes (e.g., /dʒ/ spelled g, ge, dge)
Select the correct alternative GPC to decode an unfamiliar word in context
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} know that the /j/ sound can be spelled different ways — like in 'jump', 'cage', and 'bridge' — and can they read words with these less common spellings?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 准确且有感情地朗读
topics.description: 准确、语速得当、富有感情（有韵律感）地大声朗读，通过反复朗读熟悉的文本提升朗读流畅度、建立自信心，还能结合上下文自行纠正读错的内容。
evidence: Read a grade-level passage aloud with expression and appropriate pacing
Self-correct miscues during oral reading by re-reading or using context cues
Re-read a familiar book demonstrating increased fluency and confidence
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a story aloud, do they vary their voice to match the mood — pausing at punctuation, slowing for sad parts, speeding up for excitement?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 音节划分（6岁以上）
topics.description: 将两个或更多音节的单词拆分成音节块，利用每个音节必须包含一个元音发音的知识，再把各部分拼合起来认读单词
evidence: Read 'rabbit', 'thunder', 'fantastic' by breaking into syllable chunks and blending
Clap or tap syllables in a multi-syllable word, then read each chunk before blending
Identify that every syllable must contain a vowel sound
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} encounters a long word like 'fantastic' or 'umbrella', can they break it into syllables and blend the parts together to read the whole word?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 解码陌生单词
topics.description: 认读三至四年级拼写与发音不对应的特殊单词，运用逐渐增长的词法和词源学知识来解码陌生的特殊词
evidence: Read exception words from the Y3-4 statutory word list accurately (e.g. 'business', 'caught', 'knowledge', 'different')
Identify unusual letter-sound correspondences in exception words and explain why the word does not follow common GPC rules
Use growing knowledge of morphology and etymology to attempt unfamiliar exception words (e.g. recognise the root 'know' in 'knowledge')
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} read trickier exception words — like 'ordinary', 'promise', 'recent', or 'island' — without being thrown off by the parts that don't follow the usual spelling rules?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 前缀和后缀
topics.description: 认读三至四年级课程中含常见前缀和后缀的单词，运用词根、前缀和后缀的知识（词法与词源学）来朗读和理解新单词
evidence: Read words with common prefixes (dis-, mis-, re-, pre-) and suffixes (-ation, -ous, -ly) by identifying the root word first
Apply morphological knowledge to attempt unfamiliar words (e.g. recognise 'happy' inside 'unhappiness')
Explain how a prefix or suffix changes the meaning or word class of a root word (e.g. 'care' → 'careless' → 'carelessly')
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} sees a word like 'disappear' or 'comfortable', can they spot the root word and figure out what the prefix or suffix is adding to its meaning?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 预测故事情节发展
topics.description: 根据已读内容预测故事接下来可能发生什么；讨论标题和事件的意义
evidence: Make a prediction before turning the page and explain reasoning
Discuss why a title fits or hints at the story content
Revise predictions as new information is encountered in the text
topics.assessmentPrompt: When you stop midway through a story, can {{name}} make a reasonable guess about what might happen next — and explain why they think so based on what's happened so far?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 图书结构与作者意图
topics.description: 识别图书的封面、封底和扉页；识别作者在说明文中为支撑观点所给出的理由
evidence: Point to and name parts of a book (front cover, back cover, title page)
Use the title page to find the title, author, and illustrator
Identify a reason the author gives for a claim in a simple non-fiction text
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} find the contents page or index in a non-fiction book and use it to locate specific information — and do they understand why the author included those features?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 人物、场景与事件
topics.description: 识别故事中的人物、场景和主要事件；熟悉重要故事、童话和传统故事，并能按顺序复述关键细节
evidence: Name the main characters in a story
Describe where and when a story takes place
Retell a familiar story including beginning, middle, and end events
topics.assessmentPrompt: After reading a fairy tale or story together, can {{name}} retell it to you in order — saying who was in it, where it happened, and what the main events were?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 跨故事人物比较
topics.description: 比较和对照熟悉故事中人物的冒险经历；找出同一主题下两篇文章的异同点
evidence: Identify what two stories have in common (e.g. 'Both have a bear character')
Compare information from two books about the same topic
Discuss how characters' experiences are similar or different across stories
