Use a thesaurus to find synonyms and select the most precise word for a given context, e.g. choosing 'sprinted' rather than 'ran' to convey speed
Replace overused words in writing with more precise synonyms and explain how the substitution changes the tone or emphasis
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is writing, can they swap out a basic word for a more precise one — for example, replacing "happy" with "elated" or "said" with "whispered" — to make their meaning clearer?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 跨学科领域词汇
topics.description: 学习并准确运用与本年级学习主题相关的通用学术词汇和学科专属词汇，包括各学科说明类文本中表达精准含义的词汇。
evidence: Identify and define academic vocabulary (e.g., compare, contrast, summarise, evidence, interpret) used across multiple subject areas and use these words accurately in discussion and writing
Determine the meaning of domain-specific words encountered in science, social studies, or maths texts (e.g., ecosystem, democracy, numerator) using context, glossaries, and prior knowledge
Use newly acquired academic and domain-specific vocabulary in sentences that demonstrate understanding of precise meaning and appropriate context
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is studying a topic in science or history, do they pick up and correctly use the specific vocabulary for that subject — like "erosion," "parliament," or "habitat"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 借助希腊语、拉丁语词根理解词义
topics.description: 运用希腊语、拉丁语词缀（前缀、后缀）及词根的相关知识作为线索，推断陌生单词的词义，积累常用词根及其对应含义
evidence: Identify common Greek and Latin roots in unfamiliar words and use root meaning to infer word meaning, e.g. 'aqua' (water) in aquarium/aquatic, 'dict' (say) in predict/dictionary
Break a multi-morpheme word into prefix + root + suffix to determine meaning, e.g. un- (not) + believe + -able = not able to be believed
Use knowledge of Greek-origin prefixes (auto-, tele-, micro-) and Latin-origin prefixes (inter-, trans-, sub-) to decode and define unfamiliar vocabulary in context
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} comes across an unfamiliar word containing a Greek or Latin root they recognise — like "port" in "transport" or "bio" in "biology" — can they use that to work out the meaning?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 习语与谚语
topics.description: 认识并理解常见习语（如“break the ice”，意为打破僵局；“hit the nail on the head”，意为一针见血）、格言（如“actions speak louder than words”，意为事实胜于雄辩）与谚语（如“a stitch in time saves nine”，意为小洞不补，大洞吃苦），理解这些固定表达的比喻含义与适用场景。
evidence: Explain the figurative meaning of common idioms encountered in texts, e.g. 'let the cat out of the bag' means to reveal a secret, not literally releasing a cat
Interpret the meaning and intended lesson of adages and proverbs, e.g. explain that 'the early bird catches the worm' advises that acting promptly gives an advantage
Use context clues to determine the meaning of an unfamiliar idiom or proverb encountered during reading and verify using a reference source
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} hears a saying like "don't judge a book by its cover" or "the early bird catches the worm," do they know what it really means and when you'd use it?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 明喻与暗喻
topics.description: 理解并识别文本中的明喻（借助“like”或“as”打比方的比喻修辞）和暗喻（直接将一个事物表述为另一个事物的比喻修辞），能解释这两种修辞如何营造画面感、传递含义
evidence: Identify similes in a text by locating comparisons using 'like' or 'as' and explain what two things are being compared and what quality is highlighted, e.g. 'The snow was like a white blanket'
Identify metaphors in a text and explain the implied comparison, e.g. in 'Time is a thief', explain that time is compared to a thief because it takes things away
Explain how a simile or metaphor in a poem or story creates a particular image or feeling for the reader that a literal description would not achieve
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a description like "the moon was a silver coin" or "her smile was like sunshine," can they explain what image the author was trying to create?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 选择正式词汇
topics.description: 能够区分正式词汇与非正式词汇，选出适合正式演讲、写作场景的词汇，例如表达「发现」含义时，用正式词汇「discover（发现）」替代非正式表达「find out（弄清楚）」；表达「请求」含义时，用正式词汇「request（请求）」替代非正式表达「ask for（请求）」
evidence: Replace informal words with formal equivalents in a given text
Identify formal vocabulary choices in official letters and reports
Write the same message twice using formal vocabulary for a letter and informal vocabulary for a text message
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is writing something formal — like a letter or a report — do they choose more sophisticated words, like "enquire" instead of "ask" or "sufficient" instead of "enough"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 方言与语域
topics.description: 对比故事、戏剧、诗歌中出现的各类英语表达形式（包括方言和语域），理解语言会随使用地区、语境和表达目的的不同而发生变化
evidence: Identify dialect features in character dialogue and explain their effect
Compare formal and informal registers in different types of texts
Explain how an author uses language variety to develop character or setting
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a story with characters who speak in dialect or old-fashioned language, can they understand it and explain how it differs from the way we speak today?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 使用同义词词典选词
topics.description: 使用同义词词典查找同义词，拓展词汇选择范围，结合上下文、词语的情感倾向与语体特点选出最恰当的用词。
evidence: Use a thesaurus to find three alternatives for overused words in own writing
Select the most appropriate synonym from thesaurus options based on context and tone
Explain why one synonym is more suitable than another for a specific sentence
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is writing and wants a better word than the one they first thought of, can they use a thesaurus and pick the right synonym for the context — not just any word that means something similar?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 学术词汇
topics.description: 准确习得并使用丰富的通用学术词汇与学科专属词汇——从阅读、听力材料中积累新词汇，并有意识地在写作和口语表达中运用，以达成特定表达效果。
evidence: Use academic vocabulary (e.g., analyse, evaluate, justify, convey, imply) accurately and appropriately in essay writing
Incorporate domain-specific terms from a subject studied (e.g., 'photosynthesis', 'legislature') into explanatory writing
Draw a new word or phrase from a text read and use it consciously in own writing or speech
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} pick up new words from books and lessons and actually use them in their own writing and conversation — not just understand them when someone else uses them?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 高级修辞性语言
topics.description: 理解并解读修辞性语言、词语关系与词义的细微差别，涵盖典故、反语、双关语、矛盾修饰法、扩展隐喻等修辞类型；在分析或选用词语时，能够区分词语的字面意义与隐含意义。
evidence: Explain the connotative difference between words with similar denotations (e.g., thrifty vs. stingy vs. economical)
Identify irony or an allusion in a text and explain what it adds to the meaning
Analyse an extended metaphor across a paragraph or poem and explain how it develops an idea
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} reads a poem or novel and the author uses irony, a pun, or an unexpected comparison, can they explain what effect it creates and why the author chose those words?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 词汇策略
topics.description: 运用多种灵活策略判断生词、多义词及短语的含义，可使用的策略包括借助上下文线索、利用希腊语与拉丁语的词缀和词根、查阅参考资料，以及验证自己推测出的词义
evidence: Use context clues (the overall meaning of a sentence, a word’s position or function) to infer the meaning of an unfamiliar word
Break down a word using known Greek or Latin roots and affixes to deduce its meaning (e.g., 'malevolent' = mal- (bad) + volent (wishing))
Look up a word in a dictionary to verify or refine an inferred meaning
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} encounters an unfamiliar word in a book or article, can they work out its meaning using context clues, word roots, or a dictionary — and then check whether their guess was right?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 回应写作反馈
topics.description: 在老师的引导下，大声重读自己的习作，检查读起来是否通顺；认真倾听并回应老师或小伙伴提出的问题与建议，以此补充细节、厘清意思、提升习作质量——这是写作自我评价的支架式启蒙阶段，并非需要孩子独立掌握的技能。
evidence: Reread own writing and spot a missing word or unclear sentence
Add a detail in response to a question (e.g. 'Can you tell me more about...?')
Make at least one improvement to a piece based on feedback
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}}'s teacher asks them to read their own writing aloud and then asks "does that bit make sense?", can {{name}} listen to the feedback and make a simple change to improve it?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 写句子前先口头说句子
topics.description: 大声说出自己准备书写的内容，动笔写下来之前先口头组织句子，为独立写作做准备。
evidence: Say a complete sentence aloud before attempting to write it
Rehearse a sentence orally more than once to hold it in memory
Practise sentences with a partner before writing independently
topics.assessmentPrompt: Before {{name}} starts writing a sentence, do they say it out loud first — testing how it sounds — before putting pen to paper?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 集体探究项目
topics.description: 参与集体探究与写作项目；既可以回忆自身经历中的相关信息，也可以从各种渠道收集信息，以此解答问题。
evidence: Contribute ideas and information to a class writing project
Draw or write facts learned from personal experience about a topic
Help gather information from books or adults for a group research task
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is given a writing project that involves finding out about something — like an animal or a place — can they look up information and use what they find to write about the topic?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 分享与发布自己的写作作品
topics.description: 大声清晰地朗读自己的写作作品，让同学和老师都能听清；使用数字工具创作并发布写作作品
evidence: Read own sentences aloud with clear voice and appropriate expression
Share a piece of writing by reading it to the class
Type simple words or sentences using a computer or tablet
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} read their own writing aloud to the class clearly enough for everyone to hear and follow along — and have they ever typed or published a piece of writing using a computer or tablet?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 有开头和结尾的简单小故事
topics.description: 通过给句子排序、按事情发展的先后顺序描述事件，撰写简单的叙事小故事；叙述单个事件或互相关联的多个事件时，需包含开头、中间经过，以及结尾或个人心情感受
evidence: Write a short story with at least three sequenced sentences
Use time words like 'first', 'then', 'next' to order events
Include a reaction or ending to a narrative (e.g. 'I felt happy')
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write a short story about something that happened — with a clear beginning, middle, and end — so that someone who wasn't there could follow what happened and in what order?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 观点写作
topics.description: 可以借助绘画、口述或动笔书写的方式完成观点类小创作，需明确点明对应的主题或书籍，并说明自己对它的喜好或看法。
evidence: State an opinion clearly (e.g. 'My favourite animal is a dog because...')
Give at least one reason for an opinion
Draw, dictate, or write to express a preference about a book or topic
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write a sentence or two giving their opinion about something — like their favourite book or food — and explain why they feel that way?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 写作过程常用词汇
topics.description: 认识并会使用写作过程中的相关词汇，包括撰写、构思、打草稿、内容修订、语言润色、校对、文体、目标读者、写作目的、故事叙事、经历复述、操作说明、段落、写作顺序、细节；同时要明白，这些词汇对应的是所有写作者都会经历的不同步骤、都会做出的不同选择，而不只是需要逐项打勾完成的任务。
evidence: Use 'compose', 'revise', and 'edit' correctly when describing the stages of writing
Explain who the 'audience' is for a piece of writing and how that changes what they write
Describe the purpose of a piece of writing (to persuade, inform, entertain, or instruct) and match their language to it
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you asked {{name}} to explain what they're doing when they write a story at school, could they walk you through each step using words like 'plan', 'draft', and 'revise' — showing they understand it's a process, not just one sitting?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 信息类写作
topics.description: 可通过绘画、口述或书写的方式创作信息类、说明类作品，需明确点明主题，并提供若干与主题相关的信息
evidence: Write or dictate two or three facts about a familiar topic
Label diagrams or drawings with informative details
Name a topic and provide relevant details about it
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write a few sentences explaining something they know about — like how butterflies grow or how to make a sandwich — naming the topic and sharing some facts?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 基础信息类写作
topics.description: 能够撰写信息介绍类或解释说明类短文，明确介绍写作主题，运用事实与定义展开内容要点，且包含总结性语句或结尾部分。
evidence: Write an informative text that introduces a topic clearly and groups related information together
Use facts, definitions, and concrete details to develop and explain points about the topic
Provide a concluding statement or section that wraps up the information presented
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write an explanatory or informative piece — like "How Volcanoes Work" — that introduces the topic clearly, develops it with facts and definitions, and ends with a conclusion?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 培养写作耐力
topics.description: 围绕真实事件、出于不同表达目的写作，锻炼长时间持续写作的耐力，尝试记叙文以外的多种文体，例如经历记述、书信、操作指引等。
evidence: Write a recount of a school trip using temporal connectives (first, then, after that)
Write a simple set of instructions with numbered steps
Sustain writing for an extended period across a full page without stopping
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write in different styles for different purposes — for example, writing a recount of a school trip, a letter to a friend, or a set of instructions for a game?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 写作前构思
topics.description: 写作前提前做好规划：可以大声说出或是记下将要写的内容，写下想到的点子和关键词，动笔写作文前先把想法逐句捋顺组织好
evidence: Verbally rehearse sentences before writing them down
Jot key words or ideas in a planning format (e.g., story map) before drafting
Write a simple plan with beginning, middle, and end for a story
topics.assessmentPrompt: Before {{name}} starts a piece of writing, do they spend a few minutes planning — jotting down ideas, key words, or a rough structure — rather than jumping straight into writing the first sentence?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 修改与校对
topics.description: 校对自己的习作，检查拼写、语法和标点符号错误；在老师或同伴的帮助下评估并修改习作，反复重读确保意思清晰、时态一致。
evidence: Re-read own writing and spot a missing full stop or capital letter
Identify and correct a tense inconsistency in a piece of writing
Discuss improvements with a partner and make at least one revision to strengthen the writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} finishes a piece of writing, do they proofread it for spelling mistakes, missing punctuation, and errors in grammar — and make corrections before handing it in?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 结构化观点写作
topics.description: 撰写观点类短文，需引入写作话题、清晰表明自身观点，运用连接词衔接条理分明的支撑理由，且短文包含总结性语句或结尾部分
evidence: Write an opinion piece that introduces the topic, states a clear opinion, and provides at least two reasons
Use linking words (because, and, also, for example) to connect the opinion to supporting reasons
End an opinion piece with a concluding statement that restates or reinforces the opinion
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write a persuasive piece — like arguing for a longer lunch break or why dogs are better pets than cats — with a clear viewpoint, organised reasons, and a conclusion?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 学写诗歌
topics.description: 尝试创作诗歌，探索语言、押韵和节奏的规律；背诵诗歌，学习用恰当的语调朗诵
evidence: Write a simple poem using rhyming couplets or a repeated pattern
Recite a poem from memory with expression and appropriate intonation
Identify rhyme and rhythm patterns in poems read aloud
topics.assessmentPrompt: Has {{name}} tried writing a poem — playing with rhyme, rhythm, or repeating patterns — and can they recite one they've learned or written with expression?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 记叙文写作
topics.description: 写出场景具体、人物丰满、情节完整的记叙文，能运用对话和描写丰富故事内容，展现人物面对不同情境的反应
evidence: Write a narrative that includes a described setting, at least one developed character, and a clear plot with a problem and resolution
Use dialogue to show what characters say and reveal their personality or feelings
Use descriptive details and temporal words to organise events into a clear sequence with a satisfying ending
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a story, do they bring it to life with descriptions of the setting, details about the characters, and some dialogue — rather than just listing what happened?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 作文段落组织
topics.description: 学会将作文内容组织为段落，把围绕同一主题的相关内容归为一组；在非叙事类写作中使用标题、小标题这类简单的内容组织方法。
evidence: Divide a piece of writing into paragraphs, each focused on one main idea or aspect of the topic
Use headings and sub-headings to organise a non-fiction text (e.g., a report about animals with sections 'Habitat', 'Diet', 'Appearance')
Identify where a new paragraph should begin in a given text and explain why (e.g., 'A new paragraph starts here because the topic changes from appearance to diet')
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a longer piece — like a report or a story — do they organise it into paragraphs, with related ideas grouped together and, where appropriate, headings to help the reader navigate?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 句子演练与句式变换
topics.description: 动笔写作前先口头构思、演练句子，逐步积累丰富多样的词汇，掌握越来越多的句式结构，其中包括对话句式。
evidence: Rehearse a sentence containing dialogue aloud before writing it (e.g. 'Let's go!' shouted Tom)
Orally compose sentences with varied openers (e.g. time adverbials, subordinate clauses) before writing
Try out two or three different ways to express the same idea orally and choose the most effective version to write
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} try out a sentence aloud before writing it — experimenting with different words and structures to find the version that sounds best?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 作文修改与校对（7岁及以上适用）
topics.description: 针对小学三至四年级难度的写作内容，通过评估表达效果、提出语法与词汇调整建议以保障行文一致性、校对拼写、语法及标点错误三个环节，开展作文评价与修改工作。
evidence: Read own or a peer's writing aloud and suggest specific improvements to vocabulary or sentence structure
Propose changes to grammar and word choice to improve clarity and consistency across a piece of writing
Proof-read writing at Y3-4 level for spelling, punctuation, and grammatical errors and correct them independently
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} revisits a draft piece of writing, can they improve it — changing word choices to be more precise, fixing inconsistent tenses, and correcting spelling and punctuation errors?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 修改与润色（8岁及以上）
topics.description: 能够独立以审视的态度回看自己的写作内容，找出表意不清、用词可优化或是可能令读者困惑的地方；无需教师提示，自主判断内容的优劣并完成修改。
evidence: Reread a paragraph silently and independently identify at least one place where meaning could be clearer or a word choice improved
Make a revision that goes beyond spelling/punctuation — changing a sentence for clarity or effect
Explain in their own words why they changed something ('I thought the reader wouldn't understand what I meant')
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} read back something they've written — a story, a report, a letter — and spot a part that isn't quite right or could be better, all by themselves without you or a teacher pointing it out?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 小型研究项目
topics.description: 开展小型研究项目，积累某一主题的相关知识，从纸质资料和电子资料中搜集信息，并记录简洁有条理的笔记
evidence: Generate three research questions about an assigned topic and identify two sources for each
Take brief notes from a print source, sorting key facts into provided categories
Write a short summary paragraph synthesising information gathered from two different sources
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is given a research project at school, can they look up information from books or websites, take organised notes, and then write it up in their own words?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 生动词汇选择
topics.description: 选择精准生动的词汇和短语，在写作中营造特定的表达效果
evidence: Replace vague words in 'The nice man went to the big house' with more precise alternatives and explain the effect
Write two versions of the same scene — one with plain language and one with carefully chosen words for suspense or humour
Select from a word bank the most effective verb and adjective for a given sentence, justifying each choice
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes descriptive or creative pieces, do they choose interesting and precise words — like "sprinted" instead of "ran", or "crimson" instead of "red" — to create a specific effect?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 写作技法词汇
topics.description: 认识并能运用与写作技法、表达效果相关的专用词汇，具体包括体裁、结构、语域、语气、作者口吻、连贯性、衔接性、论点、论据、叙事视角、修辞、写作手法、正式、非正式、语言风格；同时要明白，这些词汇所描述的是写作者为了给读者带来特定感受、达到想要的表达效果，特意做出的写作选择。
evidence: Explain the difference between 'formal register' and 'informal register' and give an example of when each is appropriate
Use terms like 'coherence', 'cohesion', and 'paragraph structure' accurately when discussing or improving their own writing
Identify the 'purpose', 'audience', and 'form' of a piece of writing and explain how these shape the language choices
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is writing a persuasive letter compared to a story, can they explain the difference in 'tone' and 'register' — and why they'd make different word choices for each one?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 根据目标读者选择写作体裁与语气
topics.description: 动笔写作前先明确目标读者和写作目的，选择与目标读者、表达目标相匹配的恰当体裁、语气和语体风格
evidence: Determine the audience (e.g., peers, teacher, younger children, a public audience) and purpose (to persuade, inform, entertain, or explain) before drafting and explain how these choices affect language and structure
Select an appropriate form for the writing task (letter, report, story, instructions, review) based on audience and purpose
Adjust vocabulary, sentence length, and level of formality to suit the identified audience, e.g. using simpler language for younger readers and more formal language for an official letter
topics.assessmentPrompt: Before {{name}} starts a piece of writing, do they think about who will read it and why — adjusting their tone, vocabulary, and format accordingly, like writing more formally for a teacher than for a friend?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 基于证据的写作
topics.description: 写作时能运用对应年级的非虚构类文本阅读标准，从信息类文本中提取证据，支撑自己的分析、思考与探究
evidence: Write a research-based paragraph or short report that cites specific facts, details, and evidence from informational texts to support key points
Synthesise information from two informational sources into a written summary that accurately represents both, noting areas of agreement and difference
Paraphrase information from informational texts accurately and cite sources appropriately, avoiding plagiarism
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a non-fiction piece — like a report on climate change — do they draw on specific facts and evidence from things they've read, weaving that information into their own writing?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 写作中的文学证据
topics.description: 运用对应年级的文学类文本阅读标准，从文学作品中提取证据，为写作中的分析、思考与探究内容提供支撑
evidence: Write a response to a literary text that includes direct quotations and specific details from the text as evidence to support a claim or observation
Explain how a character's actions or dialogue reveal their traits or motivations, citing specific passages from the story as evidence
Compare how two literary texts treat a similar theme, using textual evidence from both to support the comparison
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes about a book they've read — like an essay about a character or a theme — do they support their ideas with specific quotes or details drawn directly from the text?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 面向读者写作
topics.description: 写出清晰连贯的作文，内容展开和结构安排要符合写作任务、写作目的与目标读者的特点，全文始终保持统一的风格和结构。
evidence: Identify the task, purpose, and audience before writing and make deliberate choices about structure, tone, and vocabulary to suit them
Organise ideas logically so that the writing flows from introduction through development to conclusion, with each section serving a clear purpose
Review a draft to check that the organisation, style, and level of formality are consistent and appropriate for the intended reader
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes for school, does the piece feel well-organised and appropriate for its purpose — whether it's a formal essay, a creative story, or a persuasive argument — with a consistent tone throughout?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 信息类写作中的排版与格式
topics.description: 学会运用标题、小标题、分栏、项目符号、表格等排版手段搭建文章结构，帮助读者顺畅读懂信息类、说明类文章的内容
evidence: Organise an informational text using headings and sub-headings to separate sections
Present comparative information using a table with clear row and column headers
Use columns and bullet points to display information in a scannable format
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a non-fiction piece — like a guide or an explanation — do they use layout features like headings, bullet points, and columns to help the reader navigate the information easily?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 记叙文写作构思
topics.description: 在规划记叙文写作时，可以参考作者塑造人物、搭建故事场景的方法，借鉴自己从读过、听过或是看过表演的文本中观察到的写作技巧。
evidence: Identify specific authorial techniques for character development from a mentor text
Plan a character using techniques such as showing through action borrowed from a studied author
Analyse how an author builds setting and apply similar techniques in planning own narrative
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is about to write a story, do they think ahead about what their main character is like and where the story will take place before they start writing?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 资料搜集与笔记记录
topics.description: 从纸质及数字资源中搜集相关信息，在笔记和完成的作文中对信息进行总结或转述，并能列出基础参考书目或资料来源清单
evidence: Take organised notes from multiple sources using own words rather than copying
Create a bibliography listing sources used in a research project
Paraphrase key information from a source without changing the meaning
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is researching a topic for a school project, can they find information from books or websites, put it in their own words, and keep track of where they got it from?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 概要写作
topics.description: 对篇幅较长的文章做概要缩编，用简洁的语言提炼核心观点与关键信息，保留原文核心意思，删去非必要细节。
evidence: Reduce a three-paragraph text to a single paragraph capturing all main points
Identify and remove redundant information while preserving essential meaning
Write a precis that is no more than one-third the length of the original text
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} reads a long article about a topic they're studying, can they write a short summary in their own words that captures the key points without copying sentences?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 整篇作文的衔接与过渡
topics.description: 学会运用丰富多样的过渡语、衔接手段和段落衔接方法，让整篇作文逻辑连贯；需掌握的内容包括时间过渡词、因果连接词，以及标示论点、时间或场景转换的写作技巧。
evidence: Use a range of causal and logical connectives (consequently, nevertheless, as a result) appropriately across a discursive essay
Signal a shift in time or setting within a narrative using a transitional phrase or paragraph break
Link paragraphs using a cohesive device such as a topic sentence that refers back to the previous paragraph
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes several paragraphs, do they use linking phrases like "however," "as a result," or "on the other hand" to connect ideas smoothly between sections?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 进阶信息性与说明性写作
topics.description: 能够撰写信息性、说明性文本，围绕主题展开探究、清晰传递观点：借助标题与排版有条理地组织信息，运用相关事实、定义、细节及引述丰富主题内容，且用词精准规范。
evidence: Organise an explanatory essay with a clear introduction, logical body paragraphs, and a conclusion
Develop a topic using well-chosen facts, definitions, concrete details, and quotations from sources
Use domain-specific vocabulary and formatting (headings, graphics) to aid the reader's comprehension
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write a clear explanation of how something works — like how a volcano erupts or how bread is made — so that someone who's never learned about it would understand?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 说服性写作
topics.description: 撰写议论文，依托清晰的理由与相关论据支撑个人观点，核心要求包括：引入核心观点、承认反方观点、逻辑清晰地组织理由、保持正式写作风格，并给出总结性陈述。
evidence: Write an argument essay with a clear claim supported by at least three pieces of evidence
Acknowledge and respond to a counterclaim rather than ignoring opposing views
Use linking words and phrases (however, furthermore, consequently) to connect claims, reasons, and evidence
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} wants to convince you to let them stay up later, can they write down clear reasons and examples to support their case rather than just saying "because I want to"?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 作文构思、修改与校订
topics.description: 对作文进行构思、修改与校订，能够提升文章的连贯性与表达效果：过程中要考虑作文是否贴合目标读者、是否达成写作目的，灵活调整词汇、语法及篇章结构，同时通过校对确保拼写、标点与语法使用准确。
evidence: Revise a draft to improve paragraph structure, adding or removing material for coherence
Edit sentence-level issues including word choice, grammar, and punctuation before finalising
Reflect on whether the writing achieves its intended effect on the target audience and adjust accordingly
topics.assessmentPrompt: After {{name}} finishes a first draft, do they go back and make real improvements — not just fixing spelling, but changing sentences or reorganising ideas to make it better?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 资料研究与来源评估
topics.description: 总结、整理阅读及研究过程中获取的资料：从多种资料来源收集相关信息，评估资料来源的可信度，整合论据时不抄袭，并用事实细节支撑自身观点
evidence: Take notes from multiple sources on a topic and organise them under logical headings
Paraphrase information from a source accurately without copying word-for-word
Assess whether a source is credible and relevant before including it in research writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is preparing for a school project, can they gather notes from several sources and organise them into a logical order before they start writing?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 跨体裁写作
topics.description: 除记叙文外，能围绕不同写作目的、针对不同受众开展写作，可创作剧本、诗歌、私人信件、正式信函、发言提纲及其他多种形式的作品，且能根据体裁特点选择恰当的写作形式、语域与写作规范。
evidence: Write a formal letter using appropriate layout, salutation, register, and sign-off conventions
Compose a script with stage directions, character names, and realistic dialogue
Adapt writing style (vocabulary, sentence structure, tone) to suit different audiences and purposes
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} write in different styles depending on the task — for example, a persuasive letter, a set of instructions, or a diary entry — and make each one sound appropriate?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 人物塑造与对话写作
topics.description: 运用有效写作技巧创作基于真实经历或虚构想象的记叙文，具体技巧包括：设定故事背景与叙事视角，通过对话、叙事节奏把控和描写手法塑造人物，使用丰富多样的过渡语句，以及设置带有感悟反思的结尾。
evidence: Open a narrative by establishing setting, point of view, and a hook that engages the reader
Use dialogue, pacing, and descriptive detail to develop characters and advance the plot
Craft a conclusion that reflects on the narrated events rather than simply ending the action
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} writes a story, do they use techniques like describing feelings, building suspense, or showing dialogue to make it interesting to read?

topics.subject: English
topics.name: 增强表达效果的写作技巧
topics.description: 将不断积累的词汇、语法和篇章结构知识运用到写作中，借鉴阅读中学到的文学与修辞手法（如反问、三项排比、首语反复、对比），增强文章的表达效果。
evidence: Use a rhetorical question or tricolon deliberately in a persuasive piece and explain the intended effect
Employ varied sentence openings and structures to maintain reader interest across a whole piece
Draw on a literary device encountered in reading and apply it consciously in own writing
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} edits a piece of their writing, do they make choices about word order, sentence structure, or vocabulary to make the writing more powerful or clearer?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 发现图坦卡蒙的陵墓
topics.description: 我们之所以能了解古埃及，是因为考古学家发掘并研究了在黄沙中埋藏了数千年的古代物件。1922年霍华德·卡特找到了隐秘的图坦卡蒙陵墓，墓中满是黄金宝藏，这是有史以来最激动人心的考古发现之一。
evidence: Explain that archaeologists find and study old objects to learn about people who lived long ago
Retell the story of Howard Carter discovering Tutankhamun's tomb
Understand that discoveries like this help us learn about how ancient Egyptians lived and what they believed
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} watches a documentary about Howard Carter opening a tomb full of gold, can they explain who Carter was and why his discovery was so important?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古埃及众神与来世
topics.description: 古埃及人信奉许许多多的男神和女神，相信人死后会在美好的来世继续生活——正因如此，他们会精心处理逝者的遗体，还会在坟墓中放满食物、珠宝和贵重物品，供逝者使用。
evidence: Explain that ancient Egyptians worshipped many different gods and goddesses
Describe the basic belief that Egyptians thought life continued after death
Give a reason why tombs were filled with treasures and everyday objects
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} learns that Egyptian tombs were filled with food, games, and gold, can they explain why the Egyptians put those things there?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 埃及、尼罗河与沙漠
topics.description: 能在非洲地图上找到埃及的位置，知道埃及是一个地处炎热干燥沙漠中的国家；世界最长河流尼罗河穿境而过，带来了水源与肥沃的土壤，让人们可以种植粮食，孕育出了人类最早的伟大文明之一。
evidence: Point to Egypt on a map and identify the River Nile running through it
Explain why the Nile was so important to the ancient Egyptians (water, food, transport)
Describe how the desert and the river created two very different environments side by side
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees a picture of pyramids in a desert, can they tell you which country they're in and why a river made it possible for people to live there?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古埃及的日常生活
topics.description: 古埃及普通人的日常生活是这样的：农民在尼罗河岸边种植小麦和大麦，一家人住在泥砖房里，小朋友们玩游戏、养小宠物，人们常吃面包、鱼、水果和蔬菜。
evidence: Describe at least two things ordinary Egyptian families did in their daily lives
Name foods that ancient Egyptians ate or crops they grew
Identify at least one similarity and one difference between life in ancient Egypt and life today
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you asked {{name}} what a child their age might have done on a normal day in ancient Egypt, could they describe some activities — like playing games, helping with farming, or eating bread and fish?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古埃及象形文字与莎草纸
topics.description: 古埃及人有一套特殊的书写系统，叫做象形文字，用图画和符号来代表发音和字词；他们会在一种名叫莎草纸、类似纸张的材料上写字，莎草纸是用尼罗河沿岸生长的一种植物做成的。
evidence: Describe hieroglyphs as a writing system that uses pictures and symbols
Explain that papyrus was a material like paper made from a river plant
Understand that only specially trained people called scribes could read and write hieroglyphs
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees hieroglyphs on a museum artefact, can they tell you what they are and explain that the Egyptians wrote on a special paper called papyrus?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 法老与图坦卡蒙
topics.description: 小朋友要知道：古埃及由权力很大的国王和女王统治，这些统治者被称为法老。他们住在宏伟华丽的宫殿里，负责制定法律。最有名的法老之一是图坦卡蒙，他小小年纪就当上了法老，数千年后，他的黄金陵墓被人们发现。
evidence: Explain that a pharaoh was the ruler of ancient Egypt, like a king or queen
Name Tutankhamun as a famous pharaoh and describe at least one fact about him
Understand that pharaohs were very powerful and made important decisions for everyone in Egypt
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees a picture of a golden Egyptian mask, can they tell you it belonged to a pharaoh called Tutankhamun and explain what a pharaoh was?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 金字塔与大狮身人面像
topics.description: 小朋友要知道：古埃及人修建了巨大的石头金字塔当作法老的陵墓；吉萨大金字塔是古代世界七大奇迹之一，直到今天还稳稳矗立着；大狮身人面像长着狮子的身体和人的脑袋，一直守护着金字塔。
evidence: Explain that pyramids were built as tombs to protect the pharaoh's body for the afterlife
Describe the Great Pyramid as very large, very old, and still standing at Giza
Describe the Sphinx as a stone statue with a lion's body and a human head
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees a photo of the pyramids, can they tell you why they were built and describe the Sphinx that sits near them?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古埃及核心词汇
topics.description: 认识并学会运用古埃及相关核心词汇，包括：法老、金字塔、陵墓、木乃伊/木乃伊制作工艺、象形文字、纸莎草纸、石棺、卡诺匹斯罐、泡碱、考古学家、文物、尼罗河、三角洲、灌溉、桔槔（沙杜夫）、书吏、维齐尔（古埃及宰相）、方尖碑、狮身人面像、王名圈；在描述古埃及的社会风貌、宗教信仰与物质文化时，能够准确使用这些词汇。
evidence: Use 'pharaoh', 'pyramid', and 'hieroglyphs' correctly and naturally in a spoken or written account of ancient Egypt
Explain what mummification is and why the Egyptians did it, using 'sarcophagus', 'canopic jar', and 'natron'
Use 'archaeologist' and 'artefact' correctly when discussing how we know about ancient Egypt
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} visited an ancient Egypt exhibition at a museum, could they read the labels and explain to you what a pharaoh was, why there were pyramids, and what hieroglyphs are?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 时间轴上的古埃及
topics.description: 在跨度超过3000年的时间轴上定位古埃及：它的历史约始于公元前3100年（第一位法老完成统一），终于公元前30年（古罗马征服埃及）。古埃及文明的持续时长比从古罗马时代到今天的时间长度还要长，其历史主要分为三个重要时期：古王国时期（金字塔时代）、中王国时期、新王国时期（帝国时代）
evidence: Place ancient Egypt on a timeline showing it lasted over 3,000 years
Name the three main periods (Old, Middle, New Kingdom) and associate one fact with each
Compare the length of ancient Egyptian civilisation with another time period the child knows
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you asked {{name}} when the ancient Egyptians lived and for how long, could they explain that it was thousands of years ago and lasted longer than most other civilisations?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 建造金字塔
topics.description: 了解金字塔的建造方式：成千上万名劳工借助坡道、滚木和滑橇搬运巨型石块，整个工程由法老手下的官员统筹安排。金字塔的设计经历了长期演变：最早是平顶的马斯塔巴墓葬，之后发展出阶梯金字塔（比如左塞尔阶梯金字塔），最终演变为外壁光滑的大金字塔。你还需要知道，后来的法老不再修建金字塔，而是安葬在帝王谷中、在天然岩石里开凿出的隐蔽陵墓里。
evidence: Describe at least two methods used to move and raise heavy stone blocks
Explain that pyramid design changed over time from simple tombs to the Great Pyramid
Explain why later pharaohs chose hidden tombs in the Valley of the Kings instead of pyramids
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} wonders how the Egyptians built the pyramids without modern machines, can they describe some of the methods used and explain how tomb design changed over time?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 埃及众神
topics.description: 能够说出并介绍几位核心的埃及神：每天驾船划过天空的太阳神拉，掌管死后世界的奥西里斯，掌管魔法与母性的女神伊西斯，长着胡狼头、掌管木乃伊制作的阿努比斯，长着猎鹰头的天空之神荷鲁斯，长着朱鹮头、掌管文字的透特，还有负责守护的猫女神贝斯特。
evidence: Name at least four Egyptian gods/goddesses and describe their roles
Explain why many gods were shown with animal heads and what the animals represented
Understand that Egyptians built temples as homes for the gods and performed daily rituals there
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees an Egyptian statue with a jackal head, can they tell you it represents Anubis and explain what he was the god of?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古埃及社会等级制度
topics.description: 古埃及的社会结构是金字塔形的等级体系：法老处在金字塔最顶端，向下依次是祭司与贵族、书吏和士兵、工匠与商人，最底层是农民和劳工。古埃及人的社会地位通常世代传承，孩子一般会继承父母的阶层身份，所处的阶层会决定人一生的生活方式。
evidence: Draw or describe the social pyramid with at least four levels correctly ordered
Explain that most people were farmers and had very different lives from the pharaoh
Give an example of how social position affected someone's daily life (e.g., only scribes could read)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is asked who was more important in ancient Egypt — a scribe or a farmer — can they explain the social pyramid and where each person fitted?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古埃及墓葬壁画与文物
topics.description: 我们可以将古埃及的墓葬壁画、文物和各类物品作为证据，了解古埃及人的日常生活：内巴蒙墓的壁画呈现了狩猎、宴饮的场景，珠宝和家具展现了当时的工艺水平，锅、工具这类日常用品能让我们知道普通人平时使用的器物；要明白，我们正是依靠这些资料，才能拼凑出这个数千年前就已消亡的文明的相关信息。
evidence: Describe what can be learned about Egyptian life by studying a tomb painting or artefact
Explain that objects found in tombs and ruins are evidence that helps archaeologists understand the past
Give an example of something specific a painting or object reveals (e.g., what food they ate, what games they played)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} looks at an ancient Egyptian painting showing people fishing and feasting, can they explain what it tells us about how Egyptians lived?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 木乃伊的制作步骤
topics.description: 本知识点讲解木乃伊制作的分步流程：首先清洗遗体，取出内脏后放入卡诺匹斯罐；接着用泡碱对遗体进行干燥处理，整个过程需要40天；干燥完成后用亚麻绷带层层缠绕遗体，绷带夹层中会放入护身符；最后将处理好的遗体放入装饰精美的棺木（石棺）中。
evidence: List the main steps of mummification in the correct order
Explain the purpose of canopic jars and what was stored in them
Describe why mummification was performed (to preserve the body for the afterlife)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is asked how the ancient Egyptians made a mummy, can they describe the main steps — like removing organs, drying the body, and wrapping it in bandages?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 书吏与罗塞塔石碑
topics.description: 需要了解：书吏是受过专门训练、能够读写古埃及象形文字的人；罗塞塔石碑是一块石板，上面用三种不同的文字刻下了完全相同的内容，是破解象形文字密码的关键；象形文字的谜团持续了数百年，直到1822年，让-弗朗索瓦·商博良借助这块石碑成功破译了古埃及象形文字。
evidence: Explain the importance of scribes as the only people who could read and write
Describe the Rosetta Stone as having the same message in three different scripts
Name Champollion as the person who decoded hieroglyphs using the Rosetta Stone
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees the Rosetta Stone in a museum (or a picture of it), can they explain why it was so important and how it helped us read hieroglyphs?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 上埃及和下埃及
topics.description: 古埃及曾分为上埃及和下埃及两部分：南部狭窄的尼罗河谷地是上埃及，北部宽阔的尼罗河三角洲是下埃及；后来两片土地完成统一，由同一位法老统治。古埃及人通过修建灌溉渠、使用桔槔（一种杠杆提水工具）调配尼罗河的水源，一年四季都能种植庄稼。
evidence: Identify Upper and Lower Egypt on a map and explain why they had different landscapes
Describe how irrigation tools like shadufs and canals helped farmers water their fields
Explain that uniting the two lands was an important achievement of the early pharaohs
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees a map showing the Nile splitting into branches near the sea, can they explain the difference between Upper and Lower Egypt and how farmers used the river's water?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古埃及的深远遗产
topics.description: 认识古埃及的深远遗产价值：古埃及人发展出了早期医学、数学（可用于建造金字塔，也能在洪水过后帮人们丈量土地）、天文学（通过观测恒星制定历法）和工程技术，这些成就影响了包括古希腊、古罗马在内的诸多后世文明；此外还要将古埃及与美索不达米亚文明（又称两河流域文明）、印度河流域文明、中国商代文明等其他早期文明做对比，归纳出文字、农业、城市、有组织的宗教信仰等共通特征。
evidence: Name at least two Egyptian achievements that influenced later civilisations
Identify at least two features that ancient Egypt shared with other early civilisations
Explain why studying ancient Egypt helps us understand how human civilisation developed
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is asked what the ancient Egyptians gave to the world, can they name some lasting achievements and explain how Egypt compared to other ancient civilisations?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 克利奥帕特拉与古埃及的终结
topics.description: 了解古埃及最终走向终结的历史：古埃及最后一任法老是克利奥帕特拉七世，她曾与罗马结盟，却在公元前31年被屋大维（即后来的奥古斯都）击败。此后埃及成为罗马帝国的一个行省，延续三千多年的法老统治就此终结，埃及历史翻开了新的篇章。
evidence: Name Cleopatra VII as the last pharaoh of ancient Egypt
Explain that Egypt was conquered by Rome and became part of the Roman Empire
Understand that the end of pharaonic rule did not mean the end of Egyptian culture
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is asked what happened to ancient Egypt in the end, can they tell you about Cleopatra and how Egypt became part of the Roman Empire?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古埃及艺术与建筑
topics.description: 学习分析古埃及艺术与建筑，需理解以下核心内容：古埃及绘画遵循严格的创作规范：人物脸部与身体呈侧面形态，但眼睛画为正面样式，人物的体型大小代表其身份地位高低；古埃及墓葬与神庙的设计经历了长期演变：从最早的马斯塔巴墓葬，先后发展出阶梯金字塔、表面光滑的金字塔，最终演变为阿布辛贝神庙这类在天然岩壁上开凿的岩凿神庙；方尖碑、巨型雕像以及卡纳克神庙等建筑，既彰显了法老的至高权力，也体现了法老对神明的虔诚信奉。
evidence: Identify at least two conventions used in Egyptian painting and explain their purpose
Describe how monument design changed over the course of Egyptian history
Explain why pharaohs built such enormous structures (power, religion, afterlife)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} notices that Egyptian paintings always show people in a strange sideways pose, can they explain that this was a deliberate artistic rule and describe why the Egyptians drew this way?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古埃及时间线与地图
topics.description: 学习读取和制作历史时间线：将古埃及各个历史时期、历任法老与重大事件标注在时间线上，理清它们彼此之间以及与当代的时间先后关系；学会解读标注有尼罗河三角洲、贸易路线和重要遗址位置的地图
evidence: Place the Old, Middle, and New Kingdoms on a timeline and calculate the number of years between them
Read a map of ancient Egypt and identify the Nile, Memphis, Thebes, and the Valley of the Kings
Compare the age of Ancient Egypt on a timeline against other civilisations studied (e.g. Ancient Greece, Roman Britain)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is shown a timeline of ancient history, can they place the Ancient Egyptian kingdoms in the right order and say roughly how long ago they happened — and read a map to find where key places like Thebes were?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古埃及的贸易与经济
topics.description: 了解古埃及拥有繁荣的经济，其基础是农业剩余、贸易和专业化劳动：尼罗河肥沃的土壤出产的粮食足以养活工匠、祭司和官员，埃及沿着尼罗河并跨越地中海进行贸易——用黄金、纸莎草和谷物换取来自黎巴嫩的雪松木、来自阿富汗的青金石和来自蓬特的香料。
evidence: Explain how agricultural surplus along the Nile allowed people to specialise in non-farming jobs
Name at least two goods Egypt exported and two it imported, and where they came from
Describe how the barter system worked and why trade routes were important to Egypt's wealth
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} reads that the Egyptians traded gold for cedarwood from Lebanon, can they explain why Egypt needed to trade with other countries and how having surplus food made this possible?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 亡者审判
topics.description: 描述古埃及人对亡者审判的信仰：死后，心脏会在审判大厅里与玛阿特的羽毛一起称重，阿努比斯监督天平，托特记录结果——心脏纯洁的人可以进入芦苇田（天堂），而心脏沉重的人会被怪物阿米特吞噬；还要知道《亡灵书》里包含帮助死者通过这一考验的咒语。
evidence: Describe the weighing of the heart ceremony and name the gods involved
Explain the role of the Book of the Dead as a guide through the underworld
Connect the concept of the ka (life force) and ba (personality) to why Egyptians preserved the body
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees a painting of a heart being weighed on scales, can they explain what the Egyptians believed happened after death and why they thought it was so important to live a good life?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 法老：活在人间的神
topics.description: 了解法老不仅是统治者，还被人们视为活在人间的神——他是神与人之间的桥梁。同时，理解“玛阿特”（真理、正义和宇宙秩序）这一理念如何指导古埃及的法律和政府，以及维齐尔（宰相）和官员如何代表法老管理王国。
evidence: Explain the pharaoh's dual role as both political ruler and divine figure
Describe Ma'at as the principle of truth, justice, and order that governed Egyptian society
Identify the role of viziers and officials in running the government day to day
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is asked why the pharaoh was so powerful, can they explain that Egyptians believed the pharaoh was a god on Earth and that a concept called Ma'at kept everything in balance?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 现代考古学与埃及伦理
topics.description: 了解现代埃及学家在传统发掘之外，还使用先进技术——对木乃伊进行CT扫描、用卫星图像寻找地下建筑、DNA分析等，并批判性地思考考古学中的伦理问题：木乃伊是否应该在博物馆展出、古代文物归谁所有，以及殖民时期的收集行为如何影响我们今天研究和展示古埃及的方式。
evidence: Name at least two modern technologies used in Egyptology and explain what they reveal
Discuss at least one ethical question about how ancient Egyptian artefacts are treated today
Understand that how we study ancient Egypt reflects our own values and biases, not just facts about the past
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} visits a museum with Egyptian mummies on display, can they think about whether that's the right thing to do and explain different viewpoints on the question?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 埃及数学与工程
topics.description: 描述古埃及在数学和工程方面的成就：莱因德数学纸草书展示了面积、体积和分数的计算方法；金字塔对齐的精确度（与真北方向偏差在0.05°以内）需要精密的测量技术；埃及医学纸草书记载了详细的解剖学知识和药物疗法——这使埃及成为早期科学技术史的重要贡献者。
evidence: Describes the Rhind Mathematical Papyrus as containing worked examples of arithmetic, geometry, and unit fractions
Explains one specific engineering achievement: pyramid alignment, ramp logistics, or the accuracy of the Great Pyramid's dimensions
Names at least one medical papyrus (e.g. Ebers Papyrus) and describes the type of medical knowledge it contains
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} was told that the ancient Egyptians were solving problems involving fractions and calculating areas of fields over 3,500 years ago, could they describe what the Rhind Papyrus is and explain what it tells us about Egyptian mathematics?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古埃及的历史资料
topics.description: 解释关于古埃及的知识是如何从多种类型的资料中构建起来的——铭文、纸草、文物和实物遗存——并批判性地评估每一种资料：存在哪些偏见、空白和扭曲？探索商博良对圣书体的破译如何改变了这一领域，以及为什么同一件文物会被不同学者做出不同的解读。
evidence: Identifies at least four types of historical source (inscriptions, papyri, tomb art, physical artefacts) and explains what each type can and cannot tell us
Explains that hieroglyphic sources were created by the literate elite and therefore tend to record official versions of events, not ordinary people's experiences
Describes at least one example where the same artefact or text has been interpreted in significantly different ways by scholars, and explains why this happens
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} was shown two history books with contradictory claims about ancient Egypt, could they explain why historians sometimes disagree, and describe what kinds of evidence they use to try to work out what really happened?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 埃及及其邻邦
topics.description: 考察埃及与周边文明的关系：通往努比亚、黎凡特和蓬特的贸易网络；喜克索斯人的入侵与战车的引入；新王国帝国及其与赫梯人的冲突，最终导致卡迭石战役和世界上最早存续的和平条约——理解埃及并非孤立存在，而是相互联系的古代世界的一部分。
evidence: Describes the trade relationship with Nubia and Punt, naming at least two goods exchanged in each direction
Explains how the Hyksos invasion introduced new military technologies to Egypt, including the horse-drawn war chariot
Describes the Battle of Kadesh (Ramesses II vs. the Hittites) and the resulting Egypto-Hittite peace treaty as a landmark in diplomatic history
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} was asked whether ancient Egyptians ever went to war with other civilisations or traded with distant countries, could they describe at least one example of each and explain how these interactions changed Egypt?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 金字塔的真正建造者是谁
topics.description: 分析是谁建造了金字塔以及为什么建造，评估证据以反驳外星人建造说和奴隶劳动说：来自吉萨工人村的考古证据显示，这是一支有报酬、有技能、营养良好的劳动力队伍；讨论纪念碑建造作为国家组织、宗教义务和就业形式的社会功能；并评估当前关于新发现的建造坡道和后勤的争议。
evidence: Cites at least three pieces of archaeological evidence from Giza that point to an organised, skilled, fed workforce rather than slaves or aliens (e.g. worker villages, bakery remains, graffiti tags, medical care)
Explains why the alien hypothesis fails to meet the standards of historical evidence and what the burden of proof in history requires
Evaluates at least two proposed explanations for ramp logistics and describes which is currently supported by the most evidence
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} saw a documentary claiming aliens built the pyramids, could they explain why archaeologists reject this idea and describe the actual evidence for who built them — and what their working conditions were like?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古埃及文明的衰落
topics.description: 追溯古埃及文明的终结，历经亚述、波斯、马其顿（亚历山大大帝）以及最终罗马的 successive 征服，并解释每位征服者如何同时被埃及文化所塑造；审视克利奥帕特拉七世作为最后一位法老和多语言政治策略家；思考古埃及在现代文化、宗教和语言中留存了什么。
evidence: Names the main conquerors of Egypt in chronological order (Assyrians, Persians, Macedonians under Alexander, Romans) and gives approximate dates
Describes Cleopatra VII accurately: not as a romantic icon but as a politically sophisticated ruler who spoke multiple languages and tried to preserve Egyptian independence

Identifies at least two enduring legacies of ancient Egypt in the modern world (e.g. the Coptic language as a descendant of ancient Egyptian, obelisks in Rome and Paris, Egyptian motifs in Western art and architecture)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} was asked when ancient Egypt ended and why, could they describe the final centuries — including who conquered Egypt, who Cleopatra really was, and name something from ancient Egypt that is still part of the world today?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 地图上的古希腊和古罗马
topics.description: 在地图上找到希腊和意大利，知道它们是地中海周围的国家，几千年前，两个伟大的古代文明——古希腊和古罗马——在那里兴起，时间远在古埃及之后，但远在我们这个时代之前。
evidence: Point to Greece and Italy on a world map or globe
Say that Ancient Greece and Ancient Rome were around the Mediterranean Sea
Place Greece and Rome on a simple timeline after Ancient Egypt and before today
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you showed {{name}} a map, could they point to where Ancient Greece and Ancient Rome were and tell you those places are near the Mediterranean Sea?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古代生活与今天
topics.description: 比较古希腊或古罗马的儿童与今天儿童的生活——包括学校（在蜡板上写字，在斯巴达学习战斗）、食物（橄榄、面包、葡萄）、游戏和服装（束腰外衣和凉鞋）的差异——并理解这些文明存在于几千年前
evidence: Name two ways a child's life in ancient Greece or Rome was different from today
Describe what ancient Greek or Roman children might have eaten or worn
Say that these civilisations existed thousands of years ago — long before grandparents were born
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you what it might have been like to be a child in ancient Greece or Rome — what they wore, ate, or did at school — and how it was different from today?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 希腊众神与奥林匹斯山
topics.description: 了解古希腊人信仰许多神和女神，他们住在奥林匹斯山上——包括宙斯（众神之王，掌管雷电）、雅典娜（智慧）、波塞冬（海洋）、赫尔墨斯（信使）和阿芙罗狄蒂（爱）——每个神都有特殊的能力，并在世界上扮演着不同的角色。
evidence: Name at least three Greek gods and say what each one was god of
Say that the Greek gods were believed to live on Mount Olympus
Explain that the ancient Greeks prayed to different gods for different things
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} saw a picture of Zeus with a thunderbolt or Poseidon with a trident, could they tell you who they are and what they were the god of?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 希腊神话与英雄
topics.description: 能复述至少一个包含英雄与怪兽的希腊神话——比如忒修斯与迷宫中的弥诺陶洛斯、赫拉克勒斯（海格力斯）与狮子，或珀尔修斯与美杜莎——并理解这些是古希腊人用来解释世界、传授道理的故事
evidence: Retell a Greek myth naming the hero, the monster, and what happened
Explain that myths were stories the ancient Greeks told to make sense of the world
Describe what made a Greek hero brave or clever in the story
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you the story of a Greek hero like Theseus fighting the Minotaur or Heracles fighting the lion, and explain why the Greeks told these stories?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 罗马士兵与建筑师
topics.description: 知道罗马士兵曾行军穿越一个庞大的帝国，修建笔直的道路和坚固的城墙，并且一些罗马道路、城墙和建筑至今仍可见——这表明罗马人是强大的建筑师，他们的作品延续了数千年
evidence: Describe Roman soldiers as part of a powerful army that marched across an empire
Name something the Romans built that we can still see today such as roads or walls
Explain that Roman buildings and roads lasted because the Romans were skilled builders
topics.assessmentPrompt: If your family drove along a very straight old road or visited Roman ruins, could {{name}} tell you that the Romans built things so well they've lasted thousands of years?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 罗慕路斯与雷穆斯
topics.description: 了解罗马建城神话——罗慕路斯与雷穆斯这对双胞胎兄弟在婴儿时期被遗弃，由一头母狼抚养长大，后来建立了罗马城——并明白这是罗马人讲述的关于他们城市起源的传说
evidence: Retell the story of Romulus and Remus being raised by a wolf
Say that Romulus founded the city of Rome
Explain that this is a legend — a story people told, not necessarily true
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} saw a statue of a wolf feeding two babies, could they tell you it's the story of Romulus and Remus and how the Romans believed their city began?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 第一届奥运会
topics.description: 知道奥运会起源于古希腊一个叫奥林匹亚的地方，是纪念宙斯的体育比赛，我们今天观看的现代奥运会就是受到古代奥运会的启发
evidence: Say that the Olympic Games started in ancient Greece at Olympia
Name at least one sport or event from the ancient Olympics such as running or wrestling
Explain that today's Olympic Games got the idea from the ancient Greek ones
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} watches the Olympics on TV, can they tell you that the Games originally started thousands of years ago in ancient Greece?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 雅典民主
topics.description: 了解雅典发明了民主——一种自由男性公民聚集在公民大会上，为城邦的重要决定进行辩论和投票的制度——但妇女、奴隶和外国人不能投票。
evidence: Explain what democracy meant in Athens: citizens voted on decisions together
Identify who could vote in Athenian democracy (free men born in Athens) and who could not
Say that the idea of people voting on decisions started in Athens and still influences us today
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain that democracy — people voting on decisions — was invented in ancient Athens, but that not everyone was allowed to take part?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 雅典与斯巴达
topics.description: 比较雅典和斯巴达这两个截然不同的希腊城邦：雅典注重学习、艺术、辩论和民主，而斯巴达注重军事训练、纪律和服从——并理解城邦就是一个像小国家一样自治的城市
evidence: Name at least two differences between life in Athens and life in Sparta
Explain what a city-state was and why Greek city-states were independent from each other
Describe what was valued most in Athens (learning, arts) versus Sparta (military strength)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you asked {{name}} about Athens and Sparta, could they tell you that Athens was famous for thinking and democracy while Sparta was famous for its fierce warriors?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 布狄卡反抗罗马
topics.description: 讲述爱西尼部落女王布狄卡的故事，她领导了一场对罗马统治的激烈反抗——烧毁了科尔切斯特、伦敦和圣奥尔本斯——最终她的军队被击败，并理解她作为反抗强大帝国的象征的重要意义。
evidence: Retell the story of Boudicca: who she was, why she revolted, what happened
Name at least one town Boudicca's army destroyed during the revolt
Explain why Boudicca is remembered as a symbol of resistance against the Romans
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you who Boudicca was and what happened when she led a revolt against the Romans in Britain?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古罗马城镇的日常生活
topics.description: 描述古罗马城镇的日常生活——广场（集市和聚会场所）、公共浴场、圆形剧场和别墅——并说明罗马人是杰出的工程师，他们修建了笔直的道路、引水渠、地板下供暖系统（火炕），以及哈德良长城，用来标记帝国在不列颠的北部边界。
evidence: Describe at least three features of a Roman town such as forum, baths, or amphitheatre
Explain what an aqueduct was and why the Romans built them
Describe Hadrian's Wall and say why it was built
topics.assessmentPrompt: If your family visited Roman ruins like a bathhouse or Hadrian's Wall, could {{name}} explain what they were used for and how the Romans built them?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 角斗士与庞贝古城
topics.description: 了解罗马人会在罗马斗兽场等巨大竞技场中观看角斗士搏斗，角斗士通常是受过搏斗训练的奴隶或囚犯，以及庞贝城在公元79年被维苏威火山喷发掩埋，保存了罗马日常生活的珍贵画面。
evidence: Describe what gladiators were and where they fought
Explain that the Colosseum in Rome was a giant arena for public entertainment
Retell what happened to Pompeii and why it is important for understanding Roman life
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you what gladiators were, describe the Colosseum, and explain what happened to the city of Pompeii?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 希腊众神与帕特农神庙
topics.description: 说出主要的希腊神祇及其职责——宙斯（众神之王，掌管雷电）、赫拉（天后，掌管婚姻）、雅典娜（智慧与战争）、波塞冬（海洋）、阿波罗（太阳与音乐）、阿尔忒弥斯（狩猎与月亮）、阿瑞斯（战争）、阿佛洛狄忒（爱与美）、赫尔墨斯（信使）、赫菲斯托斯（火与工匠）、哈迪斯（冥界）——并知道雅典的帕特农神庙是一座宏伟的神庙，用来供奉雅典娜。
evidence: Name at least five Greek gods and say what each was responsible for
Describe the Parthenon as a temple to Athena built on the acropolis in Athens
Explain that Greeks built temples to honour their gods and held festivals and sacrifices
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} saw a picture of the Parthenon, could they tell you it was a temple to Athena in Athens and name several other Greek gods and what they were god of?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 希腊神与罗马名
topics.description: 了解罗马人继承了希腊神，但给他们起了新名字——宙斯变成朱庇特，赫拉变成朱诺，阿瑞斯变成玛尔斯，雅典娜变成密涅瓦，波塞冬变成尼普顿，阿佛洛狄忒变成维纳斯——这表明罗马深受希腊文化影响。
evidence: Match at least four Greek gods to their Roman names
Explain that the Romans took Greek gods and gave them Latin names
Say that this borrowing shows Rome was strongly influenced by Greek culture
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you that the Romans had the same gods as the Greeks but with different names — like Zeus becoming Jupiter and Athena becoming Minerva?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古希腊戏剧
topics.description: 知道古希腊人发明了戏剧，在大型露天圆形剧场里表演悲剧和喜剧，演员戴着面具——戏剧表演是纪念酒神狄俄尼索斯的宗教节日的一部分，观众多达数千人。
evidence: Explain that the Greeks invented theatre with two types of plays: tragedies and comedies
Describe how Greek actors wore masks and performed in open-air amphitheatres
Say that plays were part of festivals honouring the god Dionysus
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} visited an ancient amphitheatre or saw a picture of Greek masks, could they tell you that the Greeks invented theatre and explain why actors wore masks?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 马拉松与温泉关
topics.description: 描述马拉松战役和温泉关战役，作为希腊城邦联合抵抗波斯帝国入侵的时刻——信使菲迪皮德斯带来马拉松胜利的消息（马拉松赛跑的起源），以及300名斯巴达勇士在温泉关的英勇坚守——并理解这些战争是为了保卫希腊的独立。
evidence: Retell the story of the Battle of Marathon and the runner Pheidippides
Describe the Spartan stand at Thermopylae against a much larger Persian army
Explain that the Persian Wars were about Greek city-states defending their freedom
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you about the famous battles of Marathon and Thermopylae, and explain that the Greeks were fighting to defend their freedom against the Persian Empire?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 罗马军队与征服不列颠
topics.description: 描述罗马军队如何组织成由训练有素的士兵组成的军团，尤利乌斯·凯撒如何在公元前55年首次袭击不列颠，以及克劳狄乌斯皇帝后来在公元43年征服不列颠，并解释罗马人为什么想要扩张帝国——为了土地、资源、税收和荣耀。
evidence: Describe a Roman legion as a large unit of highly trained, disciplined soldiers
Explain that Julius Caesar raided Britain first and Claudius conquered it later
Give at least one reason why the Romans invaded Britain
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you how the Roman army was organised and explain why the Romans invaded Britain — who came first and who finally conquered it?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 亚历山大大帝的帝国
topics.description: 描述马其顿的亚历山大大帝如何征服了一个从希腊延伸到埃及和印度的庞大帝国，在古代世界传播希腊语言、文化和思想，开创了被称为希腊化时代的时期，在这个时期希腊和东方文化相互融合。
evidence: Describe the extent of Alexander's empire on a map (Greece to Egypt to India)
Explain that Alexander spread Greek culture and language across the lands he conquered
Say what the Hellenistic Age was — a blending of Greek and Eastern cultures
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you who Alexander the Great was, how far his empire stretched, and what happened to Greek culture because of his conquests?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古希腊罗马生活的证据
topics.description: 了解历史学家和考古学家是如何从证据中拼凑出古希腊和古罗马生活的——陶器绘画、硬币、铭文、像庞贝这样的遗迹，以及荷马、普林尼等作家的文字作品——并且同一证据可能被不同历史学家以不同方式解读。
evidence: Name at least three types of evidence historians use to learn about ancient Greece and Rome
Explain why Pompeii is especially valuable as a source of evidence about Roman life
Give an example of how the same piece of evidence could be interpreted in more than one way
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} saw an ancient Greek pot or a Roman coin in a museum, could they explain what historians can learn from objects like these and why different experts might interpret them differently?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 西罗马帝国的衰亡
topics.description: 描述西罗马帝国如何因多种因素逐渐衰落——外族入侵的军事压力、政治动荡、经济问题以及帝国过度扩张——最终于公元476年灭亡，而东罗马（拜占庭）帝国又延续了近一千年
evidence: Name at least two reasons why the Western Roman Empire declined and fell
State the date AD 476 as when the last Western Roman emperor was removed
Explain that the Eastern (Byzantine) Empire survived for nearly 1,000 years after the West fell
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain why the Roman Empire fell apart and tell you that while the western half collapsed, the eastern half kept going for centuries?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 希腊与罗马建筑
topics.description: 认识希腊柱式——多立克柱式（简单坚固）、爱奥尼柱式（涡卷形柱头）和科林斯柱式（华丽叶形柱头）——以及罗马建筑创新——拱门、穹顶和混凝土——并发现它们对现代公共建筑的影响，如法院、博物馆、政府大楼和纪念碑。
evidence: Identify the three Greek column orders (Doric, Ionic, Corinthian) from pictures
Name Roman architectural innovations: the arch, the dome, and concrete
Point out Greek or Roman architectural features in a modern public building
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you walked past a courthouse or museum with big columns, could {{name}} tell you whether they're Doric, Ionic, or Corinthian and explain that the design comes from ancient Greece or Rome?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 古希腊罗马的现代遗产
topics.description: 评估古希腊和古罗马文明对现代生活的持久贡献——民主、法律、语言（拉丁词根）、建筑（柱子、拱门、穹顶）、体育（奥运会）、哲学、文学和戏剧——并理解希腊思想是通过罗马，再通过后来的欧洲文明，在一连串文化传播中传到我们这里的。
evidence: List at least five ways ancient Greece and Rome still influence modern life
Explain how Greek culture spread to Rome and then from Rome across Europe
Give a specific modern example of a Greek or Roman legacy such as democratic voting or architectural columns
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} list several things we still have today because of the ancient Greeks and Romans — like democracy, the Olympics, Latin words, and building styles — and explain how those ideas reached us?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 希腊哲学家与医学
topics.description: 了解被称为哲学家的希腊思想家们发展出了理解世界的方法，这些方法至今仍在影响着我们——苏格拉底提出具有挑战性的问题来检验想法（苏格拉底法），柏拉图构想了理想社会，亚里士多德观察并分类自然界——以及希波克拉底被称为医学之父，因为他坚持疾病有自然原因，而不是归咎于神。
evidence: Describe what Socrates, Plato, and Aristotle each contributed to thinking and learning
Explain the Socratic method as learning by asking questions rather than just being told answers
Say why Hippocrates is called the father of medicine
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you about Socrates, Plato, and Aristotle — what each one was famous for — and explain why Greek thinkers still matter today?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 罗马法律、拉丁语与基督教
topics.description: 了解罗马法成为欧洲及其他地区法律体系的基础；拉丁语是法语、西班牙语、意大利语、葡萄牙语和罗马尼亚语的根源，并为英语提供了数百个单词（如exit、video、annual、education）；基督教在罗马帝国传播，最终在君士坦丁大帝统治下成为官方宗教。
evidence: Give examples of English words that come from Latin
Explain that Roman law influenced modern legal systems in Europe and beyond
Describe how Christianity spread through the Roman Empire and became its official religion
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} give you examples of English words that come from Latin and explain how Roman law and Christianity spread across Europe through the Roman Empire?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 罗马共和国与罗马帝国
topics.description: 解释罗马最初如何作为共和国进行统治——设有选举产生的执政官、权力强大的元老院，以及贵族与平民之间的区分——后来又如何变成由奥古斯都（他带来了“罗马和平”）和尼禄等皇帝统治的帝国，并比较共和制政府与雅典的直接民主制。
evidence: Describe the Roman Republic's structure: consuls, Senate, patricians, and plebeians
Explain how Rome changed from a republic to an empire under Augustus
Compare Athenian direct democracy (citizens vote on decisions) with Roman republican government (citizens elect representatives)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain the difference between the Roman Republic and the Roman Empire, and compare how Rome and Athens each let people have a say in government?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 希腊与罗马的隐藏声音
topics.description: 考察那些通常被排除在希腊罗马历史叙事之外的人群的生活——约占雅典人口30%并为罗马经济提供动力的被奴役者，在雅典（主要被限制在家中）和斯巴达（接受体能训练、拥有财产）之间生活差异巨大的女性，以及两个帝国中被征服的民族——并评估历史记录中缺失了谁的声音以及原因。
evidence: Describe the daily life of an enslaved person in Athens or Rome using available evidence
Compare the lives of women in Athens and Sparta, explaining key differences
Explain why the historical record favours elite men and what this means for our understanding
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you about the lives of enslaved people or women in ancient Greece and Rome, and explain why we know less about them than about famous leaders?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 雅典的包容与排斥
topics.description: 分析雅典民主制度中谁被包容、谁被排斥——只有自由的成年男性公民（约占成年人的30%）才能参与，而妇女、被奴役的人（可能占人口的三分之一）和外国居民（外邦人）都被排斥——并通过与现代代议制民主的比较，评价雅典是否真正配得上“民主发源地”的称号。
evidence: Calculate approximately what fraction of the Athenian population could participate in democracy
List the groups excluded from Athenian democracy and explain why each was excluded
Construct an argument for or against calling Athens a true democracy, using evidence
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain who was left out of Athenian democracy and make a reasoned argument about whether it really deserves to be called the birthplace of democracy?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 特洛伊：神话还是历史？
topics.description: 探索海因里希·施利曼在土耳其希沙立克的发掘如何引发疑问：荷马《伊利亚特》中描述的特洛伊战争是真实的历史、部分真实，还是完全虚构？理解考古学和文学资料可能相互支持或矛盾，古代世界中神话与历史的界限往往模糊不清。
evidence: Describe Schliemann's excavation at Hisarlik and what he claimed to have found
Explain how archaeological evidence at Troy both supports and complicates Homer's story
Discuss why the boundary between myth and history is difficult to draw for the ancient world
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} discuss whether the Trojan War really happened, explaining what archaeology has found at Troy and why the answer isn't simple?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 罗马共和国的衰亡
topics.description: 追溯罗马政治暴力——格拉古兄弟被杀、马略与苏拉的内战、凯撒跨越卢比孔河及三月十五日遇刺、屋大维与安东尼的最终决战——如何摧毁了共和国，并导致奥古斯都的一人统治，同时讨论共和国的衰亡是不可避免的，还是一系列选择的结果。
evidence: Describe at least three key events in the collapse of the Roman Republic in chronological order
Explain what 'crossing the Rubicon' meant and why it was a point of no return
Construct an argument about whether the Republic's fall was inevitable or could have been prevented
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain the chain of events that destroyed the Roman Republic — from the Gracchi to Caesar's assassination to Augustus — and discuss whether it could have been avoided?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 同一事件的不同描述
topics.description: 认识到不同的人对同一事件可以给出不同的描述——而且这些描述可能都是真实的，但仍然存在分歧。
evidence: Wineburg corroboration heuristic
Initiating Historical Thinking in Elementary Schools
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} heard two different versions of the same historical event, would they understand that both people might be telling the truth from their own point of view — and want to know why the versions differ?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 来自过去的证据
topics.description: 理解我们对过去的所有了解都来自证据——保存下来的物品、建筑、图片、文件和故事
evidence: Wineburg historical thinking framework
Historical Thinking in the Elementary Years (ERIC)
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} learns about something that happened long ago, do they ask how we know about it — and understand that someone had to find or leave behind that evidence?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 历史思维词汇
topics.description: 认识并使用历史思维的词汇——史料、证据、一手史料、二手史料、文物、年代学、时间顺序、公元前/公元前、公元/公元、世纪、十年、时代、时期、时间线、发掘、考古学家、解读、印证、偏见、视角——并在讨论我们如何了解过去以及我们的知识有多可靠时运用这些术语。
evidence: Correctly use BC/BCE and AD/CE to place events in time and explain what the letters stand for
Distinguish between a primary source and a secondary source with an example of each
Use 'evidence', 'interpretation', and 'bias' correctly in a sentence about a historical source
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you asked {{name}} whether something they read in a history book was definitely true, could they explain why it might not be — using words like 'source', 'evidence', or 'bias'?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 相互核对资料
topics.description: 相互印证：检查多个资料是否对同一事实说法一致——并探究它们可能不一致的原因
evidence: Wineburg corroboration heuristic
Historical Thinking in the Elementary Years (ERIC)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} was trying to find out what really happened in a historical event, would they know to look at more than one source and compare what they say?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 质疑历史资料
topics.description: 在相信一份历史资料之前，先问：这是谁做的、什么时候做的、为什么做？——这些答案决定了这份资料应该有多大的可信度。
evidence: Wineburg sourcing heuristic
Teaching Historical Thinking Using Primary Sources (Library of Congress)
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} looks at a historical document, photograph, or account, do they ask who created it and what that person's reasons or point of view might have been?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 理解过去时代的人
topics.description: 明白过去的人看待世界的方式与我们非常不同——要根据他们所处的时代背景来评判他们的行为，而不仅仅是用今天的价值观来衡量。
evidence: Historical Empathy: A Cognitive-Affective Theory (ERIC)
Year 4-6 historical empathy research
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} learns that people in the past did something that seems wrong today, can they think about why those people might have believed it was normal or right at the time?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 证据与解释
topics.description: 区分历史证据和历史解释——证据是留存下来的材料，解释是历史学家基于证据构建的论点，同样的证据可以支持不同的论点。
evidence: Development of historical understanding among 9-14 year olds
Ways of Seeing: Evidence and Learning in the History Classroom (RRCHNM)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} understand that two historians can look at the same evidence and reach different conclusions — and that history involves argument and judgment, not just facts?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 国王与王后
topics.description: 中世纪国王和王后做什么：统治土地、制定法律、收税；王冠和王座作为权力的象征；伦敦塔
evidence: Explain what a medieval king or queen did (ruled, made laws, led armies, collected taxes)
Describe at least one symbol of royal power (crown, throne, sceptre)
Name one famous medieval monarch or describe the Tower of London's role
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain what a king or queen actually did in medieval times, beyond just wearing a crown?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 骑士与盔甲
topics.description: 骑士是什么：为领主效力的受过训练的战士；盔甲、盾牌、剑和长矛；骑士准则作为骑士行为规范的规则
evidence: Describe what a knight wore and carried (armour, helmet, shield, sword, lance)
Explain that knights trained from a young age and served a lord
Name one rule of the code of chivalry (be brave, be honest, protect the weak)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} describe what a knight looked like, what they did, and at least one rule they were supposed to follow?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 中世纪服饰
topics.description: 中世纪人们穿什么：农民的衣服（羊毛、亚麻）与贵族的衣服（丝绸、毛皮、鲜艳的颜色）；没有拉链或纽扣；衣服如何显示你的社会地位
evidence: Describe what a medieval peasant would typically wear
Explain how noble clothing was different from peasant clothing
Give one way that what you wore showed your place in society
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} saw pictures of different medieval people, could they tell you which ones were rich and which were poor just by looking at their clothes?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 中世纪的食物与宴会
topics.description: 中世纪人们吃什么：普通人吃面包和浓汤，富人举办盛大宴会；没有叉子，用手吃饭；大厅是城堡生活的中心。
evidence: Describe what ordinary people ate most days (bread, pottage, vegetables, ale)
Explain how a feast in a great hall was different from everyday meals
Name one surprising table manner from medieval times (no forks, shared cups, food thrown on the floor)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} went to a medieval banquet, could they describe what food would be served and which table manners would surprise them?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 罗宾汉与亚瑟王
topics.description: 罗宾汉的传说（舍伍德森林、劫富济贫、快乐伙伴）和亚瑟王的传说（圆桌骑士、王者之剑、卡美洛）；这些是故事，不是被证实的历史，但反映了中世纪价值观。
evidence: Retell the basic story of Robin Hood or King Arthur
Name at least two characters from one of these legends
Explain that these are legends (stories) rather than proven facts
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you the story of Robin Hood or King Arthur and explain that these are legends rather than definitely true history?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 维京人
topics.description: 维京人是谁：来自斯堪的纳维亚的航海战士和商人；长船；维京人对不列颠的袭击；维京人也定居和务农
evidence: Describe who the Vikings were and where they came from
Explain what made longships special (fast, could sail in shallow water, dragon prows)
State that Vikings were not just raiders but also farmers, traders, and settlers
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you who the Vikings were, where they came from, and that they did more than just raid and fight?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 村庄生活
topics.description: 中世纪村庄里普通人的日常生活：茅草屋、种田、烤面包、打水；生活与今天有多么不同
evidence: Describe what a typical medieval village looked like (thatched cottages, fields, church)
Name at least three daily tasks a medieval villager would do
Give two differences between life in a medieval village and life today
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} describe what a normal day would be like for a child living in a medieval village, and how it would differ from their own life?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 什么是城堡？
topics.description: 城堡是什么：一种既能住人又能防御的坚固建筑；城堡的主要部分包括塔楼、护城河、吊桥和厚厚的城墙；为什么要建造城堡
evidence: Name at least four parts of a castle (tower, moat, drawbridge, walls, gatehouse)
Explain that castles were both homes and defences
Describe why someone in medieval times would need a castle
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} visited a ruined castle, could they point out the main parts and explain why it was built that way?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 盎格鲁-撒克逊时期的英国
topics.description: 盎格鲁-撒克逊人是谁：罗马人离开后定居不列颠的日耳曼民族；他们的王国、村庄、地名、艺术，以及最终皈依基督教
evidence: Explain who the Anglo-Saxons were and when they came to Britain (after the Romans left)
Name at least two Anglo-Saxon kingdoms (e.g. Wessex, Mercia, Northumbria)
Give an example of Anglo-Saxon influence still visible today (place names ending in -ton, -ham, -bury)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain who the Anglo-Saxons were and point out that many English place names come from Anglo-Saxon words?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 黑斯廷斯战役与1066年
topics.description: 1066年发生的大事：忏悔者爱德华去世、三个人争夺王位、黑斯廷斯战役、征服者威廉，以及作为历史资料的贝叶挂毯。
evidence: Explain why there was a crisis when Edward the Confessor died in 1066
Describe the Battle of Hastings and its outcome
Explain what the Bayeux Tapestry is and why it is important as a historical source
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you what happened in 1066, why it mattered, and what the Bayeux Tapestry shows us about those events?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 历代城堡设计
topics.description: 城堡是如何建造和演变的：从木制土墩-外郭城堡到石制主楼，再到同心城堡；城堡的房间及其用途；城堡设计如何应对新的攻击方式。
evidence: Describe the difference between an early motte-and-bailey castle and a later stone castle
Name at least three rooms or areas in a medieval castle and their purpose
Explain one way castle design changed to resist new attack methods
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain how castles changed over time and describe what different rooms inside a castle were used for?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 中世纪的权力金字塔
topics.description: 中世纪社会是如何组织的：国王在最上面，然后是领主，然后是骑士，最后是农民/农奴；谁欠谁什么；权力金字塔和相互义务
evidence: Draw or describe the feudal pyramid showing king, lords, knights, and peasants
Explain what each level owed to the level above (loyalty, military service, labour)
Describe what a serf's life was like and why they couldn't easily leave
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain the medieval class system — who was at the top, who was at the bottom, and what each group had to do for the others?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 攻城战
topics.description: 城堡如何被攻击和防守：攻城武器（投石机、破城槌、攻城塔）、滚烫的液体、箭孔、谋杀孔；中世纪攻城战的戏剧性场面。
evidence: Name at least three siege weapons or attack methods
Describe at least two ways a castle was designed to resist attack
Explain what a siege was and why it could last weeks or months
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} was reading about a medieval siege, could they explain the weapons used to attack a castle and the clever ways defenders fought back?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 黑死病
topics.description: 1348-49年的黑死病：什么是瘟疫，它是如何传播的，它造成的毁灭性死亡人数；它如何通过让幸存的工人获得更多权力和更高工资来改变社会。
evidence: Describe what the Black Death was and at least two symptoms
Explain how the plague spread (fleas on rats, person to person)
Describe one major way the Black Death changed society (fewer workers led to higher wages, peasants gained power)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you what the Black Death was, how it spread, and why it actually ended up changing society in unexpected ways?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 十字军东征
topics.description: 用简单的方式讲述十字军东征：欧洲人为什么前往圣地，他们在那里发现了什么，以及基督教欧洲与伊斯兰世界之间的文化交流。
evidence: Explain in simple terms why European armies travelled to the Holy Land
Describe at least one thing Europeans learned from the Islamic world during the Crusades
Acknowledge that the Crusades involved violence and suffering on both sides
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain what the Crusades were and describe something that Europeans learned about the wider world through these journeys?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 中世纪教会
topics.description: 中世纪教会的巨大权力：修道院与修士修女的日常生活；建造宏伟的大教堂；朝圣作为宗教旅程；教会对日常生活的影响
evidence: Explain why the Church was so powerful in medieval times (owned land, controlled education, people feared God's punishment)
Describe what daily life was like for a monk or nun
Explain what a pilgrimage was and give one reason people went on them
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain why the Church was such a big part of everyone's life in medieval times and what monks and nuns actually did all day?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 维京人与盎格鲁-撒克逊人
