topics.description: 维京人与盎格鲁-撒克逊人争夺英格兰控制权的冲突：维京人的劫掠、阿尔弗雷德大帝的抵抗、丹麦法区、首位全英格兰国王阿瑟尔斯坦、忏悔者爱德华
evidence: Describe the Viking raids on Anglo-Saxon England and their impact
Explain who Alfred the Great was and why he was important
Describe what the Danelaw was (the area of England under Viking control)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you about the struggle between the Vikings and Anglo-Saxons for control of England, and who Alfred the Great was?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 艺术与建筑
topics.description: 中世纪的文化成就：泥金装饰手抄本、哥特式大教堂（飞扶壁、彩色玻璃）、格里高利圣咏、贝叶挂毯；艺术和建筑作为信仰与权力的表达
evidence: Describe what an illuminated manuscript is and who made them
Name at least two features of Gothic cathedral architecture (pointed arches, flying buttresses, stained glass)
Explain how medieval art and buildings were connected to the Church and religious belief
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} visited a Gothic cathedral, could they point out features like stained glass windows and flying buttresses and explain why medieval people built such impressive buildings?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 犯罪与惩罚
topics.description: 中世纪时期的司法是如何运作的：神判法、决斗审判、郡长的角色；惩罚方式包括足枷、颈手枷和地牢；与现代司法有多么不同
evidence: Describe at least two medieval methods of deciding guilt (trial by ordeal, trial by combat)
Name at least two medieval punishments and explain what they involved
Compare one aspect of medieval justice to how justice works today
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} describe how criminals were caught and punished in medieval times and explain what seems unfair by today's standards?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 《大宪章》与限制王权
topics.description: 约翰国王、男爵们的反抗，以及1215年《大宪章》的签署；《大宪章》如何限制国王的权力；它对民主和权利的持久重要性。
evidence: Explain why the barons rebelled against King John
Describe what the Magna Carta said (the king must follow the law too, fair trial rights)
Explain why the Magna Carta still matters today (foundation of democracy and human rights)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you what the Magna Carta is and why a document from 1215 is still considered important today?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 中世纪对现代生活的影响
topics.description: 中世纪留给我们的遗产：议会、大学、普通法、哥特式建筑、英语（盎格鲁-撒克逊语+诺曼法语）、地名、姓氏；以及为什么我们至今仍对中世纪世界着迷
evidence: Name at least three things from the Middle Ages that still affect our lives today
Explain how the English language was shaped by Anglo-Saxon and Norman French
Give a reason why people today are still fascinated by the medieval period (castles, knights, fantasy literature, games)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} name several things we still have today — from Parliament to English words to university degrees — that actually began in the Middle Ages?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 欧洲之外的中世纪世界
topics.description: 欧洲之外的中世纪世界：伊斯兰黄金时代（数学、医学、建筑），马里帝国和曼萨·穆萨，中国宋朝；中世纪世界如何通过丝绸之路等贸易路线相互连接。
evidence: Name at least two achievements of the Islamic Golden Age (algebra, hospitals, architecture)
Describe who Mansa Musa was and why he is remembered
Explain how the Silk Road connected distant parts of the medieval world through trade
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you about important civilisations outside Europe during the Middle Ages and explain how the Silk Road connected different parts of the world?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 印刷机与文艺复兴
topics.description: 古腾堡发明印刷机，以及威廉·卡克斯顿将印刷术带到英格兰；印刷书籍如何改变了一切；从中世纪到文艺复兴的过渡。
evidence: Explain what the printing press was and why it was revolutionary
Describe William Caxton's role in bringing printing to England
Give at least one way printed books changed society (more people could read, ideas spread faster)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain why the invention of the printing press was one of the most important moments in history and how it changed the world?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 城镇与贸易
topics.description: 中世纪城镇的成长：集市、行会、商人阶层；城镇如何赢得自治特许状；从纯乡村生活向部分城市生活的转变。
evidence: Describe how medieval towns were different from villages (markets, walls, guilds, more people)
Explain what a guild was and why it mattered for tradespeople
Describe one way towns changed medieval society (new merchant class, more freedom for townspeople)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain why medieval towns grew and how the rise of markets and guilds changed the way people lived and worked?

topics.subject: History
topics.name: 中世纪女性
topics.description: 中世纪女性的生活：贵族女性管理庄园，农妇每天辛苦劳作，修女和女修道院长，以及像阿基坦的埃莉诺和圣女贞德这样的著名人物。
evidence: Describe the different lives of noblewomen, peasant women, and nuns
Name at least one notable medieval woman and explain what she did
Explain one way women's lives in medieval times were more restricted than today
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you about what life was like for women in medieval times and name a famous medieval woman who made her mark on history?

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 寻求帮助
topics.description: 当你自己尝试过但仍然卡住时，要主动寻求帮助——知道什么时候该求助本身就是一种能力
evidence: Hattie visible learning
self-regulated learning research
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} has tried something and is still stuck, do they come and ask for help rather than sitting frustrated or giving up?

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 检查自己的作业
topics.description: 完成一项任务后，回头看看自己做了什么，并问自己：这看起来对吗？
evidence: After finishing a piece of work, re-read or review it without being asked to
Spot and correct at least one error in their own work by checking back through it
Describe what they checked for — e.g. 'I re-read each line to make sure my answers matched the question'
topics.assessmentPrompt: After {{name}} finishes a piece of work or activity, do they look it over themselves to check it seems right before saying they're done?

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 遇到困难要坚持
topics.description: 当事情感觉很难时，继续尝试——犯错并再试一次，正是学习发生的方式
evidence: Keep working on a difficult task for a sustained period without giving up or asking someone else to do it
After making a mistake, try again with a different approach rather than saying 'I can't do it'
Talk about difficulty positively — e.g. 'This is hard but I'm getting better' rather than 'I'm no good at this'
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} finds a puzzle or activity really tricky, do they keep trying different ways rather than giving up straight away?

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 不理解的感觉
topics.description: 注意不理解的感觉——当遇到困惑时能够识别出来，而不是继续读或听下去
evidence: comprehension monitoring research
Flavell metacognitive monitoring
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is reading or listening and something doesn't make sense, do they notice and say so — rather than carrying on as if they understood?

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 规划任务
topics.description: 在开始任务之前，先做一个简单的计划：我需要做什么，应该先做什么？
evidence: Before starting a task, describe what they need to do and what order to do it in
Break a larger task into smaller steps without being prompted — e.g. 'First I'll read the question, then I'll draw a diagram'
Gather the materials or information they need before beginning, rather than starting and then stopping to find things
topics.assessmentPrompt: Before {{name}} starts a bigger task — like writing a story or making something — do they take a moment to think about what they'll do first?

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 开始前先思考
topics.description: 在开始新事物之前，停下来想一想：关于这个话题，我已经知道什么？
evidence: prior knowledge activation research
Ausubel meaningful learning
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} is about to learn something new — say a new topic in science or a new type of word problem — do they first think about what they already know?

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 新旧知识联系
topics.description: 寻找新知识和已有知识之间的联系——这个新知识和我以前学过的内容有什么关系？
evidence: elaborative encoding
schema theory (Bartlett, Rumelhart)
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} learns something new, do they ever say things like 'oh, that's like...' and connect it to something they already knew?

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 发现规律
topics.description: 在数字、词语、自然、声音或事件中发现规律和重复出现的结构，并利用它们来理解新信息
evidence: Spot a pattern in a set of numbers, shapes, or facts without being told to look for one
Use a pattern they noticed to make a prediction — e.g. 'The next one should be 16 because it's doubling each time'
Explain the pattern they found and why they think it works
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} notices a pattern — like a number pattern, a word ending, or something that keeps recurring — do they use it to figure out what comes next or predict something new?

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 教回去
topics.description: 学到新东西后，用自己的话讲出来——讲给自己、家人，甚至一个玩具听。
evidence: Explain a concept they've learned to someone else in their own words, not just repeating what the teacher said
After teaching something to a friend or sibling, identify a gap in their own understanding that they only noticed through explaining
Summarise a lesson by pretending to teach it back, using examples they made up themselves
topics.assessmentPrompt: After {{name}} learns something at school, can they explain it back to you in their own words — not just repeat what they were told?

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 尝试新方法
topics.description: 当你的第一个方法不奏效时，试试别的方法——灵活调整策略是成为优秀学习者的重要部分。
evidence: When stuck on a problem, try a completely different approach rather than repeating the same method — e.g. drawing a picture instead of writing equations
Describe a time they changed strategy mid-task and explain why the new approach worked better
Accept that their first idea might not work and show willingness to start over with a fresh plan
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} tries one way to solve a problem and it isn't working, do they try a different approach rather than just repeating the same thing?

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 描述规则与规律
topics.description: 当你注意到一个规律反复出现时，把它描述成一条每次都适用的规则——然后检验这条规则在新情况下是否成立。
evidence: Describe a pattern or rule they've noticed in their own words — e.g. 'Every time you add 0 to a number, it stays the same'
Test whether a rule they've described holds for new examples they haven't seen before
Explain the difference between noticing a pattern and proving it always works
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} spots a pattern — like a grammar rule or a number pattern — can they describe it as a general rule and then check whether it works in new examples?

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 从错误中学习
topics.description: 当你做错一件事时，去探究原因——你误解或忽略了什么？分析错误是最有效的学习方式之一。
evidence: error analysis research
Hattie feedback effect size
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} gets something wrong on a test or activity, do they look at the mistake to understand what went wrong — rather than just moving on?

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 技能迁移
topics.description: 认识到在一个学科或情境中学到的技能或策略可以应用到完全不同的学科或情境中
evidence: transfer of learning research
Perkins & Salomon transfer taxonomy
topics.assessmentPrompt: Has {{name}} ever spotted that something they learned in one subject — like a way of organising information — could help them in a completely different one?

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 理解原因
topics.description: 不只知道某件事是真的，还要追问它为什么是真的、它是怎么运作的
evidence: Ask 'why?' or 'how does that work?' about something they've been told, rather than just accepting it
Explain the reason behind a rule or method — e.g. 'We carry the ten because 13 ones is the same as 1 ten and 3 ones'
Show deeper understanding by connecting a new idea to something they already know — e.g. 'Oh, that's like when we...'
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} often ask 'but why?' when they learn a fact — wanting to understand the reason behind it rather than just accepting it?

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 选择学习策略
topics.description: 在开始学习任务前，有意识地选择一种策略；完成之后，诚实地评估这个策略是否真的有用。
evidence: Before starting a task, name the strategy they plan to use and explain why — e.g. 'I'll make a mind map first because there's a lot to organise'
After finishing, honestly evaluate whether their chosen strategy helped or whether a different one would have been better
Describe at least three different learning strategies and explain when each works best
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} ever talk about *how* they're going to study or practise something — and afterwards think about whether that approach worked?

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 学习后的反思
topics.description: 完成一项学习后，反思过程：什么帮助最大，什么让你困惑，下次你会怎么做不同？
evidence: Kolb reflective learning cycle
Hattie & Timperley feedback model
topics.assessmentPrompt: After {{name}} finishes a project or topic at school, do they reflect on how the learning went — not just whether the result was good, but what worked and what didn't?

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 发现知识缺口
topics.description: 审视自己对整个主题的理解——找出哪些地方掌握得扎实，哪些地方还不太确定，以及哪些地方还需要继续努力。
evidence: metacognitive monitoring research
Flavell metacognition framework
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you ask {{name}} how well they understand a whole topic, can they tell you honestly which parts they feel confident on and which parts need more work?

topics.subject: Learning to Learn
topics.name: 设定学习目标
topics.description: 设定一个具体的学习目标，用有计划的方法努力实现它，然后诚实地评估自己是否达成了目标，以及下次会做出哪些改变。
evidence: Set a specific, achievable learning goal for themselves — e.g. 'By Friday I want to know all my 7-times tables' rather than just 'get better at maths'
Make a simple plan for how to reach their goal and follow through on it over several days
After the deadline, honestly assess whether they achieved the goal and describe what they would do differently next time
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} ever set themselves a specific learning goal — like 'I want to get better at times tables by the end of the week' — and then honestly judge whether they met it?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 买家和卖家
topics.description: 当有人制作或拥有某样东西时，他们可以把它卖掉；当有人想要某样东西时，他们可以买下来；介绍交换和交易的概念。
evidence: Explain what a buyer does and what a seller does
Act out a simple buying and selling transaction with a partner
Describe a time they or a family member bought something from a person (market stall, car boot sale, bake sale)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} set up a stall at a school fair, could they explain who the buyers and sellers are and what each person does?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 商品与服务
topics.description: 有些人制作东西（商品），有些人为别人做事（服务）；能在日常生活中识别这两种，并理解它们都有价值。
evidence: Sort a set of pictures into goods (things you can touch) and services (things people do for you)
Give three examples of goods and three examples of services from their everyday life
Explain that both making things and helping people are valuable kinds of work
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you the difference between a product you buy in a shop and a service like getting a haircut, and give examples of each?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 制作东西来卖
topics.description: 制作一个可以出售的产品——手工艺品、绘画、烘焙食品；什么让东西值得购买；为自己制作出别人想要的东西感到自豪。
evidence: Create a simple product (craft, drawing, baked item) that could be sold
Explain what makes their product good enough for someone to want to buy it
Suggest a fair price for their product and give a reason
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} made something at home — like friendship bracelets or decorated biscuits — could they explain why someone might want to buy them?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 谁是顾客？
topics.description: 理解顾客就是购买你制作或提供的产品或服务的人；思考顾客想要什么和需要什么；理解企业是为人们服务的。
evidence: Define what a customer is in their own words
Suggest what a customer might look for when deciding whether to buy something (quality, price, looks nice)
Explain why it matters to think about what the customer wants, not just what you want to make
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} was planning to sell lemonade at a school event, could they think about what would make people want to buy their lemonade rather than someone else's?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 做个好卖家
topics.description: 在生意中做到顾客服务、公平和诚实；对顾客信守承诺；为什么值得信赖对回头客和好名声很重要
evidence: Explain why being honest about what you're selling matters
Describe what good customer service looks like (being polite, helpful, keeping promises)
Give an example of how being unfair or dishonest could hurt a business
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sold something to a friend and it broke the next day, would they understand why it's important to make it right rather than ignore it?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 成本与收入
topics.description: 做东西需要花钱（成本/费用）；卖东西可以赚钱（收入）；如果收入大于成本，就是盈利；如果成本大于收入，就是亏损。
evidence: Explain what costs, revenue, and profit mean using a simple example
Calculate profit from a given scenario (e.g. spent £3 on ingredients, sold cakes for £8, profit = £5)
Explain what happens if costs are higher than revenue (you make a loss)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} spent £4 on supplies for a lemonade stand and earned £10 selling lemonade, could they tell you how much profit they made?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 拥有商业点子
topics.description: 商业点子从哪里来；发现日常问题并思考解决方案；发明新事物与改进现有事物的区别
evidence: Identify a simple everyday problem and suggest a product or service that could solve it
Explain the difference between an invention (something new) and an innovation (making something better)
Describe where one real entrepreneur got their business idea from
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you asked {{name}} to think of a problem at school or home that they could solve by making or selling something, could they come up with an idea?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 从失败中学习
topics.description: 不是每个商业想法都能成功；企业家会尝试、失败、学习，然后再尝试；迭代和韧性是核心创业技能；著名的从失败到成功的故事
evidence: Give an example of a famous entrepreneur who failed before succeeding
Explain what they would do differently if a business idea didn't work the first time
Describe why failing and trying again is better than giving up
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}}'s first attempt at a project or business idea didn't work out, would they see it as a chance to improve rather than a reason to give up?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 制定简单计划
topics.description: 在开始做生意之前，制定一个简单的计划：我要做什么或提供什么服务？谁会来买？我需要什么？成本是多少？我打算卖多少钱？
evidence: Write or draw a simple business plan covering: product, customer, materials needed, and price
Identify at least three things they would need before they could start selling
Explain why planning ahead is better than just starting without thinking
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} wanted to run a small business at a school fair, could they write a simple plan covering what they'd sell, what they'd need, and what they'd charge?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 营销基础
topics.description: 人们如何知道你卖的东西；招牌、海报、社交媒体、口口相传；如何说服别人；广告和促销的基础知识
evidence: Design a simple poster or advert for a product or service
Name at least three ways to let people know about something you're selling
Explain why a catchy name or eye-catching design helps sell more
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} wanted to advertise a car wash or bake sale, could they design a poster that would make people want to come?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 商业中的团队合作
topics.description: 大多数企业需要不止一个人；一起工作、分工合作、发挥不同人的长处；团队合作在商业中的价值。
evidence: Describe how they would divide tasks in a team business project (one person makes, one sells, one designs)
Explain why using people's different strengths makes a business better
Give an example of a problem that could happen if a team doesn't work well together
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} was working with friends to run a stall at a fair, could they suggest how to divide up the jobs so everyone plays to their strengths?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 商业道德
topics.description: 诚实守信、公平待人、善待员工、不破坏环境；什么是‘好’企业；企业是否应该不仅仅关心利润
evidence: Name at least two things that make a business ethical (fair wages, honest advertising, environmentally responsible)
Explain why a business that only cares about profit might cause problems
Describe a situation where a business owner faces an ethical choice and suggest what they should do
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} heard about a company paying its workers very little to make bigger profits, could they explain why that's unfair and suggest a better approach?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 推销创意
topics.description: 有说服力地向他人展示商业创意；解释它的优点以及为什么人们应该支持它；在公开演讲中建立自信。
evidence: Deliver a 1-2 minute pitch for a business idea covering: what it is, who it helps, and why it's good
Answer at least two questions about their idea from an audience
Explain why being able to explain your idea clearly matters for getting support
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} had to stand up in front of the class and explain a business idea in two minutes, could they do it confidently and persuasively?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 真正的企业家
topics.description: 从小创业的真实企业家的故事：米凯拉·乌尔默（Me & the Bees）、莫西亚·布里奇斯（Mo's Bows）、科里·涅韦斯（Mr. Cory's Cookies）；是什么让一个人成为企业家
evidence: Retell the story of at least one real entrepreneur who started as a child
Identify three qualities that helped that entrepreneur succeed (creativity, persistence, passion)
Explain what the word 'entrepreneur' means in their own words
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you about a real person who started a business as a kid and explain what qualities helped them succeed?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 扩大规模
topics.description: 当小生意成长时会发生什么；生产更多产品、雇佣更多人、接触更多顾客；扩大规模的挑战和机会
evidence: Describe what 'scaling up' means for a business
Identify at least two challenges of growing a business (need more money, more people, more materials)
Explain how a lemonade stand could grow into a bigger business step by step
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain what would need to change if their small school-fair business became so popular that lots more people wanted to buy from them?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 社会企业
topics.description: 用商业技能帮助他人或解决社会和环境问题；既能赚钱又能带来改变；社会企业的例子
evidence: Explain what a social enterprise is in their own words (a business that helps people or the planet)
Give an example of a real social enterprise or charity shop
Suggest a social enterprise idea that could help their school or community
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} come up with an idea for a business that both makes money and helps people or the environment?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 供应链
topics.description: 产品在到达顾客手中之前来自哪里；原材料、制造、运输和销售；一个产品从开始到结束的旅程
evidence: Trace the journey of a familiar product (e.g. chocolate bar) from raw material to shop shelf
Identify at least three stages in a supply chain
Explain why a long supply chain can make a product more expensive
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you asked {{name}} how a chocolate bar gets from a cocoa farm to a shop shelf, could they describe the main steps in the journey?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 买东西
topics.description: 买卖是怎么进行的：价格、付钱、找零；在商店和市场里基本的交易过程
evidence: Explain what happens when you buy something in a shop (choose, pay, get change)
Read a price label and say whether they have enough money to buy the item
Act out a simple buying scenario using real or play coins
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} had a £2 coin and wanted to buy a snack for 80p, could they work out roughly how much change they'd get back?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 硬币与纸币
topics.description: 认识常见的硬币和纸币，知道它们的价值，并理解不同的组合可以凑成相同的金额。
evidence: Sort a handful of mixed coins into groups by value
State the value of common coins and notes when shown them
Find two different ways to make the same amount using different coins
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you tipped out a jar of coins, could {{name}} sort them and tell you how much each type is worth?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 人们做的工作
topics.description: 人们从事的各种工作；人们通过工作赚钱；工作如何帮助社区；将个人兴趣与可能的工作联系起来
evidence: Name at least five different jobs and describe what each person does
Explain that people get paid money for the work they do
Connect a personal interest to a job (e.g. 'I like animals so I could be a vet')
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} tell you about different jobs people do in your community and explain that people get paid for their work?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 保管好钱
topics.description: 把金钱保管好；不弄丢硬币或纸币；明白金钱有真实价值，应该小心对待；基本的金钱责任感
evidence: Describe at least two ways to keep money safe (purse, wallet, money box, giving to a grown-up)
Explain why it matters if you lose money
Show that they treat real coins and notes carefully rather than leaving them lying around
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you gave {{name}} some coins to look after at a shop, would they keep them safe and know where they put them?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 需要和想要
topics.description: 我们需要的东西（食物、住所、衣服）和我们想要的东西（玩具、零食）之间的区别；因为钱是有限的，我们有时必须做出选择。
evidence: Sort a set of pictures into 'need' and 'want' categories and explain their choices
Give an example of something everyone needs and something that is a want
Explain why a family might choose to buy a need before a want
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you showed {{name}} pictures of a winter coat, a toy robot, and a loaf of bread, could they tell you which ones are needs and which is a want?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 存钱
topics.description: 人们为什么要存钱；存钱罐和储蓄罐；设定一个储蓄目标；现在不花意味着以后有更多
evidence: Explain why someone might save money instead of spending it straight away
Describe a savings goal they could set and how they would work towards it
Tell you what delayed gratification means in their own words (waiting to get something better)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} received some birthday money, could they explain why it might be smart to save some of it rather than spending it all at once?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 认识钱是什么
topics.description: 了解钱是什么以及我们为什么要用钱；钱可以用来交换商品和服务；从物物交换到硬币再到数字支付的简要历史
evidence: Explain that people use money to pay for things they need or want
Give an example of how buying worked before money existed (swapping or bartering)
Name at least two forms money can take (coins, notes, card, phone payment)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you asked {{name}} why people use money instead of just swapping things, could they give you a sensible answer?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 广告与消费
topics.description: 广告如何试图影响我们购买什么；做一个有判断力的消费者；理解“物有所值”；情感消费与理性消费的区别。
evidence: Spot at least two persuasion techniques in a real advert (bright colours, celebrity, special offer)
Explain what 'value for money' means and compare two similar products at different prices
Describe a time when advertising made them want something they didn't really need
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} sees an advert for a toy or game, can they recognise that the advert is trying to make them want to buy it?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 银行与储蓄
topics.description: 银行是做什么的，人们为什么使用银行；银行账户是存钱的安全地方；存在银行里的钱可以获得利息；儿童储蓄账户
evidence: Explain what a bank does in simple terms (keeps money safe, lets you save)
Describe what interest means (the bank pays you a little extra for keeping money there)
Name one reason a bank account is safer than keeping all your money at home
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain what a bank does and why people put their money there instead of keeping it all at home?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 零花钱预算
topics.description: 什么是预算；计划如何花掉固定数额的零花钱；在你想要买的不同东西之间做出取舍
evidence: Create a simple spending plan for £10 showing what they would buy and how much is left
Explain what a budget is and why it helps to plan spending
Identify a trade-off (choosing one thing means not having enough for another)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} had £10 to spend at a school fair, could they plan in advance what to spend it on so the money lasts?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 赚钱
topics.description: 儿童和成人赚钱的方式；工作、技能与报酬之间的联系；通常越辛苦或技能要求越高的工作，报酬也越高。
evidence: Name at least three different ways people can earn money
Explain why a doctor might earn more than a shop assistant (training, skills, responsibility)
Describe a way a child could earn money (chores, car wash, selling crafts)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain why some jobs pay more than others and describe a way they might earn some money themselves?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 公平贸易与道德
topics.description: 了解产品来自哪里、由谁制造；世界各地的人们生产我们购买的东西；工人应获得公平报酬；作为消费者做出有道德的选择
evidence: Explain that the things we buy are made by real people, sometimes in other countries
Describe what 'fair trade' means in simple terms (workers get paid fairly)
Give an example of a kind choice a shopper could make (buying fair trade chocolate, choosing less packaging)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} saw a Fairtrade logo on a chocolate bar, could they explain what it means and why it matters?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 找零钱
topics.description: 计算购物后的找零；自信地处理英镑和便士的混合运算；解决涉及加法和减法的实际金钱问题
evidence: Calculate the change from £5 when buying items costing pounds and pence
Add two or three prices together to find a total cost
Check whether they have been given the correct change in a role-play scenario
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} bought a comic for £2.75 and paid with a £5 note, could they work out they should get £2.25 back?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 支付方式
topics.description: 不同的支付方式：现金、借记卡、非接触式支付、在线支付、移动支付；数字支付仍然使用真实的钱；保护支付信息的安全
evidence: Name at least four different ways people can pay for things
Explain that tapping a card or phone still spends real money from a bank account
Give one reason why you should keep card numbers and passwords private
topics.assessmentPrompt: Does {{name}} understand that when you tap a card or use a phone to pay, real money leaves your bank account even though you can't see coins changing hands?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 借钱与债务
topics.description: 借钱是什么意思；贷款必须连本带利还清；什么是信用；为什么债务太多会有风险；负责任地借钱
evidence: Explain what a loan is and that borrowed money must be paid back with extra (interest)
Give an example of when borrowing might be sensible (buying a house) versus risky (buying luxuries you can't afford)
Describe what happens if someone borrows too much money and can't repay it
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain why borrowing money costs more than the amount you borrow, and why that matters?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 财务规划
topics.description: 设定较长期的财务目标；规划和优先安排支出；定期储蓄如何随时间累积；用钱时提前思考的价值
evidence: Set a realistic savings goal and calculate how long it would take saving a fixed amount each week
Create a simple financial plan for a specific purpose (birthday party, school trip, gift)
Explain why planning ahead with money is better than spending everything as it comes in
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} wanted to save up for something costing £30, could they work out a realistic plan for how long it would take?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 全球贸易
topics.description: 为什么国家之间要进行贸易；进口和出口；商品如何在全球流动；不同国家使用不同的货币
evidence: Explain why countries buy goods from other countries (they can't make everything themselves)
Give examples of imported and exported products from their own country
Explain that different countries use different currencies and you need to exchange money when travelling
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} looked at the labels on items in your kitchen, could they explain why so many things come from different countries?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 经济是如何运行的
topics.description: 什么是经济；生产者和消费者；供给与需求；价格为什么会变化；市场如何运行的基础知识
evidence: Explain what 'supply and demand' means using a simple example (ice cream on a hot day)
Describe the difference between a producer and a consumer
Give a reason why the price of something might go up or down
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain why ice cream might cost more at the beach in summer than at a supermarket in winter?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 诈骗与网络安全
topics.description: 识别金融诈骗和骗局；钓鱼邮件和虚假网站；在网上保护个人和财务信息；‘如果好得不像真的，那很可能就是假的’
evidence: Identify at least two warning signs of a scam (asking for personal details, too-good-to-be-true offers, urgency)
Explain why you should never share passwords or bank details online
Describe what to do if they receive a suspicious message or email (don't click, tell an adult)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} received a message saying they'd won a prize and just needed to enter their details, would they know it's probably a scam?

topics.subject: Life Skills
topics.name: 税收与公共服务
topics.description: 什么是税收，人们为什么要交税；税收如何为学校、医院、道路和紧急服务提供资金；政府决定如何使用税收。
evidence: Explain what tax is and that most working adults pay it
Name at least three things that taxes pay for (schools, hospitals, roads, police, fire service)
Describe why taxes are needed (everyone chips in so everyone benefits)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Could {{name}} explain where the money comes from to pay for things like schools and hospitals that everyone uses?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 加减法应用题
topics.description: 使用实物或图画解决10以内的加减法应用题
evidence: Solve 'There are 6 apples, 2 are eaten, how many left?' using counters
Solve 'add to' and 'take from' result-unknown problems
Solve 'put together/take apart' problems with total unknown

evidence: Correctly compute 3.45 + 2.78 and explain regrouping across decimal places
Use a number line or base-ten blocks to model 5.03 − 2.67
Explain why the standard algorithm works for decimal addition by connecting to place-value understanding
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} add or subtract decimal amounts like '4.73 + 2.68' or '10.00 − 3.47', lining up the decimal points and working through the columns correctly?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 正数和负数
topics.description: 理解正数和负数表示具有相反方向或值的量；在温度、楼层和银行余额等情境中运用它们。
evidence: Represent positive and negative numbers on a number line and explain what zero means in context
Add a positive or negative number to any integer using number line reasoning
Subtract a positive or negative number from any integer, understanding that subtracting a negative is equivalent to adding
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees temperatures like −3°C and +5°C on a weather forecast, can they figure out how much warmer one day is than the other — even when the answer crosses zero?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 二元方程
topics.description: 找出满足含有两个未知数的方程的数对（例如，找出所有满足 a + b = 10 或 2a + b = 15 的数对 (a, b)）
evidence: List all whole-number pairs (a, b) where a + b = 12 with a, b > 0
Find three pairs that satisfy 2x + y = 20
Explain systematically how to generate all integer solutions to a two-variable equation within a given range
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} find different pairs of numbers that both satisfy a rule — for example, all the pairs of whole numbers that add up to 10?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 线性数列
topics.description: 生成并描述线性数列，包括步长为负数和小数的数列；找出相邻两项之间的规律。
evidence: Continue the sequence 2.5, 4.0, 5.5, ... and state the rule as 'add 1.5'
Generate terms of a sequence that crosses zero (e.g. 3, 1, −1, −3, ...)
Describe the term-to-term rule for a given linear sequence and predict the 10th term
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees a number sequence like 3, 7, 11, 15… can they describe the rule, continue it, and predict what the 10th number will be?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数字规律关系
topics.description: 根据两个给定的规则生成两个数字序列；找出对应项之间的关系；组成有序数对并在坐标平面上绘制图形
evidence: Generate sequences starting at 0 with rules 'add 3' and 'add 6'; observe terms in one are twice the other
Form ordered pairs from corresponding terms and plot them on a coordinate grid
Explain informally why the relationship between the two sequences holds
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} follow two number patterns at once — for example, "add 2" and "add 4" — pair up the matching terms, and plot those pairs as points on a graph?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 系统列举
topics.description: 系统地列举两个变量的所有可能组合（例如，从一组选项中选出的所有方式）
evidence: List all possible meal combinations from 3 starters and 4 mains
Organise combinations into a systematic table to ensure none are missed
Explain why the total number of combinations equals the product of the options in each category
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} can choose any combination of 3 T-shirt colours and 2 trouser colours, can they list every possible outfit without missing any or repeating?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 使用简单公式
topics.description: 使用文字或符号表示的简单公式来计算数值（例如：周长 = 2 × (长 + 宽)）
evidence: Substitute values into P = 2(l + w) to find the perimeter of a rectangle
Use the formula for area of a triangle (A = 1/2 × b × h) given base and height values
Interpret a formula expressed in words and use it to compute an output
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is told that the perimeter of a rectangle uses the formula perimeter = 2 × (length + width), can they plug in the measurements and work out the answer?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 用代数式表示未知数
topics.description: 用字母表示未知数，把含有未知数的实际问题写成代数式；把文字题翻译成方程
evidence: Write 'I think of a number, double it, and add 5 to get 17' as 2n + 5 = 17
Solve a one-step equation such as 3x = 24 and explain the reasoning
Express a word problem as an algebraic equation and find the unknown value
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} reads "I think of a number, double it, and add 5 to get 17," can they write that as an equation using a letter for the unknown and solve it?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 代数符号
topics.description: 使用并理解代数符号，包括：ab表示a×b，3y表示y+y+y，a²表示a×a，a/b表示a÷b，分数形式的系数，以及用括号分组；能够流畅地读写代数表达式。
evidence: Read and interpret expressions using standard algebraic conventions for multiplication, division, and powers
Write algebraic expressions from word descriptions using correct notation
Understand that juxtaposition means multiplication and that a/b means a divided by b
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} sees something written as "3y" or "a²" in a maths problem, do they know what those shorthand notations mean and can they work with them?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 代数变换
topics.description: 通过将情境或过程转化为代数表达式或公式，并利用图表来建立模型；在文字问题、代数表示、表格和图形表示之间灵活转换。
evidence: Translate a word problem or real-world situation into an algebraic expression or formula
Construct a table of values from an algebraic rule
Plot the corresponding graph and interpret it in the context of the problem
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} take a real-world situation — like a taxi that charges £2 plus £1.50 per mile — and write an algebraic formula for the total cost, then sketch what the graph looks like?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 合并同类项
topics.description: 通过合并同类项来简化代数表达式——将具有相同变量和指数的项合并（例如，3a + 2b + 5a = 8a + 2b），同时保持等价性。
evidence: Identify like terms in an algebraic expression
Combine like terms involving positive and negative coefficients
Simplify expressions involving multiple variables and constant terms
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees an expression like "5a + 3b + 2a," can they simplify it by collecting the like terms to get "7a + 3b"?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 坐标（11岁以上）
topics.description: 在笛卡尔平面的四个象限中绘制和读取坐标，使用正数和负数的x值和y值来精确描述位置。
evidence: Plot points with negative coordinates accurately in all four quadrants
Identify the quadrant a point belongs to from its coordinate signs
Read coordinates from a graph including fractional and negative values
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} plot a point like (−3, 4) correctly on a coordinate grid and read the coordinates of points in all four quadrants, including negative numbers?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 展开单项式乘括号
topics.description: 使用分配律将单项式乘到括号内的每一项，例如：3(2x + 5) = 6x + 15；展开含有负系数的表达式。
evidence: Multiply a single positive term over a bracket to expand the expression
Multiply a negative term over a bracket, correctly handling signs
Combine expanding brackets with collecting like terms to simplify fully
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} expand a bracket like 3(2x + 5) by multiplying everything inside, to get 6x + 15?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 表达式与方程词汇
topics.description: 理解并使用表达式、方程、不等式、项和因式的概念和词汇；区分表达式（没有等号）、方程（有等号）和不等式（有不等号）
evidence: Define and distinguish between expression, equation, and inequality
Identify terms, coefficients, and factors in algebraic expressions
Use the vocabulary of algebra precisely in mathematical discussions
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} explain the difference between an expression like "3x + 2," an equation like "3x + 2 = 11," and an inequality like "3x + 2 > 11"?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 生成数列
topics.description: 根据项与项之间的规则（如“每次加3”）或位置与项的规则（如“2n + 1”）生成数列的项，并判断数列是等差数列、等比数列还是两者都不是
evidence: Continue a sequence given a term-to-term rule involving addition, subtraction, or multiplication
Generate the first five terms from a position-to-term formula such as 3n − 2
Classify sequences as arithmetic (constant difference), geometric (constant ratio), or other
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} work out the next few terms of a sequence like 5, 8, 11, 14… and explain whether the rule is "add a fixed number each time" or something else?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数轴上的数
topics.description: 理解不等式作为比较表达式的陈述，在数轴上表示解集，并像解方程一样使用逆运算方法解简单的一元一次不等式。
evidence: Write an inequality from a worded constraint (e.g., 'must be at least 12' → x ≥ 12)
Represent the solution set of an inequality on a number line with open or closed circles
Solve a one-step or two-step inequality such as 3x + 1 < 10
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} solve an inequality like 2x + 1 < 9, show the answer on a number line, and explain what all the solutions have in common?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 解一元一次方程
topics.description: 使用代数方法解一元一次方程，包括需要移项、展开括号、合并同类项的方程；解系数为有理数的方程
evidence: Solve one-step and two-step linear equations in one variable
Solve equations requiring expansion of brackets and collection of like terms
Solve equations with the unknown on both sides and with fractional or negative coefficients
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is given an equation like 3x + 7 = 22, can they work through the steps to find the value of x?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 代入公式
topics.description: 将数值代入公式和表达式（包括科学公式）；通过用给定值替换变量并按照正确的运算顺序计算结果来求表达式的值。
evidence: Substitute positive and negative values into algebraic expressions and evaluate
Substitute values into formulae involving multiple operations and powers
Use correct order of operations when evaluating expressions after substitution
topics.assessmentPrompt: If a formula says that the area of a triangle is ½ × base × height, can {{name}} substitute in the measurements and calculate the answer correctly?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 因式分解表达式
topics.description: 通过提取公因式来因式分解代数表达式——找出所有项的最高公因式，并将表达式写成乘积形式，例如：6x + 9 = 3(2x + 3)
evidence: Identify the highest common factor of all terms in an expression
Write the factorised form as a product of the HCF and a bracket
Check factorisation by expanding the brackets back out
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} look at an expression like "6x + 9" and rewrite it with the common factor taken out — as "3(2x + 3)"?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 一次函数图像
topics.description: 认识一次函数的图像是一条直线，理解形如 y = mx + c 的方程与其图像之间的关系，并在实际情境中解释斜率和 y 轴截距的意义。
evidence: Explain that changing m in y = mx + c alters the steepness and direction of the line
Identify the y-intercept of a line from its equation and from its graph
Determine whether a given equation will produce a straight line or a curve
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees the equation y = 2x + 3, can they explain what the graph will look like — including how steep it is and where it crosses the y-axis?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 第n项公式
topics.description: 通过找出等差数列的公差和第0项，求出第n项的表达式，并用它来确定数列中的任意一项，或检验某个给定的数是否属于该数列。
evidence: Derive the nth-term rule for an arithmetic sequence such as 3, 7, 11, 15, … as 4n − 1
Use an nth-term formula to find the 50th or 100th term without listing all preceding terms
Determine whether a given number (e.g., 99) is a term in a specified arithmetic sequence
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is given the sequence 4, 7, 10, 13…, can they find a formula for the nth term — and use it to check whether, say, 100 is in the sequence?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 绘制线性图像
topics.description: 通过生成数值表来绘制线性图像，将二元一次方程化简为 y = mx + c 的形式，并根据直线上的两点计算斜率
evidence: Generate a table of (x, y) values for a linear equation and plot the points accurately
Rearrange an equation such as 2x + 3y = 12 into the form y = mx + c
Calculate the gradient between two coordinate points using rise over run
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} draw the graph of a straight line by making a table of values and plotting the points — and work out the gradient from two points on the line?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 简单公式
topics.description: 理解并使用标准数学公式；通过逆运算重新排列公式，改变主项，从而分离出不同的变量。
evidence: Identify the subject of a given formula
Use inverse operations to rearrange a formula to make a different variable the subject
Rearrange formulae involving multiple steps including fractions and powers
topics.assessmentPrompt: If a formula gives speed as distance ÷ time, can {{name}} rearrange it to find distance or time when they're the unknowns instead?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 估算答案（13岁以上）
topics.description: 利用线性函数和二次函数的图像，根据给定的输入值估算输出值，求方程的近似解，并在实际情境中解读图形信息。
evidence: Read off an approximate y-value for a given x from a plotted curve
Find approximate solutions to an equation by identifying where a graph crosses the x-axis or another line
Interpret a real-world graph (e.g., distance–time) to answer contextual questions
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} use a graph — whether a straight line or a curve — to read off an answer to an equation approximately, rather than solving it algebraically?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 展开双括号
topics.description: 使用网格法或FOIL法展开两个或多个二项式的乘积，例如 (x + 3)(x - 2) = x² + x - 6；通过合并同类项简化结果。
evidence: Expand the product of two binomials using a systematic method (grid or FOIL)
Collect like terms after expansion to simplify the result
Expand products involving negative terms correctly
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} multiply out two brackets like (x + 3)(x − 2) and collect the terms to get x² + x − 6?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 二次函数图像
topics.description: 认识二次函数产生曲线（抛物线）图像，将其与直线图像区分，并利用绘制的二次函数图像估计数值和寻找近似解。
evidence: Explain why x² produces a U-shaped curve rather than a straight line
Plot a simple quadratic such as y = x² − 4 from a table of values
Read approximate solutions from a quadratic graph (e.g., where y = 0)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} recognise that an equation like y = x² produces a curved graph rather than a straight line, and use a plotted curve to estimate values?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 联立方程
topics.description: 理解两个线性方程可以通过找到它们图像的交点来同时求解，并从图形和代数角度解释这组值同时满足两个方程。
evidence: Explain that the intersection of two lines represents values satisfying both equations
Find the approximate solution to a pair of simultaneous equations by reading a graph
Verify a proposed solution by substituting into both equations
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} explain that solving two equations simultaneously means finding the one pair of values that satisfies both at once — and show what that looks like on a graph?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 比较数量：更多或更少
topics.description: 通过一一对应和数数的方法，比较两组物品，判断哪组更多、哪组更少，或者两组一样多。
evidence: Use one-to-one matching to compare two groups
State which group has more/fewer after counting both
Use the language 'equal to', 'more than', 'less than', 'fewer', 'most', 'least'
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you put 6 raisins in one hand and 4 in the other and ask {{name}} which hand has more, can they work it out — either by counting or just by looking?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 一共有多少？
topics.description: 基数原则：数一组物体时，最后说出的数字就是这组物体的总数，无论怎么排列或按什么顺序数。
evidence: After counting a set, answer 'how many?' with the last number stated
Understand that rearranging objects does not change the count
Understand that counting in a different order gives the same total
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} counts out 7 toy cars and you ask "so how many cars are there?", do they say "7" straight away — or do they count them all again from the start?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 每次多一个
topics.description: 每一个后续的计数数字都表示比前一个数字大1的数量。
evidence: Given a set of 5, know that adding one object makes 6
Explain that 8 is one more than 7
Given a number, identify one more and one less
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} has 5 stickers and you give them one more, do they know immediately there are now 6 — without needing to count all of them again from one?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 一一对应计数
topics.description: 在数物体时进行一一对应：每个物体恰好对应一个数字名称
evidence: Point to or touch each object exactly once while saying number names
Do not skip objects or double-count when counting a set
Recognise an error when someone counts an object twice
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is counting a pile of grapes, do they touch or point to each one exactly once as they say each number — without skipping any or counting the same one twice?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 用实物表示数字
topics.description: 用实物、图画和数轴来表示数字
evidence: Show a given number using counters, cubes, or fingers
Draw a pictorial representation of a quantity (e.g. tally marks, dots)
Locate a number on a number line
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you ask {{name}} to show you what the number 5 looks like, can they do it in more than one way — such as drawing five dots, holding up five fingers, or pointing to 5 on a number line?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 两个两个数
topics.description: 按2、5、10的倍数数数（跳着数）
evidence: Count 2, 4, 6, 8 … up to at least 20
Count 5, 10, 15, 20 … up to at least 50
Count 10, 20, 30 … up to 100
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is counting socks being paired up, can they skip-count in twos — 2, 4, 6, 8 — all the way to 20? Can they also count up in fives when counting coins, or in tens on a number line?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数到20个物体
topics.description: 数一组物体，回答“有多少？”的问题，数量最多20个（排列成直线、阵列、圆形或散乱摆放）
evidence: Accurately count up to 20 objects in a line
Count up to 10 scattered objects without losing track
Given a number 1–20, count out that many objects from a larger set
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you spread out 15 buttons on the table in a random arrangement and ask {{name}} how many there are, can they count them all carefully and give you the right answer?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 从0到100的机械数数
topics.description: 从0、1或任意给定的数字开始，以1为单位，正向和反向从0数到100。
evidence: Recite the number sequence 1–100 without skipping or repeating
Count backward from 20 to 0
Count forward starting from a number other than 1 (e.g. 'start at 23')
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} count out loud all the way from 0 to 100 — and if you say "start from 47", can they carry on from there without going back to the beginning?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 比较1到10之间的两个数字
topics.description: 比较1到10之间的两个书面数字，判断哪个更大或更小
evidence: Given two written numerals (e.g. 4 and 7), identify which is greater
Correctly use > and < or 'greater than' / 'less than' to compare single-digit numerals
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you write "3" and "8" on two pieces of paper and ask {{name}} which number is bigger, can they get it right — and could they tell you why?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 顺数和倒数
topics.description: 从0开始，以3为单位顺数和倒数
evidence: Count 3, 6, 9, 12, 15 … up to at least 30
Count backwards in 3s from 30
Identify the next number in a sequence of multiples of 3
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} count in threes — 3, 6, 9, 12, 15 — far enough to reach 30 without losing track or needing to start over?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 顺数和倒数（6岁以上）
topics.description: 从任意数开始，以10为单位进行顺数和倒数（不限于10的倍数）
evidence: Count 7, 17, 27, 37 … from a non-multiple starting point
Count backwards in tens from 83
Explain the pattern of adding/subtracting 10
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} starts at 37 and you ask them to count up in tens, can they say 37, 47, 57, 67 — crossing over into the next hundred without getting stuck?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 1000以内的数数
topics.description: 在1000以内数数，包括5个5个、10个10个和100个100个地跳着数
evidence: Count forwards and backwards within 1000 from any starting number
Skip-count by 5s from any multiple of 5 to 1000
Skip-count by 100s from any number (e.g. 150, 250, 350 …)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} count confidently up to 1000 — and if you ask them to count by hundreds from 200, or by tens from 650, can they do it without losing their place?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 跳跃计数（4、8、50、100）
topics.description: 从0开始，按4、8、50和100的倍数计数
evidence: Recite the multiples of 4 from 0 to at least 48
Recite the multiples of 8 from 0 to at least 96
Count in steps of 50 and 100 from 0 to 1000
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} count in fours all the way to 48, count in eights, or count up in hundreds from any starting point — for example 350, 450, 550?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 6的倍数计数
evidence: Recite the multiples of 6 from 0 to at least 72
Recite the multiples of 7 from 0 to at least 84
Count in steps of 25 from 0 to 1000 and in steps of 1000 up to 10,000
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} count in sevens — 7, 14, 21, 28 — or in nines, or in 25s when thinking about coins, or in 1000s when talking about distances like kilometres?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 按类别分类
topics.description: 将物体归入指定类别，数出每个类别中的数量，并按数量对类别进行排序。
evidence: Sort a set of shapes by colour and count how many in each group
Sort objects by size (big/small) and state how many in each category
Identify which category has the most/fewest after sorting and counting
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} sort a pile of objects — like buttons, coins, or toy animals — into groups and count how many are in each group?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 象形图和计数图表
topics.description: 解读和构建简单的象形图、计数图表、方块图和简单表格
evidence: Read a pictogram where each symbol represents one item
Construct a tally chart from collected data
Draw a block diagram to represent data from a survey
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} read a simple chart or pictogram — like one showing how many children chose each favourite fruit — and answer questions like "which was most popular"?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 象形图和计数表（6岁以上）
topics.description: 阅读、书写和使用数据收集与展示的词汇——数据、计数、计数表、频数、频数表、调查、象形图、条形图、轴、刻度、标签、类别、离散数据、连续数据、折线图、饼图——并在收集、整理和呈现数据时应用这些术语。
evidence: Correctly label the axes of a bar chart including a title, axis labels, and scale
Distinguish between discrete data (counted) and continuous data (measured) with an example of each
Use 'tally', 'frequency', and 'pictogram' correctly when describing how to record and display data
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} wanted to show you how many books different children in their class read last month, could they draw a bar chart, label the axes, and explain what each bar represents?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 将数据分类整理
topics.description: 通过数出每个类别中物体的数量，并按数量对类别进行排序，来整理和表示最多三个类别的数据。
evidence: Sort a set of objects into 2-3 given categories and count each group
Create a simple table or list showing category names and counts
Order categories from most to fewest or fewest to most
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} look at a collection of objects — like different coloured counters — sort them into up to three groups, count each group, and organise the results into a simple chart?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分类整理（6岁以上）
topics.description: 通过提问和回答关于总数、每个类别有多少、以及一个类别比另一个类别多多少或少多少的问题，来解读分类数据
evidence: Answer 'how many?' for each category in a data set
Calculate the total number of data points across all categories
Compare two categories using 'how many more/fewer' language
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} looks at a chart showing how many children chose each flavour of ice cream, can they answer questions like "how many chose chocolate?" and "how many more chose vanilla than strawberry?"

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 象形图和条形图
topics.description: 绘制象形图和条形图（以单个单位为一个刻度）来表示最多包含四个类别的数据集；利用条形图中的信息解决合并、拆分和比较问题。
evidence: Draw a picture graph with a symbol representing one unit for each data point
Draw a bar graph with labelled axes and a single-unit scale
Use a bar graph to answer comparison questions (e.g. 'How many more votes did cats get than dogs?')
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} draw a simple bar chart or picture graph to show information — like how many of each colour of sweet are in a bag — and answer questions from it?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 条形图
topics.description: 使用合适的图形方法（包括条形图和时间图）解读和呈现离散数据和连续数据
evidence: Read a time graph showing temperature changes over a day
Present data about plant growth over weeks as a time graph
Explain the difference between a bar chart (discrete) and a time graph (continuous)
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} choose the right type of chart for some data — for example, a bar chart for favourite colours or a line graph for temperature over a week — and draw it correctly?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 用图形表示数量（8岁以上）
topics.description: 绘制带比例的象形统计图和条形统计图来表示一组数据；利用条形图、象形图和表格解决一步和两步的比较、求和及求差问题。
evidence: Draw a bar graph where each square represents 5 pets
From a scaled pictogram, answer: how many more children chose football than tennis?
Solve a two-step problem: how many votes in total for the top two choices?
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} looked at a bar chart showing how many books different children read last month, could they work out the total, find the difference between the most and least, and draw their own chart with a scale like "each square = 2 books"?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 阅读和比较条形图
topics.description: 利用条形图中的信息解决比较、求和和求差问题
evidence: Read a line graph of temperature over a week and identify the warmest day
Find the difference in rainfall between two months from a line graph
Explain what a rising/falling line means on a time-series graph
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees a line graph showing how a plant's height changed over several weeks, can they read off values, spot when it grew fastest, and find the difference between two points?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 阅读表格
topics.description: 完成、阅读并解释表格中的信息，包括时间表
evidence: Read a bus timetable to find the departure time for a particular stop
Complete a two-way table from given data about favourite sports by gender
Calculate how long a train journey takes using a timetable
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} read a timetable — like a train or bus timetable — to find out when a journey leaves, arrives, and how long it takes?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 统计分析词汇
topics.description: 阅读、书写并使用统计分析词汇——平均数、中位数、众数、极差、频数、数据、样本、平均值、图表、表格、图形、饼图、散点图、相关性——并理解每个术语所描述的内容。
evidence: Correctly define and calculate the mean, median, mode, and range of a small data set
Use 'outlier' correctly to identify a value that doesn't fit the pattern, and explain its effect on the mean
Use 'correlation' correctly when describing the relationship shown in a scatter graph
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} looked at a set of test scores from their class, could they find the mean, the median, and the range — and explain what each one tells you about how the class did?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 计算平均数
topics.description: 计算并理解平均数作为数据集的平均值
evidence: Calculate the mean of five test scores: 72, 85, 90, 68, 95
Explain what the mean represents and how it differs from individual data values
Find a missing data value given the mean and all other values
topics.assessmentPrompt: If the family scored 6, 8, 7, 5, and 9 on a board game over five rounds, can {{name}} work out the mean (average) score?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 折线图（10岁以上）
topics.description: 解读和绘制饼图与折线图；用它们来解决问题
evidence: Read values from a line graph showing temperature over a day and identify trends
Construct a pie chart from given data by calculating sector angles
Use a pie chart to determine the actual quantity represented by each sector given the total
topics.assessmentPrompt: Can {{name}} read a pie chart — for example, one showing how a family spends its weekly budget — and use it to answer questions and solve problems?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 理解分数
topics.description: 制作线形图来展示以分数单位（1/2、1/4、1/8）表示的测量数据集；运用分数运算解决涉及线形图中数据的问题（例如将总量平均重新分配）
evidence: Create a line plot showing lengths measured to the nearest 1/8 inch
Use the line plot to find the total of all measurements by adding fractions
Solve: 'If the total liquid were redistributed equally among all beakers, how much would each have?'
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} measured the lengths of several objects to the nearest quarter or eighth of an inch and plotted them on a number line, could they use those measurements to work out totals or share amounts equally?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 比较测量值
topics.description: 使用适当的集中趋势度量（平均数、中位数、众数）和离散程度度量（极差）来描述、解释和比较单变量分布，包括异常值的影响。
evidence: Calculate mean, median, and mode for a data set and explain when each is most appropriate
Find the range of a data set and explain how an outlier affects the mean versus the median
Compare two data sets using their averages and ranges to draw conclusions
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} had the test scores of a whole class, could they find the mean, median, and range, and explain what each tells you about how the class performed?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 象形图和计数图表（11岁以上）
topics.description: 针对分类数据和分组数值数据，构建并解读频数表、条形图、饼图、象形图和垂直线图，并根据数据类型选择合适的表示方法。
evidence: Construct a grouped frequency table from raw continuous data, choosing appropriate class intervals
Draw a pie chart by calculating the angle for each category
Interpret a bar chart comparing two data sets and draw a conclusion about the difference
topics.assessmentPrompt: When {{name}} collects data for a project, can they choose the right type of chart to display it — and draw it accurately with correct labels and a suitable scale?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 散点图
topics.description: 在散点图上绘制双变量数据，正确标注坐标轴并选择合适的刻度；描述相关性（正相关、负相关、无相关），并在适当的情况下画出估计的最佳拟合线。
evidence: Plot 10 data points on a scatter graph with correct axis labels and a consistent scale
Draw a line of best fit by eye, ensuring roughly equal numbers of points above and below
Use the line of best fit to estimate a y-value for a given x-value within the data range
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} has data comparing hours of sleep and test scores for 10 students, can they plot the points on a scatter graph, draw a line of best fit, and use it to predict a score for someone who slept 7 hours?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 散点图与相关性
topics.description: 使用散点图描述两个变量之间的简单数学关系，识别正相关、负相关或无相关，并使用最佳拟合线进行预测
evidence: Plot bivariate data on a scatter graph and describe the type of correlation observed
Draw a line of best fit by eye and use it to estimate a value within the data range
Explain what positive, negative, and no correlation mean in the context of real data (e.g., temperature vs. ice-cream sales)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} plotted a scatter graph — say, comparing hours of revision and test scores — could they draw a line of best fit, describe the pattern, and use it to make a prediction?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 认识一半和四分之一（5岁以上）
topics.description: 认识、找出并说出四分之一是一个物体、图形或数量的四个相等部分之一
evidence: Fold a shape into four equal parts and identify each as 'a quarter'
Find a quarter of 12 objects by sharing into 4 equal groups
Identify whether a shape has been divided into quarters (four equal parts)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you fold a square piece of paper into four equal parts, can {{name}} tell you that each part is a quarter — and point to just one quarter?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 什么是二分之一？
topics.description: 认识、找出并说出二分之一是一个物体、图形或数量分成两个相等部分中的一份
evidence: Fold a shape into two equal parts and identify each as 'a half'
Find half of 8 objects by sharing into 2 equal groups
Identify whether a shape has been divided into halves or not (equal vs unequal parts)
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is helping share a sandwich equally between two people, can they cut it so both pieces are the same size — and tell you each piece is called a half?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 将图形分解成更多等份
topics.description: 理解将图形分解成更多等份会产生更小的份额
evidence: Explain that a quarter of a pizza is smaller than a half of the same pizza
Demonstrate that fourths are smaller pieces than halves
Compare the size of halves and quarters of the same shape
topics.assessmentPrompt: If a pizza is shared between 2 people and then the same pizza is shared between 8 people, can {{name}} explain why each slice is smaller when more people share it?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数表示法
topics.description: 正确读写和使用分数表示法——分数、分子、分母、单位分数、非单位分数、真分数、假分数、带分数、等值分数、最简形式——并理解每个术语的含义，包括分子和分母在表示整体中的部分时所起的作用。
evidence: Point to and name the numerator and denominator in any given fraction and explain what each tells you
Correctly classify fractions as unit, proper, improper, or mixed number with an example of each
Explain in own words why 2/4 and 1/2 are equivalent fractions
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} saw the fraction 3/4 written down, could they point to the numerator and the denominator — and explain what each number actually means?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数量的分数
topics.description: 认识、找出、命名并写出长度、图形、一组物体或数量的1/3、1/4、2/4和3/4
evidence: Find 1/3 of 12 objects by sharing into 3 equal groups
Shade 3/4 of a rectangle that has been divided into 4 equal parts
Identify 1/4 of a length on a number line or ruler
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you put 12 grapes on the table, can {{name}} count out a quarter of them — and then show you what three-quarters of the grapes looks like?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 图形的半与四分之一
topics.description: 将圆形和矩形分成两份和四份相等的部分，并用半、四分之一和四等份来描述它们
evidence: Divide a circle into two equal halves
Divide a rectangle into four equal quarters
Describe the whole as 'two halves' or 'four quarters'
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you give {{name}} a round pizza or a rectangular chocolate bar, can they divide it into four equal pieces and tell you each piece is called a quarter or a fourth?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 认识分数
topics.description: 写出简单的分数（例如：6的1/2 = 3），并认识2/4和1/2的等值关系
evidence: Write 1/2 of 10 = 5
Explain that 2/4 is the same as 1/2 using a diagram
Calculate simple unit fractions of quantities and write the result
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} has 6 strawberries and eats half of them, can they write that as "1/2 of 6 = 3" — and explain why 2/4 and 1/2 are the same amount?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 比较分数
topics.description: 比较和排序单位分数，以及分母相同的分数
evidence: Order 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, 1/5 from largest to smallest
Explain that a larger denominator means smaller unit fractions
Compare 2/5 and 4/5 and explain that 4/5 is larger because it has more fifths
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} has eaten 3/8 of a cake and a friend has eaten 5/8 of the same cake, can they tell you who has eaten more — and put those fractions in order from smallest to biggest?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数比较（7岁以上）
topics.description: 解决涉及十分之一计数、数量的分数、等值分数、分数加减法和分数比较的问题
evidence: Solve a word problem requiring finding a fraction of a quantity
Solve a problem that requires comparing or ordering fractions
Choose and apply appropriate fraction knowledge to a multi-step problem
topics.assessmentPrompt: If a bag of 20 sweets is shared equally among 5 friends, can {{name}} work out what fraction each person gets — and how many sweets that is?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 等值分数
topics.description: 借助图表认识并展示分母较小的等值分数
evidence: Show that 1/2 = 2/4 using a diagram of equal parts
Use a fraction wall or bar model to find equivalent fractions
Explain why two fractions are equivalent by comparing the shaded areas
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees a bar divided into 4 equal parts with 2 shaded, can they tell you that's the same as 1/2 — and draw a different bar showing the same amount another way?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数轴上的分数
topics.description: 认识并使用分数作为数字：在数轴上放置单位分数和分母较小的非单位分数
evidence: Place 1/2, 1/4, 3/4 on a number line from 0 to 1
Identify that 1/3 lies between 0 and 1/2 on the number line
Understand that a fraction is a single number, not just 'part of a shape'
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you draw a number line from 0 to 1, can {{name}} mark where 1/4, 1/2, and 3/4 should go — without any extra help?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 简单分数加减法
topics.description: 在一个整体内，对分母相同的分数进行加法和减法运算（例如：5/7 + 1/7 = 6/7）
evidence: Calculate 2/5 + 2/5 = 4/5
Calculate 6/8 − 3/8 = 3/8
Explain that when denominators are the same, you add/subtract the numerators
topics.assessmentPrompt: If a recipe calls for 2/8 of a cup of milk and then another 3/8 of a cup, can {{name}} work out the total without a calculator?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 把图形分成相等的部分（7岁以上）
topics.description: 把圆形和长方形分成2份、3份或4份相等的部分；用“一半”、“三分之一”和“四分之一”来描述这些部分；认识到同一个整体的相等部分可以有不同的形状。
evidence: Partition a circle into 3 equal parts and label each 'a third'
Partition a rectangle into 4 equal shares in more than one way
Explain that two different-looking shares can still be equal in size
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you cut a rectangle into thirds in two different ways (three strips vs three squares), can {{name}} recognise that both give equal thirds — even though the pieces look different?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 十分之一
topics.description: 以十分之一为单位进行顺数和倒数；认识到十分之一来自将一个物体分成10等份，以及将一位数或数量除以10
evidence: Count: one tenth, two tenths, three tenths … up to ten tenths (one whole)
Show that dividing a shape into 10 equal parts gives tenths
Explain that 3 ÷ 10 = 3/10
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} splits a chocolate bar with 10 equal pieces, can they tell you each piece is one tenth — and count up from 1/10 to 10/10 in order?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 单位分数
topics.description: 认识、找出并写出离散物体集合的分数：单位分数和分母较小的非单位分数
evidence: Find 1/4 of 12 objects by dividing into 4 equal groups
Find 3/4 of 12 objects
Write the fraction of a set that is shaded or selected
topics.assessmentPrompt: If there are 15 books on a shelf, can {{name}} work out how many two-thirds of them is — and check by grouping the books into three equal piles?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 同分母分数加法
topics.description: 学习同分母分数的加法和减法，包括结果大于1的情况（例如：5/8 + 6/8 = 11/8）
evidence: Calculate 3/5 + 4/5 = 7/5 and explain it equals 1 2/5
Subtract 2/6 from 5/6
Solve addition problems where the sum exceeds the whole: 7/8 + 3/8
topics.assessmentPrompt: If a recipe uses 5/8 of a bag of flour and then another 6/8, can {{name}} work out the total and explain what the answer means as a mixed number?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数比较（8岁以上）
topics.description: 通过推理大小来比较分子相同或分母相同的两个分数；用>、=或<符号记录比较结果
evidence: Compare 3/8 and 3/4: same numerator, larger denominator means smaller pieces so 3/8 < 3/4
Compare 5/6 and 2/6: same denominator so 5/6 > 2/6
Justify a comparison using a visual model and explain why both fractions must refer to the same whole
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees 3/5 and 3/8, can they tell you which is bigger just by thinking about the size of each piece — without needing to draw it out?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 十分位和百分位的小数等价
topics.description: 认识并写出十分之几或百分之几的小数等价形式（例如：3/10 = 0.3，27/100 = 0.27）
evidence: Write 7/10 as 0.7 and vice versa
Convert 45/100 to 0.45
Place 0.3 and 3/10 at the same point on a number line
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees 7/10 on a price label, can they rewrite it as a decimal — and do the same thing for 43/100?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 小数与百分数表示法
topics.description: 正确读写和使用小数与百分数——小数、小数点、十分位、百分位、千分位、百分数、百分比、%符号、转换、有限小数——并理解分数、小数和百分数是表示同一个值的三种方式。
evidence: Read and write decimal numbers correctly, identifying the value of each digit (ones, tenths, hundredths)
Use the % symbol correctly and explain that per cent means 'out of 100'
Convert between simple fractions, decimals, and percentages (e.g. 1/2 = 0.5 = 50%) and explain why they are equal
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} saw '0.5' and '50%' written down, could they explain that they both mean the same amount — and write them as a fraction too?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 小数位值
topics.description: 将一位小数四舍五入到最接近的整数
evidence: Round 3.7 to 4 and 3.2 to 3
Place 6.5 on a number line between 6 and 7 and decide it rounds to 7
Round a set of one-decimal-place numbers and explain the rounding rule
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} measures something as 3.7 m, can they tell you whether that rounds to 3 m or 4 m — and explain why?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 小数位值（8岁以上）
topics.description: 比较小数位数相同且最多两位小数的数的大小
evidence: Order 0.45, 0.54, 0.39 from smallest to largest
Compare 3.72 and 3.27 using place-value reasoning
Place three two-decimal-place numbers on a number line in order
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is comparing two prices — £4.75 and £4.57 — can they tell you which is more expensive without using a calculator?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 小数与分数
topics.description: 解决涉及分数和小数（最多两位小数）的简单测量和货币问题
evidence: Calculate 1/4 of £3.20
A rope is 2.5 m long; how much is left after cutting 0.75 m?
Find 3/10 of 1 kg and express the answer in grams and as a decimal of a kg
topics.assessmentPrompt: If a bottle holds 1.5 litres and {{name}} drinks 0.75 litres, can they work out how much is left — and write it as both a decimal and a fraction?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 除以10和100
topics.description: 探索一位数或两位数除以10和100的结果，识别数字在个位、十分位和百分位上的值
evidence: Calculate 37 ÷ 10 = 3.7 and identify 3 as ones and 7 as tenths
Calculate 4 ÷ 100 = 0.04 and identify 4 as hundredths
Explain that dividing by 10 shifts each digit one place to the right
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} starts with the number 48 and divides it by 10, can they tell you the answer — and explain what happened to each digit's place value?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 等值分数（8岁以上）
topics.description: 使用视觉分数模型生成简单的等值分数，并解释它们为什么相等。
evidence: Given 1/3, generate 2/6 as equivalent and show with area model
Simplify 4/8 to 1/2 and justify with a fraction strip
Complete equivalence chains: 1/4 = ?/8 = ?/12
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} is shown a fraction bar split into 3 parts with 1 shaded (= 1/3), can they draw an equivalent bar with 6 parts that shows exactly the same amount shaded?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数轴上的等值分数
topics.description: 理解如果两个分数大小相同或在数轴上对应同一点，那么它们是等值的；能借助图表识别并展示常见的等值分数族。
evidence: Use fraction strips to show 1/2 = 2/4 = 3/6
Verify on a number line that 2/3 and 4/6 land on the same point
Identify at least three fractions equivalent to 1/2 using diagrams
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} sees that 2/4 and 1/2 land on the exact same point on a number line, can they explain in their own words why those two fractions are equal?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数与小数的等值关系
topics.description: 认识并写出1/4、1/2和3/4的小数形式
evidence: Match fractions to decimals in a sorting activity
Explain why 1/4 = 25/100 = 0.25 using a hundredths grid
topics.assessmentPrompt: If a recipe calls for 3/4 of a cup of flour, can {{name}} tell you what that is as a decimal — without looking it up?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数作为形状的一部分
topics.description: 将图形分割成面积相等的部分，并用单位分数表示每个部分的面积占整体的比例。
evidence: Partition a rectangle into 6 equal-area parts and label each 1/6
Show two different ways to partition a square into 4 equal parts
Given a pre-partitioned shape, write the unit fraction for one part
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you ask {{name}} to fold a square piece of paper into 8 equal parts, can they tell you what fraction of the whole square each part represents?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 求数量的几分之几（进阶）
topics.description: 解决涉及更复杂分数的数量计算问题，包括结果为整数的非单位分数
evidence: Find 3/5 of 20
Calculate 2/3 of 18 and explain the two-step process (divide then multiply)
Solve: A bag has 24 sweets, 3/8 are red — how many red sweets?
topics.assessmentPrompt: If 3/4 of a class of 28 pupils brought their homework in, can {{name}} work out exactly how many pupils that is?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 整体的分数
topics.description: 理解分数1/b表示将整体平均分成b份后，其中1份的数量；理解a/b表示a个大小为1/b的部分。
evidence: Given a shape divided into 5 equal parts, identify one shaded part as 1/5
Explain that 3/4 means 3 parts each of size 1/4
Draw a model showing 2/6 as 2 pieces of a whole cut into 6
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you cut a pizza into 6 equal slices, can {{name}} explain what 1/6 means — and then work out what 4/6 of the pizza looks like?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 整数的分数表示（8岁以上）
topics.description: 将整数表示为分数（例如 3 = 3/1），并认识与整数相等的分数（例如 4/4 = 1，6/1 = 6）
evidence: Write 5 as 5/1 and explain why
Locate 4/4 and 1 at the same point on a number line
Identify which fractions from a list equal a whole number: 6/3, 8/4, 5/2
topics.assessmentPrompt: If you ask {{name}} to write the number 3 as a fraction, can they write 3/1 — and also tell you what fraction equals exactly 1 whole, like 4/4 or 5/5?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 数轴上的分数（8岁以上）
topics.description: 在数轴上表示分数：将0到1的区间等分成b份，找到1/b的位置，然后从0开始连续标记a个1/b的长度，从而找到a/b的位置。
evidence: Partition a 0-to-1 number line into 4 equal parts and mark 1/4
Explain that each part on the line has size 1/b
Locate 1/3 and 1/6 on separate number lines
Locate 3/4 on a number line by counting three 1/4-jumps from 0
Place 5/6 on a number line and explain the process
Identify a fraction shown by a point on a pre-partitioned number line
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} draws a number line from 0 to 1 split into 5 equal parts, can they label where 2/5 and 4/5 go — and explain how they worked it out?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 十分位（8岁以上）
topics.description: 以百分位为单位进行顺数和倒数；理解百分位是将一个物体分成100份或把十分位再分成10份时产生的
evidence: Count from 3/100 to 12/100 in hundredths
Explain that 1/10 ÷ 10 = 1/100
Place several hundredths on a number line between 0 and 1/10
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} has £1 and spends 37p, can they say that 37p is 37/100 of a pound — and count up in hundredths from 0/100 to 100/100?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 带分数的加减法
topics.description: 学习同分母带分数的加减法，包括将带分数化为假分数或运用运算性质来计算。
evidence: Calculate 2 3/5 + 1 4/5 and express as a mixed number
Subtract 3 1/4 from 5 3/4
Solve 4 2/6 − 1 5/6 by regrouping the whole number
topics.assessmentPrompt: If a recipe calls for 1 and 2/5 cups of oats and another batch needs 2 and 3/5 cups, can {{name}} add them together to get the total — including converting when the fifths add up past a whole?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 异分母分数加法
topics.description: 通过寻找公分母，对分母为同一数的倍数的分数进行加减运算
evidence: Calculate 1/3 + 1/6 by converting to sixths: 2/6 + 1/6 = 3/6 = 1/2
Calculate 3/4 − 1/8 by converting to eighths
Add 2/5 + 3/10 and simplify the answer
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} needs to add 1/3 and 1/6, can they find a common denominator and work out the total — showing their working?

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: 分数加减法应用题
topics.description: 运用直观模型和算式，解决同分母分数加减法的应用题
evidence: A jug contains 3/4 litre of juice; 2/4 litre is poured out — how much remains?
Two pieces of ribbon are 2 3/8 and 1 5/8 inches — what is their total length?
Draw a fraction model to represent and solve a fraction word problem
topics.assessmentPrompt: If {{name}} reads that one section of a nature trail is 3/8 km and another is 5/8 km, can they work out the total distance without a calculator?
